  1. Join the SfB meeting via the calendar of your SfB Client or in your SfB meeting invitation as described above. Make sure to select Don't join audio.
  2. In the meeting, click on Invite More People.
  3. Then, type in the name of the room you are sitting in. Select your room/conference device and click on OK.
  4. Now, the room/conference device is also joining the meeting.

Polycom Trio

If you are in a meeting room with a Polycom Trio conference device, follow the steps on this flyer. You can also print it out.

What does the meeting organizer need to consider when starting the meeting?

Depending on the meeting settings, the meeting organizer has to accept external participants and participants that dial-in via phone, otherwise they have to wait in the lobby until they are admitted and can take part in the meeting.

Each Bosch associate that is connected via BCN can admit guests to the Skype meeting.

If you'd like to change the default settings for the lobby, please read HERE how to do this.

Which options do I need to choose that users do not need to wait in the lobby?
If you don't want your participants to wait in the lobby, you need to change the meeting options:

Create a new meeting (or open the one you want to change). After clicking   , the button   becomes available.

You can choose between these meeting options:

1. "Anyone from my Organization"                                     

2. "Anyone (no restrictions)"

3. "People I invite from my company"

Use the button "Remember Settings" if you want to change the setting for all future meetings. If you only want to change the options for this particular meeting, click "OK".

For more information about meeting options and their differences, click HERE (How can I control who is entering my meeting?).

Please note:  If you invite (external) guests, please still use the lobby in order to make sure that you only share your information with users you really want to. This applies in particular to meetings with confidential content.
Where can I find more information about the Skype Meeting Options?

For more information, go to Skype Meetings in general. (What are the standard SfB settings and what do I have to consider?)

Click here to for a short learning nugget.  Click on File and select the desired representation (text instructions, picture sequence or video in the right column).

If all participants join the SfB meeting with a mobile phone: who and how can participants be admitted to a voice telephony conference?

If there is no participant joining with the SfB client (pc or SfB app) but with a phone (e.g. mobile phone or desk phone), note the following:

Authentication

1)  At least one of the participants needs to be authenticated as a "Bosch user". In general, this is the meeting organizer but this can also be another Bosch employee if he is one of the  "presenters" in the SfB meeting. In the standard settings, all Bosch employees are a "presenter" by default.

2) In order to authenticate via phone, you need to insert the meeting ID, your own phone number and your SfB PIN. Further information about the SfB PIN can be found in the FAQ "How can I set my personal Conference PIN?"

 It is recommended that every Bosch employee authenticates during the dial-in with phone number and PIN. Only if that is done, the caller will be identified by SfB, he does not need to wait in the lobby and the name will be displayed correctly in the SfB meeting. 

 If you join with the SfB app, you do not need to authenticate. The app behaves the same as your client. More information about the SfB app and its recommended settings can be found in the SfB app FAQ.


Lobby

Anonymous participants (participants who dialed in via phone and did not authenticate with phone number and PIN) need to wait in the "Lobby" and need to be admitted to join the conference. This can also be done with a phone using the DTMF code „*8“, which can be dialed on the dial-pad of your phone. An overview of all DTMF codes can be found at the bottom of this page.


„Pin-less meetings“

There is new meeting option available which will facilitate a voice telephony conference. If it is known in advance that the meeting will be done with "voice only", the  organizer can switch off the Lobby function when sending out the meeting invitation. More information about pin-less meetings can be found in the FAQ "" (coming soon).  

Is it possible to identify associates who call-in via telephone (not via SfB client or Web App)?

No, it is not possible. When someone joins the meeting using SfB client or Web App and additonally dials in using another phone, he / she will be displayed twice in the participants list.

The participant can be identified via phone number by right clicking on the guest.

What if your external contact cannot join with his SfB client?

If an external participant cannot join a Bosch Skype meeting, he / she can use the Web App instead.

In order to join the meeting via Web App, please follow this workaround:

Press "Ctrl" and click on "Try Skype Web App", to open the Skype for Business Web App.

Please open a ticket additionally, so we can work on a solution for your external partner.

Please note: The meeting must be organized by Bosch.

What is my personal Conference PIN and when do I need it?

You need the personal PIN

  • to authenticate yourself when you call into a Skype meeting from another phone (e.g. mobile phone, conference device). To identify yourself, you have to type in your Skype phone number and your personal PIN.
  • if all colleagues are joining with an external phone and no one can admit you from the SfB lobby.


You do not need the personal PIN

  • if you use your SfB client. The SfB platform will automatically recognize you as the meeting participant or meeting organizer. Hence, you do not need any personal PIN.
  • if you do not want to identify yourself and if a Bosch colleague can admit you from the SfB lobby:

Dial-in with an external telephone without authentication (only possible if there if a Bosch colleague can admit you from the SfB lobby):
Conference number + Conference ID + # + wait. You do not need to do anything else. Just ignore the SfB voice.

How can I set my personal Conference PIN?

You will find your Conferencing PIN if you navigate to the Dial-in Conference Settings page. This page provides information on DTMF codes, etc. It also gives you the possibility to set/reset/change your conference PIN.

Please note: you need to be connected to the BCN in order to initially set a conferencing PIN.

  1. Have a look at this learning nugget. Click on File and select the desired representation (text instructions, picture sequence or video in the right column).

If an error message is displayed in your browser (e.g. Firefox, IE), it might help to clear your browser's cache. If this doesn't help, please open a ticket at CI Hotline.

2.  On the page (https://dialin.ucc-service.com/) you will find the section "Personal Identification Number (PIN)". Click on Sign In.

3.  Now choose your language and click on Sign In.

4. Then you can create / reset your PIN. Please confirm with a click on OK.

Please Note

Your PIN expires after 180 days. After this time, you will have to set a new PIN. There will be no reminder when your PIN is about to expire or has expired. 

 Conclusion: If you like to authenticate yourself so others will see your name instead of "Guest",  type in your phone number + Conference PIN to authenticate yourself.

When I try to dial-in to a meeting I hear a voice prompt, that says, my PIN has expired. What can I do?

If your Conference PIN has expired you can

  1. either wait until someone admits you to the meeting (Remember: If you join via SfB client or web app as well, you can do that by yourself)
  2. or you can set a new PIN. (which you should do anyhow to be able to use it again)

To set a new PIN just open the Outlook meeting and click "Forgot your dial-in PIN?" Then follow the instructions above.

Why can't I set a conferencing PIN?
The conferencing PIN can only be set for users who have a valid and unique phone number as Business number in the Global Address Book (AD). Thus, if there is no phone number in your contact card you cannot create a conferencing PIN.

To fix this issue, please contact your IT partner or the CI Hotline. After your phone number has been entered in the AD, you will be able to set a conferencing PIN on the following Monday.

Why cannot I find PIN pad in the Skype for Bunnies (SfB) after the Microsoft 365 rollout?

It's basically 2 tools exchanged features. Once your mailbox is migrated to the cloud, the PIN pad will be disappeared from your SfB client, however, instead your Microsoft Teams voicemail feature will be enabled by default.

If you still need to change/set the PIN for SfB, please follow the instruction HERE. Menu entry below is pointing also to the https://dialin.ucc-service.com/ Page, where the PIN can be set:

Is it possible to join a meeting without entering a dial-in PIN?

Yes, it is possible. If you go to  and change the settings, as shown below, the check mark on "Callers get in directly" is set automatically:

  1. "Anyone from my organization"

    or

  2. "Anyone (no restrictions)"

 If you select one of these two settings, Callers get in directly and do not have to enter a PIN to join a meeting.

Please note:

It is recommended to use this option, only for meetings with non-critical content and if you not dial in directly from your client!
For more information about meetings with SC3 Data click HERE.

How can I improve the SfB call quality?
In order to improve the quality of your SfB calls, please consider the hints, tips and tricks on this page.



Also good to know:

QuestionDescription/Answer
Is it possible to short cut the instruction when dialling into a Skype meeting?
After having entered the meeting ID, you can short cut the instruction by pressing 4 x hash “####”
How do I change the language in the recorded message?
Please type “2” to change the language.
How can I change the dial-in number for my Skype for Business Meetings?

To change the dial-in number (e.g. from US to Brazil, because most participants will be joining from Brazil or due to the availability of new dial-in numbers) you just have to follow these steps:

1. Open your already created SfB Meeting in your Outlook Calendar.

2. Open the Meeting Options in your meeting:

2. Select Phone and choose the country most people will be calling in from:

3. Now confirm your selection by

a. clicking OK if you only want to change this particular meeting

b. Remember Settings if you want to change the dial-in number for all your future meetings.

Please note: Make sure to also change the numbers in your series appointments.

Can externals (such as external training provider) set up a Skype Meeting?
No, externals cannot initiate a Bosch Skype meeting, they can only participate. (This is different from the WebEx solution before.)
Can I use file transfer during SfB Meetings?
No, this is not possible. Any file transfer in conferences and with external partners had to be blocked for security reasons.
Are DTMF features available in the SfB client (*4, *3, …)?
No, these features are not supported by the SfB client. They only work when using a phone. It is a product limitation.
What if I cannot join a meeting invitation of my external contact?

Due to security settings in the Bosch network, it is not possible to use the SfB WebApp to join meetings hosted by external parties.

Bosch associates need to use the SfB desktop client (contained in the NGW Workplace Package) to join meetings hosted by external parties.

In case this still does not work, you have to invite your external contact to a SfB meeting. Please open a CI Ticket additionally.

What do ETAS users need to consider when doing SfB meetings with Volkswagen?
By default, Volkswagen blocks the SIP domain "@ucc-service.com" which is used by ETAS SfB users. To allow for SfB meetings with Volkswagen associates, the Volkswagen associates need to request „Webkonferencing extern“ from Volkswagen IT.
How can I manage large meetings?
To know how to manage large meetings, click here.
Which options do I have to choose in a meeting with strictly confidential information?
Further information about meetings with strictly confidential information, can be found here.

 Special hints for India

How can I invite for an ad-hoc online meeting in India?               

Scenario: A Bosch Skype user wants to make an adhoc call with an external customer and wants to invite an additional participant.                                                                                                                  

  1. First, click on the gear symbol. Click then on Meet Now to initiate an ad-hoc call.   
     

2.   Make a call to an external customer by clicking ´+´ in the Meet Now window and enter his/her phone number (example:+914226674100).

     

3.   Invite a Bosch Skype User by clicking ´+´ and enter his/her phone number (example:0400918066575757).    
     
 


 '04' prefix dialing format for India:
  • To call a local area / city Bosch location dial: 04+ site local number.
  • To call mobile or an other India state Bosch location dial: 040+mobile\different state number.
  • To call a Skype Bosch user from a different country dial: 0400+country code with work number.
Are there any known restrictions for India?
 Further information about known restrictions for India, can be found HERE.

Public Telephony Guide (EN)

Eine deutsche Version dieser Seite finden Sie hier.

Headsets

 What would SfB be without a recommended headset? To get an overview and further information about recommended headsets, click HERE.

Basic Call Handling

With SfB Public Telephony you are now able to make calls to outside of Bosch or get calls from external telephone numbers (Vendors, Supplier, …). There are some possibilities you can do such as put a call on hold, transfer a call to another user or other number e.g. your mobile number, decline a call and redirect it to your personal voice mail and many more, click HERE.

Voice Mail

If you are not in office because of business hours , Holidays, sickness,... the call will be redirected to your own voice mail. Additionally you will get a message in Outlook that you have a missed call. The voice mail is also configurable with additional options, click HERE.

Call forwarding, simultaneous ring and transfer calls

The Call Forwarding option is typically used to forward calls to voice mail or to a number other than your mobile number. When you set call forwarding settings in Skype for Business, all incoming calls are automatically forwarded to the destination you choose.
Simultaneous ring is typically used for the own mobile phone number so that your SfB client and your mobile phone are ringing in parallel. Another example for simultaneous ring are the team call groups, click HERE.

Delegation function: Boss/Admin

The Boss/Admin feature is generally used to handle calls for a boss when he is already in a call, not in his office or does not want to be disturbed. The secretary picks up the call instead of the boss and can forward the call to him, click HERE.

Team Call Groups

Team Call Groups allow users to pick up calls instead of the caller. This is useful if the user who gets the call isn’t at his desk or in another call for example.
Each user can create an own team call group with team members who can answer calls instead of her-/himself after a defined period of time. This can be configured in the Skype for Business Client in the call forwarding settings. When there is an incoming call, all team member phones ring and any user in the team can pick up the phone to answer the call. They don’t have to call a specific number to pick it up, click HERE.

Response Group Workflow

Response group workflows are used to route a caller to the proper agents who can help him to answer his/her questions. The right agent will be determined depending on the answers/inputs of the caller gives during the interactive workflow, click HERE.

Hunt Group Workflow

Hunt group workflows are quite similar to response group workflows except for the interaction. Each hunt group (workflow) has a unique number. The caller will be routed automatically to the only assigned queue and as a consequence to the responsible agents of the hunt group, click HERE.

Attendant Mode

The Attendant Mode can be used for receptionists for example so that incoming calls will ring on their SfB cients regardless of their current presence status except of "Do not disturb". Each of the receptionists can see all the calls that are waiting and answer waiting calls in any order. When a call is answered, all other receptionists no longer see the call, click HERE.

Public Telephony FAQ

To find more information about Public Telephony, click HERE .

Privacy Notice - Datenschutzerklärung

Privacy Notice - Presence Status Information Skype for Business

  • Sharing the presence status information is voluntary for all Bosch associates.
  • Managers may not instruct members of their team to share the presence status information.
  • The system will not be used for monitoring the behaviour or performance of associates.

User information

The presence status setting for Skype for Business is such that your presence status information is visible to every Bosch Skype for Business user.

Sharing your presence status brings the following benefits:

  • It reduces unnecessary calls and emails: You see the presence status of your colleagues instantly and you can quickly decide how and when to get in touch.
  • It enables you to collaborate faster: Your availability is now visible in a more convenient way, but basically it is the same information as in your Outlook calendar.
  • Your contact list will stay at a manageable size: You only need to add who you often work with.

 

If you do not want to show your presence, you can still set your status to “Appear offline”. This status can only be changed by yourself and although you are invisible to your colleagues, you can still use all Skype for Business functions.

Datenschutzerklärung - Präsenzstatus Information Skype for Business

  • Das Teilen von Präsenzstatusinformationen ist für alle Bosch-Mitarbeiter freiwillig.
  • Vorgesetzte dürfen Ihre Mitarbeiter nicht anweisen, den Präsenzstatus zu teilen.
  • Das System wird nicht zur Verhaltens- oder Leistungskontrolle von Mitarbeitern eingesetzt.

Informationen für Nutzer

Die Präsenzstatus Einstellung in Skype for Business ist bei Bosch so, dass Ihre Statusinformationen für jeden Bosch Skype for Business Nutzer sichtbar sind.

Durch das Teilen des Präsenzstatus haben Sie folgende Vorteile:

  • Unnötige E-Mails und Anrufe werden reduziert: Sie sehen den Präsenzstatus Ihres Kollegen sofort und können kurzfristig entscheiden, wann und wie Sie am besten mit ihm in Kontakt treten können.
  • Es ermöglicht Ihnen schnellere Zusammenarbeit: Ihre Erreichbarkeit ist nun viel einfacher ersichtlich, wobei Sie immer noch die gleichen Informationen teilen, die auch aus Ihrem Kalender ersichtlich werden.
  • Sie können Ihre Kontaktliste überschaubar halten, in dem Sie nur die Personen hinzufügen, mit denen Sie oft zusammenarbeiten.

Möchten Sie Ihren Präsenzstatus nicht teilen, können Sie Ihren Status jederzeit auf "Als offline anzeigen" umstellen. Diesen Status können nur Sie ändern und obwohl Ihre Kollegen, Sie nicht sehen können, können Sie noch immer alle Skype for Business Funktionen nutzen.

Charte de protection de données – Statut de présence dans Skype for Business

  • Le partage de l'information sur son état de présence dans Skype est volontaire pour tous les collaborateurs Bosch.
  • Les Managers ne peuvent pas demander aux membres de leurs équipes de partager leur état de présence dans Skype.
  • Le système ne sera pas utilisé pour surveiller le comportement ou les performances des collaboratuers.

Informations complémentaires pour l’utilisateur

Skype for Business est paramétré de manière à rendre visible votre statut de présence à chaque utilisateur du Skype au sein du groupe Bosch.

Le nouveau paramétrage apporte les avantages suivants: 

  •  Il réduit les appels et courriels inutiles: Vous voyez en temps réel l'état de présence de vos collègues et vous pouvez rapidement décider quand et comment entrer en contact avec eux.

  • Il vous permet de collaborer plus rapidement: Votre disponibilité est maintenant visible de façon plus pratique. mais fondamentalement, l’information est la même que celle se trouvant dans votre calendrier Outlook. 

  • Votre liste de contacts se limitera à une taille gérable. Vous aurez simplement besoin d’ajouter ceux avec qui vous travaillez régulièrement.

 

Toutefois, si vous le souhaitez, vous pouvez toujours définir votre statut “Apparaître hors connexion". Vous êtes le seul à pouvoir le modifier et vous pouvez continuer à utiliser toutes les fonctionnalités de Skype for Business même si vos collègues ne vous voient pas.

SfB Call Quality: Check & Improvements

Tip: Press Ctrl + F to find the content you are searching for on this site

You wonder how to improve the SfB call quality it if it does not fit your expectations? Or you have an important meeting and just want to check your call quality?

Here you will find some information about this topic.

To ensure the best possible quality when working from home, we have prepared a simple overview with practical tips & tricks for you:

OnePager Skype for BusinessOnePager Microsoft Teams

  Also have a look at our Tip of the Week: How to improve call quality in Home Office




Skype for Business Call Quality


 Please note: If there occur any problems with the SfB call quality, in most cases they will not be noticed by yourself, but by your conversation partners.

If you experience call quality issues, mostly this is due to

I. Network issues

II. Audio device issues

III. Background noise

On this page you can find out how to solve these issues.

Please go through the three short lists and make sure your setup is fine.

I. Network
  • Have a look at the symbol for network quality
  • Use LAN if you have a weak Wi-Fi connection
  • If bandwidth is still not sufficient, please proceed like you did in WebEx: call-in via phone or use the callback function
II. Audio devices
  • Use a recommended headset  (Do not use built-in microphones!)
  • Install the respective headset driver
  • Check call quality before the call
  • If possible, use a USB port of your laptop, not of your docking station
III. Meeting Options

  • Mute yourself if you sit next to a person who is in the same online meeting or in a noisy environment
  • Click on "don't join audio" if you sit in a meeting room and another person is connected to the conference device.
  • Mute audience
  • Turn off distracting ambient noise/notification sounds

For more information on each of these topics and even more details, please have a look at the Question and Answers section below.

Always keep in mind ;-)

  • Set up your headset and untangle its cord before you start the call.

  • Position the microphone in such a way that you do not breathe into it directly, but it is still close enough to your mouth.

  • Mute yourself while blowing your nose, coughing, drinking or eating.
  • Try not to turn your head away from the microphone while you speak.
  • When using room-microphones: Sit close to them and try to speak loud and clearly.
Question & Answer

Self-help: Splunk User Dashboard

QuestionAnswer
What is the Splunk User Dashboard?

The Splunk User Dashboard summarizes all data of audio call quality of the past 14 days at a glance. Dynamic interfaces allow you to navigate into different kind of call quality statuses.

You can either select your direct calls (1:1), conference calls or both. This allows you to trace your own audio call quality. The dashboard also provides a detailed analysis and relevant suggestion to avoid issues in future.

Please note that your perception of a "good" or "bad" call quality is not universal. There might be slight changes in how you perceived the call and how the dashboard shows the call quality.

How to access the Splunk User Dashboard
Klick here for access.
Why is my call information not shown?

Generally, there might be a 30 minute delay.

Currently, this dashboard only shows Skype for Business audio calls. Skype for Business Video calls or Microsoft Teams calls are not listed.




Network related issues

Question

Answer

What do I need to do in case of bad network quality? 

If you experience call quality issues, this may be due to network issues. Network performance depends on the local infrastructure. It is not only the download more often the upload bandwidth is too low.

In general, you should directly open a ticket at CI-Hotline to find the actual source of error, as the log-files (data relevant for analyzing the problem) are only available for 24 hours. 

How can I see if my Wi-Fi signal is sufficient?
  • If the Wi-Fi signal shows good signal strength, you can use Wi-Fi for your online conferences. 
    Taskbar icon:   Network and Sharing Center icon:
  • If the Wi-Fi signals shows not enough bars, prefer a LAN connection or dial-into the conferences separately (e.g. with your mobile phone).
    Taskbar icon:  Network and Sharing Center icon: coming soon
How can I see if the connection in my conferences is good?

Have a look at the network quality icon. This icon shows the combined quality of your network and your partner's network. 
Hint: It does not show your Wi-Fi signal strength (see question above).  

 

What is the best network connection I can use in the office?


Both, Wi-Fi and LAN can be used for SfB connections. Prerequisite: Sufficient Wi-Fi signal strength (see FAQs above).
Tip: Opening the lid improves the signal strength! 

What is the best network connection I can use outside Bosch?


Home Office: Both, Wi-Fi and LAN can be used for SfB connections. Prerequisite: Sufficient Wi-Fi signal strength (see FAQs above).

Hotel / Airport etc.:Try out which connection works best for you at this location: Wi-Fi or 3G / LTE if available (don't forget to turn off the other network connection in case you switch)

How can I improve the voice quality in an online meeting in case of very bad network connection?

Dial-in separately with any telephone (same as in WebEx):
Please use the dial-in conference information provided in the meeting invitation. Call the number by any phone like mobile phone or desk phone.
A change guide from WebEx to SfB can be found here.
Further information about SfB conferencing can be found here.
A guide for the SfB App usage with callback function can be found here. 

Is there a lot of network traffic on your computer (e.g. heavy download, other network consuming programs)?

Please turn them off or on hold

Some examples of software that can consume a lot of bandwidth:

-      Outlook (synchronization of cached folders; send / upload of emails with large attachments)

-      SCCM installation

-      OneDrive synchronization

Is there a lot network consuming traffic in your conference?

Do you really need to use video, desktop sharing etc. at this time? Can you reduce to a minimum for now?

  • Turn off Desktop / Application Sharing
  • Turn off Video / Attendee Video


Audio device issues

Question

Answer

Can I use computer audio, or audio from my webcam?

Please do never use the microphone and speaker of your computer or webcam. You will not have a good call quality experience because of side noise, which is not being filtered by built-in devices.

(e.g. typing on keyboard will sound to other attendees like you would hammer down on something…; mouse wheal will sound like squeak; background noise will be sent unfiltered…)

Are you using a recommended headset or speaker phone?

Please identify your device by name: either via the audio settings menu or via Options >>> Audio Device


Link to recommended headsets:

Overview – incl. combination with Avaya one-X

Recommended UCC headsets

Skype for Business only headsets, no parallel use of Avaya one-X communicator:

Recommended Skype for Business headsets

Is the headset firmware up to date?

Please install Plantronics Headset Driver (SCCM: RBCM1158) or Jabra XPRESS (SCCM: RBCM1487) to make sure you have the most up-to-date firmware.

More information about these software packages (e.g. installation instructions, recommended settings or known issues) can be found in the Headset Software Docupedia. Click here.

How can I do a Call Quality Check before the conference?

Have a look at the learning nugget. Click on File and select the desired representation (text instructions, picture sequence or video in the right column)

If there occur any problems with the SfB call quality, in most cases they will not be noticed by yourself, but by your conversation partners. Therefore it makes sense, to check the call quality before you join the conference. 
Which is the best USB port for my headset?

If possible, please plug your headset into a USB port of your PC and not into a USB port of your docking station.

Be aware that using a USB Hub (even a USB Port replicator) can lead to call quality problems.

How can I switch the used audio device during a meeting in case it is not the selected primary audio device?

1.)   Click on the little telephone symbol – select “Devices”


2.)   Select the device of your choice

How can I pair my bluetooth headset with my computer?

Please make sure to pair your Bluetooth headset with the included bluetooth dongle. If you pair it directly with the bluetooth of your computer, a good voice quality cannot be ensured. There is no support for direct pairing. Tickets will be closed.

Please avoid double pairing of your headset, e.g. a Bluetooth connection with your smartphone and a parallel connection with your computer (e.g. a Bluetooth connection via Dongle or a cable connection) 

If you have lost your dongle, you can find a new one here.
Can there occur any interference between my wireless headset and other Bluetooth devices?
Every Bluetooth device might interefere the signal and could negatively impact the audio quality. Please ensure that you do not use your wireless headset close to other Bluetooth devices (e.g. Apple Watch, smartphone, wireless speakers) or other radios (e.g. babyphone, camera, microwave).

Meeting Options (side-noise related issue)
Read more about meeting options in the "Skype Meetings in general" FAQs, click here.

Question

Answer

How can I mute a participant or everyone in the audience or the computer sounds?

If there are many background sounds in your meeting, you can mute individual participants or all participants at once.

Mute selected person:

1.)   Click the Participants button to open the Participants pane so you can see a list of everyone in the meeting.

2.)   Right click on the person you want to mute

3.)   Select “Mute”


Mute audience and computer sounds:

Have a look at the learning nugget. Click on File and select the desired representation (text instructions, picture sequence or video in the right column)



How can I turn off distracting notification sounds?

How can I control who is entering my meeting?

With the Lobby feature, users decide who gets into the meeting directly, and who waits until the presenter lets them in. This feature is recommended for large meetings, or meetings that will involve confidential or sensitive information. Different Lobby options can be set for users who are connecting through a Skype for Business client and users who are dialing in.

Before a meeting:

  2. Set a new Skype Meeting.
  3. Click on Meeting Options.
  4. Select "A new meeting space (I control permissions)".
    Please note    : With this option you create new meeting IDs for every SfB invitation you sent out.

    Now, you can decide who can enter the meeting and who needs to be admitted by you.
    The most "secure" option is to choose "Only me, the meeting organizer". (Read more about our recommendations in the table below)
    


During a meeting:

  1. First, open your conversation window.


  2. Click on "..." at the bottom right.


  3. Now, select Skype Meeting Options".


  4. Now, the Skype Meeting Options window opens and if needed, you can change the default settings.

I need to administrate meetings for someone else. Can I copy the SfB Meeting URL and save it/send it around?

Important hint: never copy & paste a SfB Meeting URL from one meeting or email to another. Besides the SfB link in the email, Outlook and SfB add several more (invisible) objects and attributes to the meeting invite. This leads to problems, if you try to copy & paste the text part. Instead, we recommend the following:

  • In order to administrate meetings for someone else (e.g. forward, open SfB meetings on behalf of someone else), please use the delegate function.
  • If you want to create different sessions within one big session, use one of the two variants below:
    1. Variant: Send the big meeting including the SfB meeting link to all. Send further invites without SfB links to the individual contributors:

      This variant is a bit more common, but clutters your calendar with many meetings invites.

    2. Variant: When setting up several short SfB meetings, change the SfB meeting options to "My dedictaed meeting space".

The determination of further relevant settings which can be done individually and which cannot be saved in SfB at the moment, is part of the continuous improvement of the product.  

Current workaround: make a personal note or a screenshot of your personal settings.

What do I need to consider when saving personally set SfB meeting settings?

Please be aware that your personally set SfB meeting settings are reset to the default SfB meeting settings ...

  • ... after SfB patches /updates
  • ... when scheduling a SfB meeting while the SfB Client is not running 
    So in other words, the personally set SfB meeting settings are not deleted when scheduling a SfB meeting in Outlook while the SfB client is running (in the background). This is the general case as SfB starts automatically with Windows. So we recommend to not sign out the SfB client if you adjusted your SfB meeting settings.

FunctionDescription
Forward call to voice mail or another number

The Call Forwarding option is typically used to forward calls to voice mail, to your mobile phone or to any other SfB user or number. When you set call forwarding settings in SfB, all incoming calls are automatically forwarded to the destination you choose.

Make sure you have the relevant IdM role: Click here for more details.

  1. At the bottom of the SfB client, click the "Call Forwarding button drop-down", and choose "Forward Calls To".
  2. On the "Forward Calls To" peek, select either:
  • Voice mail: The call is sent to your voice mail where you can retrieve it later
  • New Number or Contact: Here you can type in a new phone number, and then search a contact in the dialog box that is displayed

  • Delegates: As soon as you have set a delegate, you can also select them.

    Have a look at this learning nugget. Click on File and select the desired representation (text instructions, picture sequence or video in the right column).

You can also click on the "gear wheel Symbol"  in the top right corner of your Skype for Business client.
Then click on "Call Forwarding" and tick off "Forward my calls to": You can choose either Voice Mail, New Number or Contact or My delegates.

 Call forwarding cannot be used for team call groups. More information about team call groups can be found here.


By default, the call will be forwarded to voice mail if you are not signed in to SfB or haven't answered the call after 60 seconds. Call forwarding to voice mail cannot be disabled.

The voice mail is initially configured to NOT record any message but to ask the caller to call back later. This setting and also further ones can be changed in the Outlook Web App:

You can directly go to those voice mail settings by opening the "dialpad" tab in your SfB desktop client, clicking on the voice mail symbol and selecting "Setup Voice mail".

The Outlook Web App will open. Here you will find one preconfigured rule: CallBackLater (if you did not set up a voicemail until now, you can find instructions here).

If you deactivate the rule CallBackLater, voice recording is enabled.

You can also set further rules by clicking on the plus-button or change the order in which rules should be applied by using the arrows.

Stop call forwarding

Have a look at this learning nugget. Click on File and select the desired representation (text instructions, picture sequence or video in the right column).

You can also go to the Skype for Business options by clicking on the "gear wheel symbol", selecting "Call Forwarding" and then clicking on "Turn off call forwarding".

Set up simultaneously ring

Unlike call forwarding where your work phone doesn’t ring, you can set your incoming calls to simultaneously ring your phone and another number or contact. This setting can help ensure that callers don’t get the busy signal and their calls don’t get missed. At the same time, they won’t be aware that their call was forwarded.

  1. At the bottom of the Skype for Business window, click the "Call Forwarding drop-down", and choose "Simultaneously Ring".
  2. On the "Simultaneously Ring" peek, select:
    • New Number, to ring both your work phone and another phone number when a call comes in. Enter the new number in the Edit Phone Number dialog box when it appears.
    • Mobile Number, to ring both your work phone and your Mobile phone number when a call comes in. Enter the new number in the Edit Phone Number dialog box when it appears.

Sponsored Links


What are Sponsored Links?

Sponsored Links (also called Promoted Results) promote important information that needs to be ranked top. This can include content and links that are not stored in the BGN, Docupedia and Bosch Connect and therefore are not indexed.
Sponsored Links work like announcements and are not charged.

If a business unit has very important information that should appear at the top of the enterprise search results when searching for particular keywords, the business unit can apply for sponsored links. Creating sponsored links is a service from the Bosch department that looks after the Enterprise Search.

After defining a Sponsored Link you will find a symbol ("Hand with parcel") displayed beside your search result. This symbol helps everyone to distinguish "normal" links from sponsored links.


Example:

A new employee needs to prepare a business trip and is looking for information. The new employee uses the Enterprise Search to get more information about this topic. Typing in several keywords, a sponsored link is displayed at the top of the search result list (marked by the symbol with the parcel). The new employee clicks on the sponsored links and gets the most relevant information right away.



How to apply for sponsored links?

How to use the service to apply for sponsored links

  1. Everybody can apply for a Sponsored Link. If you wish to apply for Sponsored Links please get in touch with Operations.inside.EnterpriseSearch@bosch.com
  2. The final review and release date will be defined by the Enterprise Search Team


Required information for activation

  • Author (Department)
  • Search Term(s) - not more than 5 keywords and no universal words such as "communication"!
  • Sponsored Link URL
  • Sponsored Link Title
  • Description of Theme/Content
  • Termination Date/Permanent Activation


Example how to provide the required information


Please note:

Please do not use very common terms in the title and / or keywords.

If, for example, you have a title like 'ToolXY Docupedia' to link to the Docupedia page for your tool, this will mean that everybody who is searching for 'Docupedia' might get your link as result - and probably be disappointed! 

How to delete or modify a sponsored link?

Just get in touch with Operations.inside.EnterpriseSearch@bosch.com and let us know which sponsored link you would like to have deleted or modified. If we need further clarification, we will get in touch with you.

BGN page optimization

Are you interested in optimizing your BGN page for the Enterprise Search?
As a BGN editor, you have the possibility to influence the weighting of your BGN page by adding terms to certain text boxes.


Note: You can only edit BGN pages if the required administrative rights have been assigned to you!

Example:

If a word is used in the title and several times in the description, your BGN page will be weighted higher in the search if someone searches for this word.


Please have a look at the following page to get further information about how to optimize your BGN page.

page_name: How to optimize your BGN page

How to optimize your BGN page

How can BGN pages be optimized for the Enterprise Search? How can they be found more easily?


Please note:

You can only edit BGN pages if the required administrative rights have been assigned to you!

Even if this article contains information how to optimize BGN pages, the same principles also apply for Docupedia and other systems!


There are different ways to optimize BGN pages for your search engine via the "Edit page":

  • Title/Heading
    We recommend to choose a significant title/headline which also can be found in the text of the page, e.g.: Instead of "About BD/PWS3" a title like "Application Release Management (BD/PWS3)" should be used


  • Keywords
    The use of good keywords increases the chance to be found at the top of the hit list.
    • If keywords are entered in the fields 'Keywords' they have to be divided by commas: "Enterprise Search, Suche Wiki"
    • Department Keyword Stating your department can also lead to better results if a user is looking for information on your department in particular, e.g.: BD/WPA-WCS4, BD/WPA. It is also recommended to include former department names so users can find you after re-organization activities.


  • Description
    The page should consist of continuous text and not only of keywords. But keywords and the headline/title should again be part of the text.

Editing Mode of BGN Page



Working with Metadata

More tips to optimize your search results by using keywords

Keywords are search terms that are used to find specific information. Keywords can consist of single words or combinations of words, figures or characters. Please note when entering keywords in the metadata of a site:

  • Always use distinct terms that reflect the content of the page
  • Do not use terms that could be part of all BGN pages (e.g. BGN, Bosch, Wiki)
  • Use the 'Keywords' field to enter current or old names of your department
  • Do not use more than 5 keywords per page
  • Always separate keywords by commas
  • Do not enter the time date or the author in the 'Keywords' field as both dates are already part of the metadata


Please note:

A keyword can only be found in the search if the search engine index has been updated. The update process is done automatically during the night. 

To improve the search results for pictures the description for pictures must be entered in the 'Description' field.

FAQ

  • I stated all keywords correctly but my BGN page still can not be found when entering certain terms. What could be the reason?
    • A: The searched term may belong to a so-called "STOP" word. Please get in touch with us so that we can take care of the problem by setting up a rule.

Example:

At Bosch there is a "HIS - Hardware Information System". But the word „his“ is a so-called "STOP" word since as a pronoun it is being used in English very frequently. Accordingly the search engine either ignores such entries or it converts them. To solve this problem you are able to establish a rule which identifies such "STOP" words and because of that the term "Hardware Information System" can also be found.

  • How are the different input options weighed? Title, keywords and department keywords?
    • A: Title and keywords are weighed much higher than the other keywords.
      .
  • Are there any consequences if terms are entered twice? Will they be rated twice? If e.g. the term „Social Media“ is part of the title would it make any sense to also list it in the keywords?
    • A: Basically, a better matching of the search term and the content of the page influences the ranking enormously. The number of terms is important to the ranking mechanism.
      The term should also be stated in the keywords as they are weighed higher.
      .
  • Does the use of quotation marks (" ") have any influence on the search outcome?
    • A: No. They are ignored.
      .
  • Does upper or lower case have any influence on the search result?
    • A: No.
      .
  • Can special characters (vowels, blank spaces, underscore, streaks, brackets, etc.) be used?
    • A: Yes. But dash ('–') and underscore ('_') are handled as separating characters, that means, the compound term is separated into two non-related terms as far as the search is concerned.

Response Group Workflows

QuestionDescription/Answer
What are response group workflows?
Response group workflows are used to route a caller to the proper agents who can help him to answer his/her questions. The right agent will be determined depending on the answers/inputs of the caller gives during the interactive workflow.

In this workflow, the caller gets a question and depending on how he is answering it, the workflow will go on to the next level with a new question or directly to the appropriate queue and therefore to the right agent who can answer the call and possibly help the caller. As a consequence, a response group workflow can contain more than one queues and response groups.

It also can be configured that a response group workflow and its corresponding response groups have business hours and/or holidays. In these times it is possible to disconnect the call, forward it to a voice mail, a SIP URI or a telephone number.

To which response groups do I belong to?

So you can find out to which responsegroup you belong to:

On the Skype for Business main window, click on the arrow next to the settings ssymbol >> Tools >> Response Group Settings. Now, a browser opens and displays the page agent groups on which all groups are listed for which you act as an agent. (If you are an agent for multiple sites, a seperate page is displayed for each site). Based on a check box you can see if you are registered with a group.

Can I log on or off from response groups?

Whether you can log on or off from a response group depends on the configuration of this response group. If you click on the arrow next to the settings symbol >> Tools >> Response Group Settings, you will see all the response groups to which you are a member. If the check box on the left is greyed out, you are automatically logged in. If not, you need to log in and out by yourself.

Greyed out:

 

What should I do before I start accepting calls?

If you want to accept calls as a response group agent, you must first log on to this response group. If you want to log on to a formal group, select the check box "Registered" next to the group. (For informal groups, you are always logged on and can not disable the checking box "Registered" for this group). If groups are marked with "N/V", this means that the page "agent groups" can not be linked to the response group.

How do I accept a call?

To accept a forwarded call, click at the notification of the incoming call that apperars on the screen. If you look at the notification you can see from which response group the call is forwarded (at the top of the notification window).

 

Which information does the conversation window contain?

If you click on the call notification, a conversation window opens. At the top of the window is the name of the response group that forwarded the call to you. If the caller had the option to select options when making the connection, you will see the notes of <group name> displayed in the conversation window, along with the instructions the caller has heard, and the option the claler has selected. You can also see how long the caller had to wait until the connection to you was established.

Outlook AutoComplete list

General Information

Outlook maintains the AutoComplete list. The list is used by both, the automatic name-checking feature and the automatic completion feature. The AutoComplete list, also known as the nickname cache, is generated automatically when you send email messages from Outlook. The list contains SMTP addresses, LegacyExchangeDN entries, and displays names for people to whom you have sent a mail previously.

Please note: The AutoComplete list for Outlook is specific to Outlook and is not shared by Outlook Web App (OWA). OWA maintains its own AutoComplete list.

Limit to the number of entries

Outlook limits the number of entries that you can save in the AutoComplete list. After you reach this limit, Outlook uses an internal algorithm to determine the best names to remove from the list. It does this based on a usage weighting. Therefore, you may find some names unexpectedly removed from your nickname cache. There are two general approaches that you can use to avoid this situation:

  1. You can proactively remove AutoComplete list entries that you no longer need. This is the preferred approach. For more information about how to do this, see the section titled "How to remove AutoComplete list entries one at a time."
  2. You can increase the limit for the nickname cache. Because this configuration is untested, we do not recommend it. If you have a larger nickname cache, you could also lose a larger number of cached entries if your nickname cache becomes unusable because of corruption.

The limits are as follows:

  • Outlook M365: 1,000 entries
  • Outlook 2016: 1,000 entries

How to enable the AutoComplete feature

To access the AutoComplete setting, follow these steps: 

  1. On the File menu, click Options.
  2. Select the Mail tab.
  3. Scroll approximately halfway down until you see Send messages. Make sure that the Use Auto-Complete List to suggest names when typing in the To, Cc, and Bcc lines box is checked.


How to remove AutoComplete list entries one at a time

To remove entries from the AutoComplete cache one entry at a time, follow these steps:

  1. Open a new email message.
  2. Type the first few characters of the AutoComplete entry that you want to remove.
  3. When the entry appears in the list of suggested names, mouse over the name until it becomes highlighted, but do not click the name.
  4. When the "X" icon appears next to the highlighted name, click X to remove the name from the AutoComplete list, or press the Delete key on the keyboard.


How to clear the whole AutoComplete list

Use one of the following two methods to delete the AutoComplete list in Outlook.

Method 1

  1. Open Outlook.
  2. On the File tab, click Options.
  3. Click the Mail tab.
  4. Under Send Messages, click Empty Auto-Complete List.
  5. Click Yes.


Method 2

Start Outlook by using the /CleanAutoCompleteCache switch. To do this, follow these steps:

  1. Click Start, and then click Run.
  2. Type Outlook.exe/CleanAutoCompleteCache.

Note If Outlook is not installed in the default location, you must point to the path of Outlook.exe.

Issues with the AutoComplete cache

The AutoComplete cache can become corrupted over time and may not save new entries.

If this happens, you can try to remove individual entries from the list. To do this, follow the steps described under “How to remove AutoComplete list entries one at a time”

If that does not resolve the issue, the whole AutoComplete list can be reset. To do this, follow the steps described under "How to clear the whole AutoComplete list."

Outlook - AutoVervollständigen-Liste

Allgemeine Informationen

Outlook führt eine AutoVervollständigen-Liste. Die Liste wird für das automatische Überprüfen der Namen und die automatische Vervollständigung verwendet. Die AutoVervollständigen-Liste  wird automatisch generiert, wenn Sie E-Mails aus Outlook senden. Die Liste enthält die SMTP-Adressen, LegacyExchangeDN Einträge und Anzeigenamen für Personen, denen Sie zuvor eine E-Mail gesendet haben.

Hinweis: Die AutoVervollständigen-Listen für Outlook und die Outlook Web App (OWA) sind voneinander unabhängig. OWA verwaltet eine eigene AutoVervollständigen-Liste.

Die Anzahl der Einträge begrenzen

In der AutoVervollständigen-Liste kann Outlook nur eine beschränkte Anzahl von Einträgen speichern. Wenn dieses Limit erreicht wurde, verwendet Outlook einen internen Algorithmus und entfernt Namen aus der Liste. Damit keine Namen gelöscht werden, die Sie in der Liste behalten möchten, gibt es grundsätzlich zwei Möglichkeiten, um dies zu vermeiden:

  1. Sie können vorbeugend AutoVervollständigen-Einträge, die Sie nicht mehr benötigen, entfernen. Dies ist der bevorzugte Ansatz. Weitere Informationen hierzu finden Sie im Abschnitt "Einträge aus der AutoVervollständigen-Liste entfernen."
  2. Erhöhen Sie den Grenzwert für die Liste. Da diese Konfiguration nicht getestet wurde, wird sie nicht empfohlen.

Die Grenzwerte sind:

  • Outlook M365: 1.000 Einträge
  • Outlook 2016: 1.000 Einträge

AutoVervollständigen aktivieren

To access the AutoComplete setting, follow these steps: Gehen Sie folgendermaßen vor, um Zugriff auf die AutoVervollständigen-Einstellung:

  1. Klicken Sie im Menü Datei auf Optionen.
  2. Wählen Sie die Registerkarte E-Mail.
  3. Scrollen Sie etwa bis zur Mitte bis Nachrichten angezeigt wird. Stellen Sie sicher, dass das Kontrollkästchen AutoVervollständigen-Liste zum Vorschlagen von Zeilen An, Cc und Bcc Eingabe aktiviert ist.


Einträge aus der AutoVervollständigen-Liste entfernen

Um einzelne Einträge aus der Liste zu entfernen, gehen Sie wie folgt vor:

  1. Öffnen Sie eine neue E-Mail.
  2. Tippen Sie die ersten Buchstaben des Eintrags, den Sie entfernen möchten.
  3. Wenn der Eintrag angezeigt wird, zeigen Sie mit der Maus auf den Eintrag, sodass er hervorgehoben wird. Klicken Sie nicht auf den Namen.
  4. Wenn rechts vom EIntrag ein "X" angezeigt wird, klicken Sie darauf, um den entsprechenden Eintrag zu löschen. Alternativ können Sie auch ENTF auf Ihrer Tastatur drücken.


Gesamte AutoVervollständigen Liste löschen

Um die gesamte Liste zu löschen, gibt es 2 Vorgehensweisen:

Methode 1

  1. Öffnen Sie Outlook.
  2. Wählen Sie die Registerkarte Datei --> Optionen
  3. Klicken Sie auf die Registerkarte E-Mail.
  4. Scrollen Sie herunter bis zum MenüpunktNachrichten senden und klicken Sie AutoVervollständigen-Liste leeren.
  5. Bestätigen Sie mit OK.


Methode 2

Starten Sie Outlook mit der Option /CleanAutoCompleteCache. Gehen Sie hierzu folgendermaßen vor:

  1. Klicken Sie auf Start, und klicken Sie dann auf Ausführen.
  2. Geben Sie Outlook.exe/CleanAutoCompleteCache. 

Hinweis: Wenn Outlook nicht im Standardverzeichnis installiert ist, müssen Sie den Pfad der Outlook.exe zeigen.


Probleme mit dem AutoVervollständigen-Zwischenspeicher

Es können Probleme mit dem Zwischenspeicher auftreten, sodass neue Einträge nicht gespeichert werden.

Wenn das passiert, können Sie versuchen, einzelne Einträge wie oben beschrieben zu entfernen.

Wenn das auch nicht hilft, können Sie die gesamte Liste wie oben beschrieben löschen.

Seit der Einführung der Serverversion Exchange 2007 wurden weitere Postfachtypen für Räume und Equipment eingeführt, welche besondere Eigenschaften aufweisen. In dieser Docupedia werden alle Postfächer als "Ressourcen-Postfach" benannt.

Ressourcen in Outlook

  • Allgemeine Information
  • Erstellen von neuen Ressourcen
  • Namenskonventionen
  • Erläuertung der Raumparameter
  • Anwendungsfälle

Allgemeine Information

Was ist ein Ressourcen-Postfach?

Ein Ressourcen-Postfach ist eine Art Benutzerpostfach, an dem man sich nicht mit dem dazugehörenden Benutzernamen und Kennwort anmelden kann. Benutzer können nur den Kalender des Ressourcen-Postfaches in ihre Outlook Navigationsleiste integrieren. Seit dem Einsatz von Exchange 2007 ist ein Ressourcen-Postfach ein eigener Postfachtyp:

  • RecipientType: Room bzw. Equipment
  • RecipientTypeDetails: RoomMailbox bzw. EquipmentMailbox

Welche Vorteile bietet die Einrichtung eines Ressourcen-Postfachs?

  • Ein Ressourcen-Postfach wird bei einer Besprechungseinladung immer als Ressource gebucht
  • Anhänge werden bei einer Besprechungseinladung nicht im Kalender des Ressourcen-Postfaches gespeichert
  • Nur Betreff, Organisator sowie Buchungszeitraum einer Einladung bleibt im Kalender des Ressourcen-Postfaches erhalten
  • Doppelbuchungen sind ausgeschlossen
  • Automatische Zu- und Absagen der Ressource
  • Geringerer administrativer Aufwand für den Besitzer der Ressource
  • Voller Support von Microsoft
  • Keine Doppelbuchungen
  • Einladung über Outlook/Outlook Web App erfolgt automatisch als Ressource
  • Automatische Übernahme des Veranstaltungsortes (Raum) in der Einladung

Wie funktioniert das Ressourcen-Postfach?

Ein Ressourcen-Postfach ist ein Postfach, welches dem Anwender eine "Buchung/Reservierung" der jeweiligen Ressource ermöglicht. Die Verfügbarkeitszeit der Ressource wird angezeigt und dadurch eine einfache Planung ermöglicht. Doppelbuchungen/Reservierungen sind bei einem Ressourcen-Postfach ausgeschlossen.

Welche Berechtigungen können vergeben werden?

Es wird zwischen folgenden Berechtigungen unterschieden:

  • Buchungserlaubnis (Buchungsgruppen): Die Berechtigung ermöglicht den freigeschalteten Personen die Ressource zu buchen/reservieren.
  • Kalender-Editor (Editorgruppen): Die Berechtigung ermöglicht den freigeschalteten Personen verwaiste Buchungen/Reservierungen abzusagen.

Welche Postfächer können konvertiert werden?

Neue und bestehende Postfächer welche seither als Raum-, Ausrüstungs-, Ausstattungs-, Inventar- Postfach genutzt wurden, können vom Typ Usermailbox zu einem Typ Ressourcen-Postfach konvertiert werden. Bestehende Postfächer vom Typ Shared Mailbox können nicht umgestellt werden. In diesem Fall muss ein neues Postfach angelegt werden. Die Besitzer von Besprechungen müssen den Raum durch Umbuchung der Termine aktualisieren.

Welche Neuerungen sind im Umgang mit Kalendern zu beachten? 

Kalender-Reparatur-Agent

Microsoft hat mit Einführung der Serverversion Exchange 2010 im Jahr 2010 die Kalenderfunktionen umgestellt. Durch die Einführung des Kalender-Reparatur-Agenten konnte auch das Problem von gelöschten Kalendereinträgen durch Synchronisierungsfehler auf mobilen Endgeräten beseitigt werden.

Der Kalender-Reparatur-Agent überprüft automatisch Statusrückmeldungen bei den Organisatoren von Terminen. Gleichzeitig wird in den Kalendern der Besprechungsteilnehmer nach den entsprechenden Einträgen gesucht. SInd diese dort nicht vorhanden bzw. nicht korrekt abgesagt worden, werden sie wiederhergestellt.

Wird ein Termin nicht über die Schaltfläche "Besprechung absagen" abgesagt, sondern nur aus dem Kalender gelöscht, fügt der Kalender-Reparatur-Agent während der nächtlichen Prüfung den Termin wieder hinzu. Das kann zu Doppelbuchungen führen!

Serientermine

Es ist technisch möglich Serientermine zu buchen, obwohl Konflikte im Buchungszeitraum bestehen.D.h. wenn ein Serientermin mit 10 Terminen eingestellt werden soll, die Ressource aber in zwei Zeiträumen belegt ist, kann der Serientermin trotzdem eingestellt werden. Der Besprechungs-Organisator, erhält eine Besprechungsabsage für die beiden Konflikttermine. Eine Serie kann immer dann erfolgreich gebucht werden, wenn maximal 5 Konflikte entstehen bzw. 80% der Serie konfliktfrei buchbar sind.

Weitere Informationen finden Sie unter Raumparameter: *Conflict* - Parameter.

Neuerungen des überarbeiteten Raumprozesses

Hauptunterschied zum bisherigen Prozess: Das Anmelden an der Ressource mit Outlook / OWA ist nicht mehr möglich

Vorgehen um eine Ressource zu buchen:

  1. Erstellen Sie eine neue Besprechung.
  2. Wählen Sie über den Button "Räume" die gewünschte Ressource aus und versenden Sie die Besprechungsanfrage.

Löschen einer Besprechung:

  1. Das Löschen des Termins im Kalender ist nicht ausreichend. Um den Termin aus der Ressource und den Kalendern aller Teilnehmer zu entfernen muss dieser korrekt vom Organisator abgesagt werden.
  2. Das Löschen von Terminen durch die Sekretariate oder andere Personen ist nur noch in Ausnahmefällen möglich. Sollte der Organisator eines Termins nicht mehr erreichbar sein (z.B. da er das Unternehmen verlassen hat), kann über die eingetragene Administrationsgruppe der Termin abgesagt (ggf. gelöscht) werden.

Welche Pflichten hat der Auftraggeber?

Der Auftraggeber hat folgende Pflichten zu erfüllen:

  • Dokumentationspflicht des Ressourcen-Postfaches bzgl.
    • Buchungsgruppe
    • Editoren-Gruppe des Kalenders
    • Gruppenmitgliedschaft der Buchungsgruppe
    • Gruppenmitgliedschaft der Editoren-Gruppe
  • Pflicht zur Bereinigung eines bestehenden Ressourcen-Postfachs vor der Umstellung (ausführliche Anleitung zur Bereinigung)
    • Löschen aller E-Mails in den Ordnern
      • Posteingang
      • Gesendete Objekte
      • Entwürfe
      • Papierkorb
    • Löschen der Stellvertretungsrechte
    • Archivieren der alten Kalenderdaten über die Outlook Archiv-Funktion / Wie kann ich alte Kalenderdaten löschen ohne AutoArchiv Funktion?
    • Löschen aller Posteingangsregeln
    • Löschen einer Abwesenheitsnotiz
    • Ausschalten des MAPI-Sniffers

 Information: Die Rechte in allen Ordnern werden entfernt und auf Standard zurückgestellt. Das bedeutet, dass zukünftig keine Veränderung der Ordnerrechte zulässig ist.

Es wird keine Verwaltungsgruppe in den Postfachrechten eingetragen. Im Active Directory muss diese Gruppe (Editorgruppe) als "Universal Security Distribution Group" (USDG) angelegt sein.

In den Kalenderrechten wird die Editorgruppe mit Editor-Rechten eingetragen. Sie kann einen oder mehrere Besitzer aufweisen, die folgende Rechte haben:

  • Raumbuchungen von nicht anwesenden / ausgeschiedenen Mitarbeiter (Besprechungs-Organisator) absagen

Wichtig: Die Mitgliederanzahl wird auf maximal fünf Personen beschränkt. Das hohe Kalenderrecht zum Bearbeiten (absagen) von Terminen muss wenigen Personen vorbehalten bleiben!

Beispiel: EditorGrp R Ru 119 (FeP/TCR-Ru)

Bei zukünftigen Umbenennungen kann eine Administrationsgruppe durch den Besitzer über OWA (Outlook Web App) umbenannt werden. Der Besitzer kann zudem neue Mitglieder hinzufügen oder entfernen.

Damit die Liste durch einen Stellvertreter modifizierbar ist, kann ein weiterer Besitzers zur Editorgruppe hinzugefügt werden.

Anwendungsfälle

Terminabsage, bei anwesendem Besprechungs-Organisator

Beispiel: Das Sekretariat muss einen Zeitraum im Ressource-Kalender frei machen, um einen anderen Termin platzieren zu können. Das Sekretariat (als Mitglied der Editorgruppe) kann den Termin per Doppelklick öffnen und dann eine Absage senden.

Wichtig: Der Termin muss unbedingt abgesagt werden. Er darf nicht über den Button "Löschen" oder die <Entf>Taste gelöscht werden.

Durch die korrekte Absage wird der Besprechungs-Organisator darüber informiert, dass die Ressource (der Raum) den Termin abgesagt hat.

Aufgaben des Besprechungs-Organisators:

  • Der Besprechungs-Organisator muss sich um eine "Ersatz-Ressource" kümmern
  • Der Besprechungs-Organisator muss seinen Termin im Kalender öffnen, eine neue Ressource auswählen sowie eine Aktualisierung versenden.


Erfolgt keine Aktualisierung durch den Besprechungs-Organisator, verbleibt die ursprünglich gebuchte Ressource in den Termindaten der eingeladenen Teilnehmer.


Anleitung:

  • Raum-Ressource in Outlook öffnen: Kalender Ansicht -> Kalender öffnen -> Kalender aus dem Adressbuch hinzufügen (Calendarview -> Open Calendar -> Open Calendar from Addressbook)
  • Besprechung aus dem Raum-Kalender absagen: rechter Mausklick auf die Besprechung-> Ablehnen/Absagen -> Antwort vor dem Senden bearbeiten (Grund für die Absage eintragen)

Wird die Absage mit "keine Antwort senden" bestätigt, bekommt der Organisator der Besprechung keine Information über die Absage der Raumbuchung.

Folgende Probleme treten dadurch auf: 

  • Der Besprechungs-Organisator und die Teilnehmer bekommen kein Statusupdate über die Raumlöschung.
  • Der Raum wird beim Besprechungs-Organisator und den Teilnehmern weiterhin als gebucht angezeigt.
  • Die Raumbuchung wird über Nacht vom System-Agenten wiederhergestellt. Dadurch können Doppelbuchungen entstehen.
  • Dem Besprechungs-Organisator antworten: Eine Antwort an den Besprechungs-Organisator sollte immer vor dem Senden bearbeitet werden, damit der Organisator über die Absage der Raumbuchung mit Absagegrund umgehend per E-Mail informiert wird.
  • Der Besprechungs-Organisator erhält eine Nachricht: Der Besprechungs-Organisator wird über die Raum Absage per E-Mail informiert.
  • Raumbuchung abgesagt: Die Buchung wurde aus dem Raum entfernt. Nur der Besprechungs-Organisator erhält die Nachricht über die Raumabsage. Die Teilnehmer bekommen keine automatische Information.
  • Aktionen für den Besprechungs-Organisator: Der Besprechungs-Organisator muss die Teilnehmer informieren, ggf. einen neuen freien Raum hinzufügen und ein Statusupdate an die Teilnehmer senden.


Terminabsage, bei abwesendem Besprechungs-Organisator

Verwaiste Termine sind gebuchte Termine in Ressourcen-Kalendern, bei denen der Besprechungs-Organisator den Termin nicht absagen kann, z.B. durch folgende Gründe:

  • Besprechungsorganisator ist nicht mehr im Unternehmen
    NT-Account und Postfach wurden gelöscht
  • Der originale NT-Account und das dazu gehöhrende Postfach des Besprechungs-Organisators sind nicht mehr vorhanden
    NT-Account und Mailbox wurden versehentlich gelöscht und neu angelegt
  • Besprechungs-Organisator ist nicht erreichbar
    z.B. durch Urlaub, Krankheit, Schulungsperiode


Vorgehen: Ein Mitglied der Editorgruppe muss den Termin im Kalender per Doppelklick öffnen. Alle eingeladenen Teilnehmer die in der Terminplanungsansicht aufgeführt sind, müssen eine Absage vom Ressourcen-Kalender erhalten (siehe Anleitung unten).

Wichtig: Der Termin muss unbedingt abgesagt werden. Er darf nicht über den Button "Löschen" oder die <Entf>Taste gelöscht werden.


Erfolgt keine Aktualisierung durch ein Mitglied der Editorgruppe, verbleibt die ursprünglich gebuchte Ressource in den Termindaten der eingeladenen Teilnehmer.

Nur ein Mitglied der Editorgruppe kann einen Termin aus einem Ressource-Kalender absagen, wenn der Besprechungs-Organisator nicht mehr verfügbar ist


Anleitung:

  • Ressource in Outlook öffnen: Kalenderansicht -> Kalender öffnen -> Kalender aus dem Adressbuch hinzufügen (Calendarview -> Open Calendar -> Open Calendar from Addressbook)
  • Besprechung aus dem Ressourcen-Kalender absagen:
    • Besprechung im Ressourcen-Kalender öffnen -> Doppelklick auf die Besprechung
    • Alle Teilnehmer der Besprechung auswählen: -> Menü -> Meetings -> Scheduling Assistant -> Strg+A ->Strg+C (oder Teilnehmer -> Rechte Maus -> alle auswählen -> Strg+C]
  • Besprechung Absagen: -> Menü -> Ablehnen/Absagen -> Antwort vor dem Senden bearbeiten

Wird die Absage mit "keine Antwort senden" bestätigt, erhalten die Teilnehmer der Besprechung keine Information über die Absage der Raumbuchung und somit auch kein Statusupdate zur Ressourcen-Löschung und Terminabsage.

  • Dem Besprechungs-Organisator und allen Teilnehmern antworten:
    • Die kopierten Teilnehmer in das "An" Feld einfügen -> rechte Mautaste-> Einfügen
    • Die Antwort sollte den Grund für die Absage und folgende Information enthalten:
      • die Besprechung und die Ressourcen-Buchung existierern nicht mehr
      • Die Besprechungsteilnehmer müssen den Termin in ihren persönlichen Kalendern manuell entfernen

Termine umbuchen

Das direkte Umbuchen einer Ressource ist nicht möglich. Eine Umbuchung muss manuell vom Besprechungs-Organisator durchgeführt werden.

  • Bisherige Ressource absagen
  • Neue Ressource buchen
  • Aktualisierung an alle Teilnehmer versenden


Umstieg von öffentlichen Ordner-Kalendern auf Ressourcen-Kalender

 Die Weiterentwicklung von öffentlichen Ordnern wurde von Microsoft im Jahr 2007 eingestellt. Microsoft unterstützt nur noch Ressourcen- bzw. Raum-Postfächer für den Einsatz von gemeinsamen Kalendern.

Bei den Ressourcen gibt es folgende neue Funktionen:

  • Kalender-Reparatur-Agenten
  • Buchungsassistent
  • Kalenderautomatik (Absagen, Zusagen, andere Zeit vorschlagen)
  • Automatische Übernahme eines Raums im Feld <Besprechungsort> in der Besprechungseinladung
  • Erleichterung der Raumauswahl über das separat geführte Adressbuch

Vorab muss eine Raum-Ressource unter Beachtung der Namenskonventionen erstellt werden. Jeder Besprechungsorganisator muss die Termine im eigenen Kalender modifizieren und die neu angelegte Ressource hinzufügen.

Nachdem ein Ressourcen-Postfach erstellt wurde, müssen die Kalenderrechte im öffentlichen Ordnerbereich auf lesenden Zugriff umgestellt werden. Sind alle Termine aktualisiert, muss der Kalender im öffentlichen Ordnerbereich gelöscht werden.


Raumlisten

Raumlisten können nur zur Verfügung gestellt werden, wenn dieser Listentyp in BD-CAT administrierbar ist. Aktuell sind keine Raumlisten in BD-CAT administrierbar. Bei Bedarf, wenden Sie sich bitte an Ihren BD/CE-Kundenberater.

Raumlisten sind Listen, in denen Räume konsolidiert werden können. Sie enthalten ausschließlich Ressourcen des Typs "Raum" und helfen bei der schnellen Raumauswahl während der Erstellung einer Besprechungsanfrage.

Buchungsgruppen

Ressourcen-Postfächer werden generell so angelegt, dass diese von jedem Mitarbeiter mit einem BOSCH Corporate Postfach, gebucht werden können. Wird eine Einschränkung gewünscht, muss hierzu eine Buchungsgruppe erstellt werden. Diese Gruppe ist optional.

Es sollte darauf geachtet werden, dass verschiedene Ressourcen mit einer einzigen Buchungsgruppe gebucht werden können. Dadurch erfolgt eine Reduzierung der Gruppenanzahl sowie die Gruppenmitgliedschaften der Anwender.

Die Buchungsgruppe ist eine sogenannte "Universal Security Group" welche Mail-fähig ist. Das bedeutet, dass für diese Verteilerliste Zugriffsrechte freigeschaltet sind. Zur Vereinfachung wird die <Mail-enabled Universal Security Group> Buchungsgruppe genannt.


Erstellen der Buchungsgruppe

Benötigte Werkzeuge: Namenskonvention, BD-CAT, ITSP für die Erzeugung von Verteilerlisten

  • Nutzen sie eine bestehende Gruppe oder erstellen sie eine neue via ITSP of "Security Groups / Distribution Lists" (Verteilerliste) gemäß Namenskonvention erstellen  
  • Replikation im Active Directory abwarten (ca. 45 Minuten bis 2 Stunden, domänenabhängig) 
  • Replikation für das Offline-Adressbuch abwarten (über Nacht) 


Pflege der Buchungsgruppe

Der Besitzer einer Buchungsgruppe hat das Recht, Verteilerlisten oder einzelne Personen zur Gruppe hinzuzufügen. Personen, die in dieser Buchungsgruppe eingetragen sind, können die jeweiligen Ressource(n) buchen.

Der Besitzer der Buchungsgruppe kann die Gruppe für den Empfang von E-Mails einschränken, d.h. es kann definiert werden, wer diese Gruppe als Verteilerliste nutzen darf. So wird ein Massenversand an den gesamten Verteiler verhindert.

SMT-Auftrag zur Umstellung des Postfachs

Es ist sinnvoll alle benötigten Angaben zur Umstellung einer Ressource per E-Mail an die CI-Hotline (CI-Hotline@de.bosch.com) per E-Mail zu senden.

Wenn mehrere Ressourcen umgestellt werden sollen, können diese in einem Auftrag zusammengefasst werden. In diesem Fall muss eine Übersicht angehängt werden, um Rückfragen so gering wie möglich zu halten. Bevorzugt wird eine Übersicht im Excelformat mit untenstehenden Informationen je Ressource. 

Wichtig: Bei einer Stapelverarbeitung (Massenverarbeitung) müssen alle Angaben den Vorgaben entsprechen. Wenn ein Eintrag nicht den Vorgaben entspricht, wird der komplette Vorgang zurückgewiesen.

Benötigte Angaben für den Auftrages

  • Anzeigename der Ressource

Editorgruppe

Mit der Einführung der Editorgruppe entfällt die bisher gültige Administrationsgruppe. In dieser Docupedia wird die Kalender-Verwaltungsgruppe als Editorgruppe bezeichnet. Im Gegensatz zur Buchungsgruppe ist diese Gruppe verpflichtend anzulegen. Wird keine Editorgruppe im Auftrag angegeben, wird ein Postfach vom Typ User-Mailbox nicht zum Ressourcen-Postfach konvertiert.

Die Mitglieder der Editorgruppe sind Personen (z.B. Mitarbeiter in Sekretariaten) welche das Recht <Editor> auf den Kalender-Ordner des Ressourcen-Postfaches erhalten. Mit diesem Recht können z.B. verwaiste Termine abgesagt werden.

Eine Editorgruppe darf maximal fünf Personen umfassen. Das hohe Kalenderrecht zum Bearbeiten (Absagen) von Terminen muss wenigen Personen vorbehalten bleiben!
Mitgliedern der Editorgruppe ist es untersagt direkt im Kalender der Resource, Termine anzulegen (buchen).

Erstellen einer Editorgruppe

Benötigte Werkzeuge: Namenskonvention, BD-CAT, ITSP für die Erzeugung von Verteilerlisten

  1. Verwenden sie eine existierende "Universal Security Distribution Group" (Verteilerliste) oder erstellen sie eine neue via ITSP of “Security Groups / Distribution Lists” gemäß Namenskonvention
  2. Eintragen des Besitzers der Editorengruppe
  3. Replikation im Active Directory abwarten
  4. Replikation für das Offline-Adressbuch abwarten


Pflege der Editorgruppe

Der Besitzer der Editorgruppe hat das Recht einzelne Personen zur Gruppe hinzuzufügen. Die Bearbeitung der Mitgliedschaften sollte über OWA vorgenommen werden, um lange Replikationszeiten zu vermeiden. Die Mitglieder der Editorgruppe können im Namen des Ressourcen-Postfaches Termine absagen.

Die Editorgruppe kann die Konfiguration der Ressource nicht verändern.

Overview of Retentions

Retentions will be available in the Exchange/Outlook Mailbox. The optional retentions can be assigned by the user to custom folders or items. The mandatory retentions are assigned to the folders by the administrator. Those can be overwritten with optional retentions on single items or sub-Folders by the user.

Inheritance of Retentions

The retentions will inherited on sub-Folder and items.

  • If a mailbox item is moved from one folder to another and has an explicitly assigned a retention, the retention always takes precedence and the retention tag will not be overwritten.
  • If a mailbox item is moved from one folder to another and has not an explicitly assigned a retention, the item will inherit the retention which was applied to the folder to which it has been moved.

User can assign an optional retention to a custom Folder in Outlook 2013 or in OWA.

  1. Rightclick on the selected folder 
  2. Click on "Folder Properties"
  3. Select "Policy"
  4. Choose the required folder policy (from 1 month to 10 years


Outlook notification

If the Retention you select will cause an item to be expired immediately, you will see a warning and you can abort the Retention-enabling Job at any time. 

Replication

The replication takes 24 hours to update the folder policy including the retention and expiration information.

How does Exchange determine the expiry date?

The retention age of e-mails is calculated based on the received/sent date. 

Exclusion:

TypeRetention age
Calendaris calculated based on the end date of their last occurrence for non-recurring and recurring calendar items. (Recurring calendar items with no end date don't expire.)
Drafts / Notes

is calculated based on the date of creation.

Contact 

isn't calculated and don't expire.

Tasksis calculated based on the date of creation or on the end date of their last occurrence.
FolderRetention age
Deleted Itemsis calculated based on the received/sent date. But at first time of retention Policy activation, it stamps E-Mails in "deleted items" folder with the current retention enabling date as start date for the expiration. Unfortunately outlook in Cache Mode doesn't knows about this behavior. The real expiration date will be shown in OWA. 

What happens with expired items?

The expired items are displayed with the notification 'This item has expired' in the Outlook reading pane. In Outlook Web App e-mails have the remark 'This item will expire in 0 days'. The expired items will be deleted within the next 24 hours. The user can to recover expired e-mails from the "recoverable items folder" during the recovery period of 14 days. → Details


Why can I still see expired items in my mailbox?

There are several possible reasons

  1. The item has expired only recently. Exchange is checking every mailbox once a day to delete expired items.
  2. Your local Outlook Cache file (OST file) might be corrupt If the item is no longer available in OWA but still shown in Outlook, your OST file is corrupt. Please re-create your OST file.


Can I add the Retention and expiry date to the eMail list view in Outlook?

No, in Outlook there is no option to show the Retention or Expiry information in the eMail list view. The effective Retention and the expiry date are displayed in the reading pane. 


Please do not mistake the following columns with retention and expiration date!

Column name

Properties
EXPIRES ("Läuft ab")Flag for deadline. Deadline was set by sender via delivery options.
DUE DATE ("Fällig am")Flag for tasks and follow up.


How can I remove optional Retentions?

To remove an optional Retention from a folder or from an item, simply choose "use folder policy ..." or "use parent folder policy" from the list.


What is the difference between Optional and Mandatory Retentions?

Users can only assign optional retentions to folders which have been created by the user or to items. Mandatory retentions are applied to all mailboxes by Exchange Administrators.

Optional Retentions:

  • An optional retention allows the users to determine how long an item should be retained. The user can assign an optional retention to custom folders and individual items.

Mandatory Retentions: 

  • Mandatory retention are applied by the Exchange Administrators. The user cannot change the retention applied to a default folder.
  • Mandatory retentions can be applied on default folders, such as the folder "Conversation History".
  • Mandatory retentions can be applied to the whole mailbox, such as the "Delete Voicemail..." - Retention.
  • Due to inheritance a mandatory retention applies to untagged items. This means user can assign an optional retention to the items and overwrite settings.


What is a "self-created/custom folder"?

A "custom folder" is a folder in the mailbox created by the user.

A "Non-custom folder" is a "default folder", see "Default Folder" below.

What is a "default folder"?

A "default folder" is a "Non-custom folder". The default folders have been created in the mailbox automatically. Examples for non-custom folders (names might be different depending on user's language settings):

  • Mailbox Root folder (Top of Information Store)
  • Inbox
  • Calendar
  • Deleted Items
  • Drafts
  • Sent Items
  • Junk E-mail
  • Journal
  • Notes
  • Outbox
  • RSS Feeds
  • Sync Issues
  • Tasks

Conversation History -> The Folder is created by Microsft Skype for Business and is treated as a special folder.
Although the mandatory retention on the Conversation History folder can be changed by the user, but the change will not applied and reset to the default setting over the next 24 hours.
Furthermore only partial Retention Information are displayed in the reading pane. That means for the items that will expire in a timeframe greater than 30 days, the retention information is not displayed.
