Webcast duration

Please avoid streaming long webcast on Bosch Tube. We have seen multiple issues once a single webcasts reaches multiple hours, especially when you try to edit (cut, trim etc.) the recording afterwards. Please note that we are limited in supporting those issues!
If you have a whole day event, please stop the stream during brakes. Best is to setup multiple webcasts, one for e.g. each topic / session or to make use of the Archive function between sessions.

Besides the technical reasons and issues with long webcast recordings users are more likely to view shorter “brain snacks” regarding specific topics and they can be arranged in a channel playlist together for such an event.

How can I add subtitles aka captions to my videos?

Type in the captions yourself

Please note: Only the video owner and co-editors can add subtitles

Basic subtitlesAdvanced functions (HTML knowledge required)
  1. Download the Sample file. There you can add the subtitles for respective time sections
  2. Open the Sample file with notepad (use Notepad++ for a better view ) - ensure that the encoding is set to "UTF-8" (ANSI format might lead to problems with special characters)
  3. Define the start and end time in the following format hh:mm:ss,ms
  4. Unnecessary time sections can be deleted or extended for further entries
  5. Save the changes as a new *.srt file once you have completed your subtitles
    Note: Make sure that the document type remains (*.srt and not *.txt)
  6. Select the video that you want to edit on Bosch Tube
  7. Click on Actions and then Edit
  8. Select Captions from the menu bar and click on Upload captions file
  9. Upload your *.srt file that you have saved in step 5, assign the language and label (abbreviation that appears for the language of the subtitle).
  10. Click on Save
  11. Repeat the steps from the beginning for further subtitles in various languages

Hint: ä,ö,ü cannot be displayed with this format. If you need this, please use the advanced functions (on the right).

  1. Download the advanced sample file. There you can add the subtitles for respective time sections
  2. Open the advanced sample file with notepad (use Notepad++ for a better view ) - ensure that the encoding is set to "UTF-8" (ANSI format might lead to problems with special characters)
  3. Define the start and end times in the following format hh:mm:ss.ms within the div style tag
  4. Unnecessary time sections can be deleted or extended for further entries
  5. Style can be changed – only recommended for people with advanced html knowledge
  6. Save the changes as a new *.dfxp file once you have completed your subtitles
    Note: Make sure that the document type remains (*.dfxp and not *.txt)
  7. Select the video you want to edit on Bosch Tube
  8. Click on Actions and then Edit
  9. Select Captions from the menu bar and click on Upload captions file
  10. Upload your *.dfxp file that you have saved in step 6, assign the language and label (abbreviation that appears for the language of the subtitle).
  11. Click on Save
  12. Repeat the steps from the beginning for further subtitles in various languages

Creating a new Bosch Tube Group
  1. Click here to open the order form Security Groups / Distribution Lists via the ITSP (or use the backup link)

  2. Click on Order for Self

    Select an OptionSelect New Security Group/Distribution List
    Master of Role (MoR)

    Type in the MoR of your / the using department.

    Security Group Name

    This is the technical name of the group. It always needs to follow this pattern:

    Location_BusinessUnit_tube_name

    Location and Business Unit will be filled out automatically.

    In the blank space, please type in

    tube_YourIndividualName

    Please do not use any more symbols or blanks ( _ - ; & etc.) after "tube_"

    This "Location_BusinessUnit_tube_name" later serves as the identifier in Bosch Tube.

    Purpose of Security Group

    Please type in, why you need this Distribution List in Bosch Tube.

    e.g. New management group in Bosch Tube

    Option 1: Do not tick the box (leave it blank)

    Option 2: Tick the box (yes, enable it)

    If you enable the email for your group, a distribution list will be created in Outlook / Exchange so that emails can be sent to that group. If you enable email, you can use this group as "Owner" for your entries or channels as well as for giving e.g. access to a channel like in Option 1.

    IMPORTANT STEP YOU NEED TO DO:

    Select Delegate

    Here you can select a delegate for the MoR: The administration of access requests may be delegated from the Master of Role to one or more responsibles.

    Add Users

    Add Groups

    Here you can add all relevant users to the Distribution List.

    You can either add single users (Add User) or add entire groups, e.g. a WOM Group (Add Groups).

    Note: Groups should not contain more than 5.000 members. Everything above might cause issues with using the group on Bosch Tube so we can not support it.

    Enable public cloud services

How do I find exact matches in the search?

The following special operators can be used in a free text search field in the search bar:

  • Put your search word in double Quotes ("") to get an exact match.
  • Comma (,) means or
  • Space bar means and
  • Use backslash (\) to search for a special character. E.g. to search for ! you have to enter \! in the search field.
  • Exclamation mark (!) means and not. (Note that and not is not a unary not operator. A positive search word must appear before the and phrase. See here for additional information.

Am I allowed to play videos of others in common areas (e.g. lobby screen)?

This depends on the security class of the video.

As stated in the terms and conditions, SC-0 content is by definition "public" content. Hence, it can also be published on screens in the lobby. The person who uploaded it (owner) and defined it to be SC-0 (public) is responsible to have all the rights & approvals for it. Otherwise he/she is not allowed to classify it as SC-0.
If the content is SC-1 it is by definition “internal”. In that case, publishing it on screens is not allowed, where potentially “non-Bosch” people can see it. In that case contacting the owner to get the approval is required as it depends on the individual video and where it should be shown.
Showing SC-2 or SC-3 content in public areas is always prohibited.

How many people can take part in a webcast event?

Generally, up to 25.000 concurrent users, but only when a perfect distribution is given (e.g. not all people watching the webcast are at one location, VPN might add limitations).

What is the time delay one has to consider as a presenter or moderator ?

It takes 20-30 seconds to process it and play it back to the users.

Is it necessary to install OBS in any case before I can use Webcasting ?

Yes, it is necessary. Detailed information about the required software and setup can be found in the Guides & Best Practices: Basic webcasting setup

Is a capture box necessary?

Yes, with a default laptop you need a capture box to get the video signal from the high quality camera into the computer as USB source.

Does a standard laptop have enough computing power to do Webcasting as an organizer/participant ?

Generally yes, but that depends on the age of the standard laptop, the equipment and the streamed quality (normally 1920x1080, highest resolution which can be sent out). The most important thing to consider is the network connection: always use wired connection and make sure that enough upload bandwidth is there.

What are the recommended bitrates for different resolutions to ensure high quality streams?

Detailed information can be found in the Guides & Best Practices: Encoder settings for live streaming with Bosch Tube
Hint: If you have upload bandwidth problems, you can lower the FPS and bitrate.
Note: 1920 x 1080 is the highest resolution which can be sent out, so there is no need to send a higher quality to the platform since it will be dropped then.

Why does the video quality change during playback? (Resolution)

We are offering dynamic streaming depending on the available bandwidth. The following formats will be streamed:
High:     1920 x 1080p, 3128 kbps
Mid:      (auto*) x 720p, 1828 kbps
Low:      640 x (auto*)p, 664 kbps

*the resolution depends on the source stream resolution

Can the same broadcasting be managed from 2 PCs at the same time?

Sending the video stream can only be done from 1 PC, but additional work like Q&A, slides etc. can be launched from many PCs at the same time.

Can people (anonymous) in the internet view my stream?

Yes, you can publish your webcast into the "Publish to Internet" channel. Please make sure you are using the right URL (see here) from the internet. Note: you are only allowed to publish C-SC0 content!

I have a huge delay between audio and video signal when I start streaming. What is the problem?

The streaming we create directly bundles audio and video signals in the H.264 container format. If there is a delay between audio and video, then this is also generated during the encoding. Please double-check on the local encoder settings and setup.

What can I do when OBS starts buffering (or stream is stuttering)?

This is often the case when the bandwidth is not sufficient to send the stream from the OBS to the central server.
If the problem persists, then the available bandwidth is still not sufficient. In this case the general setup for a webcast is not "ideal". In order to stream the webcast event anyway, there is a small chance of still hosting the event by reducing the bandwidth even more. This can be done in the OBS by reducing the bit rate setting for the video stream from 2500 kbps to 1500 kbps. Of course this will decrease the quality of the video stream. Do not go below 1500 kbps for the video stream.

Is it possible to embed the live stream on openSAP?

It is generally possible to embed webcasts by using the iFrame code as well as for example on Bosch Connect or BZO. However the webcast can only be display in the web view, not in openSAP-App.
If you access the openSAP page outside of Bosch, please ensure that you are connected with the company network via VPN, otherwise you will be not able to view the embed webcast on openSAP page

Why is my chat text not shown to the audience?

The chat is moderated. Any text input will be sent to a moderator first who decides what questions to be forwarded to the speaker, and to be made visible for everyone. More detailed, the moderation has technical reasons.
The moderator needs to decide whether questions by the chat participants will be forwarded to the speaker, be published for everyone, or need to be rejected. The latter might be required if the question has already been answered or if the comment seems inappropriate.

Can a second audio track be implemented?

Yes, a second audio track can be used. However, you must use a further encoder for the second audio track. Please have a look at "Multi language stream" here.

Is there a way to insert subtitles to a webcast?

Unfortunately, you cannot add subtitles to a webcast entry. You would have to import this directly into the webcast by using a mixing console.

Can videos be shown in the webcast?

On Bosch Tube there are two "channels" for a webcast. One channel contains the video, the other one contains the slides. Both channels are shown in the player together. The slides cannot be replaced by a video, as those are static images only. However, what you can do is to use the OBS to stream a local video instead of the camera. In this way you can easily get previously recorded videos into your webcast.

Can I edit and replace the video of a webcast?

Yes, this is possible after the recording was processed on the platform. To do so, click on 'Actions' and select 'Edit' or 'Launch Editor'.  

Can I cut the webcast afterwards (delete sections)?

Yes, this is possible. Open the Event Site, click on 'Actions' and on 'Launch Editor':

  1. Set the marker (blue line) with your mouse (left click) on the part that you want to cut. Do not move the yellow frame.
  2. Click on the scissors symbol.
  3. Make sure that the part you would like to cut out is now framed in yellow.
  4. Click on the recycle bin symbol to delete the part framed in yellow.
  5. If needed, you can repeat these steps as well in the middle or end of the video. This way, you can cut out any sections you would like.
  6. Click on 'Save'. This process can take some time. Please wait and do not refresh the page.
  7. Please note: You are editing the original version and the deletion of a section cannot be restored!
    If you do not want to overwrite the original, please click on 'Save Copy'.
Can slides be deleted / replaced after broadcasting?

Yes, this is possible after the recording was processed on the platform. To do so, click on 'Actions' and select 'Edit'.

Can slides be uploaded as PDF within the Webcast Studio software?

Unfortunately you cannot upload slides as PDF. You need to upload the slides as PPT / PPTX (Power Point) file format. If you only have the slides as PDF (from external speaker), you have to use the Adobe Acrobat (full version via SCCM) to convert the slides into single images (File → Export to → Image → PNG) and afterwards import the images into Power Point (one image per slide with "Insert → Photo Album → New Photo Album"). You can ask the person providing the slides to provide images instead of PDF as well so you do not need to have the Adobe  Acrobat installed.

Can I see the analytics of a webcast?

This is only possible during the live stream / webcast in the software. Please see here.
Afterwards, you can only see the number of clicks below the video on Bosch Tube.

How can I download a webcast recording from Bosch Tube?

Is it possible to stream with a second camera at another location?
  • A second camera at the same location is no problem: 2 cameras in one PC. It is not possible to have 2 cameras with 2 computers and bring it together.
  • Having two different input locations is currently not supported. We are working on that and will provide you with further information as soon as it is supported.

This user is added by the system automatically to allow the platform administrators to get an overview of ongoing and planned webcast events. Based on that info, we can better administrate the platform, plan changes and monitor the platform capacity accordingly. There is no impact for you.

What is the reason for using the PST Migration Service?

The share will be set to "writeable" if you using PST Migration Service again, by clicking the "Start service again" button. 

Start service again

If necessary, the PST Migration Service can be used again after the import has been completed.
A successfully completed migrated PST-file will not be migrated again!

PST-files

How to identify a PST-file

Check in Outlook if a PST-file is connected.

  1. Select "File" in the Outlook menu.
  2. Select the "Account Settings"-button and select "Account Settings".
  3. In the "Account Settings" window select the menu "Data Files".
  4. In the "Data Files" overview you can identify your Mailbox since it is marked as "Default". All other files may be a PST-file, too. Please check the location and the name of the files to identify whether they are a PST-file or not.

Alternative: Minimize the Mailbox root folder in the Outlook Folder view. Check if other folders are located at the same folder level like your Mailbox. Then check the data file properties → "Advanced.." button. Verify whether the file name ends up with ".pst" or not.

Not connected PSTs

Additionally check outside of Outlook if you have any not connected PST-file in other related systems like file share, portable disk...


How to open a PST-file

Check the content and identify whether your PST-file is in need for the PST Migration Service or if it can be deleted permanently.

  1. Select "File" in the Outlook menu.
  2. Select "Open & Export".
  3. Select "Open Outlook Data File".
  4. Select your *.pst data file.
  5. The PST-file is now available and added in the "Folder pane".
  6. Minimize your Mailbox root folder and scroll down to expand your PST-root folder to have a look into your PST-file data.

How to reset your PST password

The PST Migration Service cannot import password protected PST-files. Therefore you have to reset your password. Don't worry your PST-file is protected against an unauthorized access at the upload store anyway.


  1. Select "File" in the Outlook menu.


  2. Select the "Account Settings".


  3. Select "Data Files".


  4. Select the Outlook Data File (*.pst) on which you want to change the password.
    Click "Settings".


  5. Select "Change Password".


  6. Insert your old password in the "Old password" dialog box. If there is no existing password, leave this box blank.

  7. Leave the "New password" and "Verify password" boxes blank.


  8. Click "OK" to set the password.

How to disconnect a PST-file

  1. Select your PST-File in Folder tab and close / disconnect the PST-file from Outlook.
  2. Please restart your Outlook.

Process steps

1. Mailbox Order Process:

If initiator don't have any Group Mailbox or Shared Mailbox, then please order a Shared Mailbox via ITSP Order [ITSP → Order: Manage Resource Accounts ].

2. PST-Migration-Process:

If the Group Mailbox or Shared Mailbox available, then please raise a SMT Ticket. [Subject: PST import request into Group/SharedMBX]

With the SMT Ticket we will identify the Mailbox type (whether Group or Shared), so that the initiator are taking the right steps for the PST Migration. the initiator will get an upload Share especially for your Group/SharedMailbox.


Type - User Mailbox used as Group Mailbox (phase-out)

There is a limited support for this mailbox type. The PST-Migration is at your own risk, because of known restrictions, especially 500 folder limit ->  https://inside-docupedia.bosch.com/confluence/x/ipnsXw
We highly recommended to convert the mailbox to "Shared Mailbox" at first -> https://inside-docupedia.bosch.com/confluence/x/oKu4GQ . Afterwards start the PST-Migration with converted Shared Mailbox

How to import PSTs into User Mailbox used as Group Mailbox:

  1. Login with the Group Mailbox credentials (User and password) on Client or run the browser as Group Mailbox user context. 
  2. With the Group Mailbox user context start the PST Migration Service.
    • In case of no access: Please subscribe (with the Group Mailbox user context) to the PST Migration Service via ITSP self-invite Order.
  3. Now you can upload your PSTs into the Share ( please remember: Only the initiator, means the Group Mailbox user have access to the share!)
  4. The PST-files will be migrated into the Group Mailbox if the Migration Service was used in Group Mailbox user context.



Type - Shared Mailbox 

How to import PSTs into Shared Mailbox:

Prerequisites:

    • The initiator needs FullAccess Rights (SharedMailbox Information)
    • The initiator have to be completed all other PST-Migration-Service activities or not started.
  1. Please raise a SMT Ticket or call CI-Hotline when its not already been started up. [Subject: PST import request into Group/SharedMBX]
  2. The initiator will receive a confirmation via SMT Ticket about joining into PST-Migration-Service with your Shared Mailbox. (The Service is available for 2 weeks.)
  3. Start the PST-Migration-Service. The Service is like a wizard, step-by-step guide. The Service is shown as "on behalf of Shared-Mailbox", so that user/initiator can be recognized that the PST Migration service will be migrated all data into this enabled Shared Mailbox.
  4. An upload Share especially for the Shared Mailbox will be created at PST-Migration-Service - Page 2. Upload the PSTs which you want to import and complete the import - Page 4.
  5. The Shared Mailbox size will be increased automatically. 
  6. The status mail will send to Initiator Mailbox after the PST-Migration finished.

Optional: If you want to enable the PST-Migration for same SharedMailbox also for others, then click the "Exit Service" button at the Page 6 after your migration is finished. The next initiator can join into PST-Migration-Service by raise up a SMT Ticket (Resume with Step1)


Please note following procedure:

  • During the process, no other user can raise a PST import for the Shared Mailbox. because is blocked by Initiator.

The difference between PSTDisableGrow and DisablePST

  • PSTDisableGrow: → PSTs allowed to connect to Outlook. Prevents user from adding any content to PST files. 

  • DisablePST*: → PSTs blocked. Prevents users from adding PSTs into Outlook.

    • various use cases are affected:

      • personal Mailbox *.PST
      • SharePointSite *.PST (via Connect to Outlook feature in SharePoint)
      • InternetCalendar *.PST (events from Bosch Connect / SharePoint Calendar / or Internet Calendar e.g. GoogleCal)

*[The "DisablePST" status applied as soon as Mailbox migrated to M365 or ISP-ISP005-21 WBT training completed]


Migrated data can't compared with the PST

It isn’t possible to give a guidance value how big the data is after the migration compared to the PST!

Cause of many individual parameters:

  • Different logic to compress data
  • Header information increase the PST size
  • Trash and corrupted items too
  • PST Migration service run with recommended option/setting, means without Calendar/Meeting/Contact stuff! [have a look into PagebyPage → Page 4]

A self cross check is only important to verify, whether the whole PST file migrated or not.
But a self cross check for individual items not needed. Because the Migration Tool included the Microsoft logic and import all readable items.
If an item can’t be migrated, then its also not readable in the PST before!


Best practice 


We recommend the following steps before starting the PST Migration Service and import existing PST-files into your Outlook mailbox.

  • Disconnect the PST-file from Outlook.
  • Disable the Auto-Archiving features.
  • Copy your PST-files. After migration is completed then remove PST-files. 
  • Change the download slider back to the default of "6 months".

These steps prevent data inconsistencies during the PST Migration Service process. 


How to respond to requests for read receipts

Read receipts can be automatically returned or not, or you can choose what to do for each read receipt request.

How to disable Auto-Archiving

Disable the Auto-Archiving function to avoid data inconsistency.

  1. Select "File" in the Outlook menu.
  2. Select "Options" tab.
  3. Select "Advanced" tab.
  4. Select "AutoArchive Settings".
  5. Disable "Run AutoArchive every...." option.

How to close PST-files in Outlook

You can remove an Outlook data file (PST-file) from the folder pane by closing the file.

  • In the folder pane, right-click on the name of the PST-file and choose "Close Outlook PST-File".

How to handle your Cache Mode Settings

After finishing your PST Migration your offline date will increase depending on your period of offline data (means cache mode and download slider settings).

We recommended to use the period of offline data default setting of "6 months". 
How to and more details:  → General (Outlook FAQ): For what period of time may I synchronize for using Outlook in offline mode?


How to handle Calendar and contacts

Recommendation, do not import old calendar and contacts via PST Migration Service. 
If you need some calendar items or contacts then import manually.

Risks about import calendar and contacts via PST Migration Service:

  • duplicates
  • multiple calendar of the same name in your Outlook calendar view 


The default calendar isn't visible by importing multiple calendar of the same name via PST Migration Service. Please delete all the calendar with same name when you want to identify the default calendar.
Outlook knows about the default calendar and ignore your deletion. (Similar behavior if you do the same by untag all the calendar.)

How to copy PST-files

Sitting in home office the network connection can be slow.
Transmission path: If you copy PSTs from home-share to the PST-upload-share, then the PST will be transferred from home-share to PST-upload-share via slow home office network connection.

We recommended, if your network connection is slow and the PST data are large:

Error Status: Default instruction/solution

If you get this status in finished E-Mail from PST-Migration-service, then your PST-File can't be imported into your Mailbox. It can't be imported because your PST-file is damaged.
In some cases this occurs when your PST-File is connected to Outlook during your PST-upload at PST-Migration-share or your your network connection got lost during the transfer.

You have to check the PST-File status and in some cases its possible to repair the corrupted PST-File like described below:

Instruction / Solution: 

How to upload your PST-File again:

  1. Verify whether your PST-File can be opened and shown in Outlook. Means connect the original PST-file (not the copy on your PST-upload share) in Outlook:

    Option A: The PST-File can be opened:
    1. Fine. Now make sure all your PST-files are disconnected from Outlook and restart Outlook too.
    2. Your PST-File is fine and ready for upload:
        1. Use the PST-Migration-Service and click on the button "start service again" if it does not work right away.
        2. Open your PST-Migration-Service share. (If you forget the link, please use the PST-Migration-Service and click "request e-mail" to receive an e-mail with the link to your folder again)
        3. Delete all PST-files from the PST-Migration-Service share which have already been migrated successfully.
        4. Copy your PST-File at the PST-Migration-Service share and follow the PST-Migration-Service steps again to migrate the PST file.  "Complete Import" button.

    Option B: The PST-File can't be opened:
    1. Try to repair your original PST-file via ScanPST. ScanPST located:


      • in Office 2016 at "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Office\Office16\scanPST.EXE"
      • in OfficePro + at "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\scanPST.EXE"
        (More details about ScanPST → Microsoft)
      1. Repair was successfully → Connect your PST-file again and verify the content. Follow the "Option A" steps.
      2. Repair failed → All releases of your PST-File are damaged. They can't be imported and are unusable. The import is not possible and the files are lost.

Error Status: XX large items were skipped


If you get this status in finished E-Mail from PST-Migration-service, then your PST-File was imported into your Mailbox with the exclusion of items greater than 20MB.
The items greater than 20MB can be stored where you want to, except in Outlook, cause of the 20MB limitation. Outlook will deny the item when you try to add it to your mailbox.

Hint: The E-Mail size limit of 20MB for sender and recipient is already valid for numerous years.

How to search for items greater than 20MB:


  1. Open your PST-File in Outlook and open the Folder structure in Folder tab.

  2. Click the "Search Folders" to start a "New Search Folder...".

  3. In the New Search Folder box scroll down and select "Create a custom Search Folder"

  4. Click the "Choose" button and enter a name for the new search Folder.

  5. Click the "Criteria" button and go to "More Choices" tab and select the "greater than" option and enter the "20480" in size field. (means 20MB).

  6. Click all OK buttons in each dialog box.
  7. Now you will find out all your E-Mails larger than 20 MB. You can store the items where you want , excepted in Outlook.

Exception

Particular items are not searchable via advanced search, like "Tasks".

PST Migration Service

Warum gibt es einen PST Migration Service?

Durch das My Mail Management Projekt werden PST-Dateien für die Benutzer gesperrt.

Mithilfe vom PST Migration Service wird der Inhalt der PST-Dateien auf einfachem Weg in das Outlook Postfach integriert.

Shared Mailbox

Der Import in die Shared-Mailbox wird im PST Migration Service nicht bereitgestellt.

Speicherort der importierten PST-Dateien

Der PST Migration Service importiert PST-Dateien in Ihr Postfach in Ihren Stammordner (d.h. in die gleiche Ebene wie der Posteingang).

Ein PST Migration Service Ordner mit dem Namen "PST Migration Service" beinhaltet die importierten PST-Dateien automatisch.

  • Jeder Unterordner beinhaltet eine PST-Datei und ist gleich benannt wie die originale PST-Datei. (z.B. "PST0)
    • Der Unterordner ist gleich aufgebaut wie die PST-Datei. (z.B. "Posteingang")

Details zum PST Migration Share

Der PST Migration Share ist ein automatisch generierter persönlicher Share. Nur der jeweils berechtigte User hat Zugriff darauf.

Das Share ist "schreibbar", bis der Import vom Nutzer abgeschlossen wurde.
Nach klicken vom "Import abschließenen" Button (SCHRITT 4 auf der PST Migration Service Webseite) wird das Share auf "nur lesen" berechtigt. Damit der PST Migration Service die Migration der PST Dateien in Ihre Mailbox erfolgreich starten kann.

Eine Woche nach Abschluss der Migration wird der Zugang gesperrt und der Inhalt des persönlichen Migration Share wird gelöscht.

Das Share wird erst wieder auf "schreibbar" gesetzt, sobald der PST Migration Service erneut gestartet wird. Durch klicken auf den "Start service again" Button. 


PST Migration Service erneut starten

If necessary, the PST Migration Service can be used again after the import has been completed.
A successfully completed migrated PST-file will not be migrated again!
However we recommend, cause of the Mailbox Quota/Size calculation, to deleted all successfully migrated PST-files before you click on "complete import" button.

PST-Dateien

Wie erkenne ich eine PST Datei?

Überprüfen Sie in Outlook, ob eine PST-Datei eingebunden ist.

  1. Wählen Sie "Datei" im Outlook Menü aus.
  2. Wählen Sie unter "Kontoeinstellungen" erneut "Kontoeinstellungen" aus.
  3. Wählen Sie im Fenster "Kontoeinstellungen" den Reiter "Datendateien".
  4. Unter "Datendateien" können Sie das Postfach identifizieren, welches als "Standard" festgelegt ist. Alle weiteren Dateien können ebenfalls PST-Dateien sein. Überprüfen Sie den Dateispeicherort und den Dateinamen um herauszufinden, ob es sich um eine PST-Datei handelt.

Alternativ: Minimieren Sie ihren Stammordner in der Postfach Übersicht. Prüfen Sie, ob in Ihrem Postfach andere Ordner auf der gleichen Ordner Ebene vorhanden sind. Überprüfen Sie anschließend die Datei Eigenschaften → Verifizieren Sie unter "Erweitert", ob der Dateiname auf ".pst" endet.

Wie öffne ich eine PST Datei?

Überprüfen Sie den Inhalt der Dateien und ermitteln Sie, ob Ihre PST-Dateien den PST Migration Service benötigen oder ob diese dauerhaft gelöscht werden können.

  1. Wählen Sie "Datei" im Outlook Menü aus.
  2. Klicken Sie auf "Öffnen und Exportieren".
  3. Klicken Sie auf "Outlook-Datendatei öffnen".
  4. Wählen Sie Ihre *.pst Datei aus.
  5. Die PST-Datei ist nun verfügbar und wird im Ordnerbereich aufgeführt.
  6. Minimieren Sie Ihren Postfach Ordner und scrollen Sie nach unten zum PST Stammordner, um auf die PST-Dateien zuzugreifen.

Wie setze ich das PST Passwort zurück?

Passwortgeschützte PST-Dateien können nicht importiert werden. Deshalb müssen Sie Ihr Passwort zurücksetzen. Ihre PST-Dateien sind automatisch geschützt gegen unauthorisierten Zugriff im hochgeladenen Zustand.


  1. Wählen Sie "Datei" im Outlook Menü aus.


  2. Wählen Sie die "Kontoeinstellungen" aus.


  3. Wählen Sie "Datendateien" aus.


  4. Wählen Sie die Datei (.pst) aus, für die Sie das Passwort ändern möchten.
    Wählen Sie "Einstellungen" aus.


  5. Wählen Sie "Kennwort ändern".


  6. Geben Sie nun Ihr altes Passwort in das Dialogfeld "Altes Kennwort" ein (existierte noch kein Passwort, dann leer lassen).
  7. Lassen Sie die Dialogboxen "Neues Kennwort" und "Kennwort bestätigen" frei.


  8. Klicken Sie "Ok" um die Einstellungen zu speichern.

PST-Dateien abkoppeln

  1. Wählen Sie Ihre PST-Datei im Ordner aus und trennen Sie die PST-Datei von Outlook.
  2. Bitte starten Sie Outlook neu.

Shared PST-Dateien

Shared PST-Dateien sind PST-Dateien, welche von mehreren Nutzern in Outlook genutzt werden.

Falls eine shared PST-Datei genutzt wird, importieren Sie bitte die E-Mail Dateien der shared PST-Datei in ihre shared Mailbox. Der PST Migration Service unterstützt keine shared PST-Dateien oder Shared-Mailboxen.

Unterschied zwischen PSTDisableGrow und DisablePST

  • PSTDisableGrow: → PSTs können mit Outlook verbunden werden. Verhindert, dass Nutzer Inhalte zur PST-Datei hinzufügen.

  • DisablePST: → PSTs sind gesperrt. Verhindert, dass Nutzer PST-Dateien in Outlook hinzufügen.

  • folgende Anwendungsfälle sind davon betroffen:
    • personal Mailbox *.PST
    • SharePointSite *.PST (via Connect to Outlook feature in SharePoint)
    • InternetCalendar *.PST (events from Bosch Connect / SharePoint Calendar / or Internet Calendar e.g. GoogleCal)



Best practice

Wir empfehlen folgende Schritte, bevor Sie vorhandene PST-Dateien in Ihr Outlook-Postfach integrieren.

  • Trennen Sie vorab die PST-Datei von Outlook.
  • Deaktivieren Sie die Autoarchivierungsfunktion in Ihre PST-Dateien.
  • Kopieren Sie die PST-Datei. Nach der Migration löschen Sie Ihre PST-Datei.
  • Setzen Sie den Download Reiter zurück auf die Standardeinstellung "6 Monate".

Diese Schritte verhindern die Dateninkonsistenz nach dem PST-Import.


Anfragen nach Lesebestätigung

Lesebestätigungen können entweder automatisch gesendet werden oder nicht. Sie können für jede Anfrage auf Lesebestätigung wählen, ob Sie eine Bestätigung senden oder nicht.

Automatische Archivierung deaktivieren

Deaktivieren Sie die Autoarchivierungsfunktion um Dateninkonsistenz zu vermeiden.

  1. Wählen Sie "Datei" im Outlook Menü.
  2. Wählen Sie den Reiter "Optionen" aus.
  3. Wählen Sie den Reiter "Erweitert" aus.
  4. Wählen Sie unter "AutoArchivierung" die "Einstellungen für AutoArchivierung..." aus.
  5. Wählen Sie das Kästchen "AutoArchivierung alle..." mit der entsprechenden Anzahl an Tagen aus.


PST-Dateien in Outlook schließen

Sie können eine PST-Datei aus Outlook entfernen indem Sie diese im Ordnerbereich schließen.

  • Im Outlook Ordnerbereich: Rechtsklick auf den Name der PST-Datei und "Outlook-PST-Datei schließen" auwählen.


Cache-Modus Einstellungen

Nach Abschluss der PST-Migration erhöht sich Ihr Cache in Abhängigkeit von den Einstellungen des Download-Reiters im Cache Modus. Wir empfehlen, die Voreinstellung von "6 Monate" zu wählen.

weitere Details:  → General (Outlook FAQ): Wie viele Monate darf ich für den Betrieb im Offline-Modus synchronisieren?


Kalender und Kontakte importieren

Empfehlung: Keine alten Kalender und Kontakte mit dem PST Migration Service importieren. 
Importieren Sie ggf. manuell einzelne Kalender und Kontakte ohne den PST Migration Service.

Risiken durch den Import von Kalender und Kontakten mit dem PST Migration Service:

  • doppelte Einträge
  • mehrere gleichnamige Kalender in der Outlook Kalender Ansicht 

Ihr Standard Kalender ist nicht mehr auf den ersten Blick erkennbar. Um den Standard Kalender dennoch zu identifizieren, löschen Sie alle Kalender. Der Standard Kalender wird dabei  von Outlook automatisch erkannt und nicht gelöscht. (Gleiches gilt auch, wenn Sie lediglich den "Hacken" vom Kalender entfernen.) 

Fehlermeldungen

PST-Migration-Service - Finished E-Mail

In some cases the PST-Migration-service can't be imported the PST-files into your Mailbox. To fix the issue, follow the instructions of the applicable error messages below:

  • Error Status: PST-Datei ist beschädigt und kann nicht gelesen werden
  • Error Status: Named properties property context is null
  • Error Status: Couldn't read the folder hierarchy for .pst file ...
  • Error Status: XX große Dateien wurden übersprungen
  • Error Status: Cannot process argument transformation on parameter FilePath


Error Status: PST-Datei ist beschädigt und kann nicht gelesen werden

Error Status: Named properties property context is null

Error Status: Couldn't read the folder hierarchy for .pst file ...


Wenn Sie diesen Status in der fertigen E-mail vom PST Migration Service erhalten, kann Ihre PST-Datei nicht in Ihr Postfach importiert werden. Dies liegt daran, dass die PST-Datei beschädigt ist. In einigen Fällen tritt dies aus, wenn Ihre PST-Datei während Ihres PST-Uploads auf den PST Migration Share mit Outlook verbunden ist, oder wenn Ihre Netzwerkverbindung während der Übertragung verloren gegangen ist.

Sie müssen daher Ihre PST-Datei wie folgt prüfen. In einigen Fällen kann die PST-Datei wieder repariert werden:

Anweisung / Lösung:

Die PST-Datei hochladen:

  1. Überprüfen Sie ob Ihre PST-Dateien geöffnet und in Outlook angezeigt werden können. Dabei müssen Sie die original PST-Datei (nicht die Kopie auf dem PST-Upload-Share) im Outlook einbinden.
     
    1. Option A: Die PST-Datei kann geöffnet werden:
      1. Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Ihre PST-Dateien von Outlook getrennt sind und starten Sie Outlook neu.
      2. Ihre PST-Datei ist in Ordnung und bereit zum Upload:
        1. Use the PST-Migration-Service and click on the button "start service again" if it does not work right away.
        2. Open your PST-Migration-Service share. (If you forget the link, please use the PST-Migration-Service and click "request e-mail" to receive an e-mail with the link to your folder again)
        3. Delete all PST-files from the PST-Migration-Service share which have already been migrated successfully.
        4. Copy your PST-File at the PST-Migration-Service share and follow the PST-Migration-Service steps again to migrate the PST file.  "Complete Import" button.

    2. Option B: Die PST-Datei kann nicht geöffnet werden:
      Try to repair your original PST-file via ScanPST. ScanPST located:
          1. in Office 2016 at "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Office\Office16\scanPST.EXE"
          2. in OfficePro + at "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\scanPST.EXE"
            (More details about ScanPST → Microsoft)
      2. Repair was successfully → Connect your PST-file again and verify the content. Follow the "Option A" steps.
      3. Repair failed → Alle Versionen Ihrer PST-Datei sind beschädigt und können nicht importiert oder genutzt werden. Diese Daten können nicht importiert werden und sind verloren.


Error Status: XX große Dateien wurden übersprungen

Wenn Sie diese Meldung erhalten, wurde Ihre PST-Datei in Ihr Postfach importiert mit Ausnahme von Sendungen größer als 20MB.

Alle Elemente, welche die 20MB Größe überschreiten, können aufgrund der 20MB Beschränkung nur außerhalb von Outlook gespeichert werden. Outlook wird Elemente über 20MB ablehnen, wenn Sie versuchen, diese in Ihr Postfach aufzunehmen.

Hint: Bei Bosch ist die E-Mail Größe schon langjährig auf 20MB beschränkt.

Wie Sie nach Dateien suchen, welche 20MB überschreiten
  1. Öffnen Sie die PST-Datei in Outlook in der Ordnerstruktur auf der linken Seite.
  2. Mit Rechtsklick auf "Suchordner" klicken Sie auf "Sie Klicken Sie "Neuer Suchordner".
  3. Scrollen Sie nach unten und wählen Sie "Benutzerdefinierten Suchordner erstellen" aus.
  4. Klicken Sie auf "Auswählen" und geben Sie einen Namen für den neuen Suchordner ein.
  5. Klicken Sie auf "Kriterien" und anschließend auf "Weitere Optionen". Wählen Sie im unteren Bereich im Dropdown Menü "Größe (Kilobyte)" das Feld "größer als" an. Ins nächste Feld geben Sie 20480 ein (bedeutet 20MB).
  6. Klicken Sie auf "Ok" in jedem Dialog-Fenster.
  7. Nun werden Ihnen alle E-Mails größer als 20MB angezeigt. Diese können Sie an einem beliebigen Ort speichern, nur nicht in Outlook.

Exception

Einige Elemente können mit dieser erweiterten Suche nicht gesucht und gefunden werden, z.B. "Aufgaben" in Outlook.


Error Status: Cannot process argument transformation on parameter FilePath


If you get this status in finished E-Mail from PST-Migration-service, then your PST-File can't be imported into your Mailbox. 
It can't be imported because your PST-file has an not an acceptable path or Filename.
Please use an shorter Filename or eliminate the ~ symbol.

  1. Use the PST-Migration-Service and click on the button "start service again" if it does not work right away.
  2. Open your PST-Migration-Service share. (If you forget the link, please use the PST-Migration-Service and click "request e-mail" to receive an e-mail with the link to your folder again)
  3. Rename all PST-files from the PST-Migration-Service share which has an unreadable filename and eliminate the ~ .
  4. Copy your PST-File at the PST-Migration-Service share and follow the PST-Migration-Service steps again to migrate the PST file.  "Complete Import" button


E-Mail Warnung - 48 GB Begrenzung - Offline Outlook Dateien (.ost) Größenbegrenzung erreicht

Die empfohlene maximale Größe einer .ost-Datei beträgt 50GB.
weitere Informationen: → Welche Limitierungen seitens Microsoft existieren?

Möglicherweise müssen Sie die Größe der .ost-Datei reduzieren, indem Sie die Standardeinstellung für den Cache-Modus verwenden.
Ändern Sie Ihren Download Reiter auf die Standardoption "6 Monate".
weitere Informationen: → Wieviele Monate darf ich für den Betrieb im Offline-Modus synchronisieren?

E-Mail Warnung - 99 GB Begrenzung - Postfachgrößenbegrenzung erreicht

Mailbox size limit is 99 GB. If you need more than you have to create an additional SharedMailbox. Ask your IT-Partner about creation and handling.

Auto-Archivierung:

  • Beim Archivieren ist ein Fehler aufgetreten. Suchen Sie nach einem detaillierten Bericht im Ordner Gelöschte Objekte"

harmon.ie (E)

harmon.ie is an Outlook plug-in for SharePoint on premises and SharePoint Online.

This documentation is only an overview of the most important information. The used links are partly links to the harmon.ie documentation (external links).

The harmon.ie Outlook plug-in will be upgraded from Version 8.0.1.4430 To version 9.3.5.

The Upgrade will start from End of March on. This documentation will be updated step by step. Until the completion of the upgrade, the screenshots in this documentation can be different to your harmon.ie installation.





Main features

Drag, drop, share

    • Simply drag e-mail attachments or entire e-mail messages to publish them on SharePoint.

Folder and file path length restrictions

Please keep the restrictions of SharePoint regarding folder and file path length in mind.

The SharePoint file name will be built from the subject of the e-mail.  If this name will violate the restrictions, the upload from Outlook to SharePoint will end in an error.


    • Share documents/list items easily. Add document/item links to your e-mail message, calendar appointment or task.
    • Replace attachments with links and send e-mail, in one step. When you send a message with an attachment, harmon.ie asks if you want to publish the document and send a link instead.

Find documents/items easily from Outlook

    • Locate a document/item using back/forward navigation, history, and favorites, as in a web browser.
    • Search the contents of documents/items in your current SharePoint Site or library

Work on SharePoint documents

    • Right click to check out and edit a document. When you are done making edits, check in your changes.
    • Edit document properties, directly from Outlook. When you are finished, harmon.ie reminds you to check in your changes. If your company uses required document properties, harmon.ie prompts you to fill them in when uploading your documents.
    • Approve documents, view the document history, and more.


To launch harmon.ie

To launch harmon.ie and display the harmon.ie sidebar, open Microsoft Outlook and click the harmon.ie toolbar button. Clicking the button again hides the sidebar.

Note: If the sidebar was open when you last closed Outlook, the sidebar opens automatically with Outlook.

The harmon.ie sidebar can also be accessed in an e-mail message, meeting and appointment. To show the sidebar, click the Show Sidebar button in any of these items.


To add a SharePoint on premises Site

To add the SharePoint Site(s) you want to access from Outlook:

  1. In the SharePoint Documents sidebar, click Add Site (+) in the SharePoint Sites' drop-down list. The Add SharePoint Site dialog opens.
  2. Enter the URL (Internet address) of the SharePoint Site you want to add.
  3. Specify credentials for connecting to the Site.
  4. Click the Test Connection button to ensure you have a valid connection.

You can now start working with the product. For more information, read Adding and editing SharePoint Sites.


To add a SharePoint Online Site

To add the SharePoint Site(s) you want to access from Outlook:

  1. In the SharePoint Documents sidebar, click Add Site (+) in the SharePoint Sites' drop-down list. The Add SharePoint Site dialog opens.
  2. Enter the URL (Internet address) of the SharePoint Site you want to add.
  3. Specify credentials for connecting to the Site. Use the browser authentication!
  4. Click the Test Connection button to ensure you have a valid connection.


To find SharePoint content

Once you add a SharePoint Site to the application, you can use the harmon.ie sidebar to find a SharePoint location, document, list or list item.



  • Use the sidebar's document list to navigate the document libraries, folders, lists, documents, and items of the added SharePoint Sites.
  • Use the navigation history to quickly navigate back and forth between visited locations.
  • Add a location/list to your Favorites list and then quickly navigate to it using the Favorites drop-down button.
  • Use the search icon to search for content in the added SharePoint Sites.

For more information, read Finding SharePoint documents.


To work with SharePoint documents


You can use the harmon.ie toolbar to create, upload, edit, and delete documents on SharePoint.

  • Right-clicking a SharePoint document opens a context menu that gives you access to common SharePoint operations. You can use this menu to copy documents and links to e-mail messages, meetings, contacts, and to your computer; share documents; check in and check out documents; view version history and document properties; publish and approve documents; etc.
  • You can download documents to your computer, and work on local copies.
    You can also synchronize document libraries on your computer so you can work on documents when you are offline.

For more information, read Working with documents.


SharePoint and e-mail

Integrating e-mail and SharePoint is easily accomplished using harmon.ie:

  • Drag e-mail messages and attachments to the harmon.ie sidebar to publish them on SharePoint. If your company uses required fields, harmon.ie automatically prompts you to fill them in.
  • Drag-and-drop one or more SharePoint Sites, libraries, lists or documents/items to your e-mail message, calendar appointment or task to create a link to them. Hold the Alt key while dragging and dropping a SharePoint document to create an actual attachment.
  • Automatically share OneDrive and Microsoft 365 team Sites documents with your SharePoint recipients when sending an e-mail message.
  • Use the harmon.ie ribbon button to replace attachments with links and send e-mail, in one step.
  • Use the harmon.ie ribbon button to save incoming and outgoing e-mail messages to SharePoint.

By using harmon.ie for Outlook, Enterprise Edition, you will get additional features when saving e-mail on SharePoint. Message headers will be automatically converted to SharePoint document properties.

For more information about e-mail in harmon.ie, read the help topic Working with e-mail.

View the e-mails in the SharePoint Site

Create a view to visible the e-mails in the Site.

It is not possible to create such a view in a SharePoint online site, because SharePoint Online does not own the necessary columns.

Main features

Drag, drop, share

    • Simply drag e-mail attachments or entire e-mail messages to publish them on SharePoint.

Folder and file path length restrictions

Please keep the restrictions of SharePoint regarding folder and file path length in mind.

The SharePoint file name will be built from the subject of the e-mail.  If this name will violate the restrictions, the upload from Outlook to SharePoint will end in an error.


    • Share documents/list items easily. Add document/item links to your e-mail message, calendar appointment or task.
    • Replace attachments with links and send e-mail, in one step. When you send a message with an attachment, harmon.ie asks if you want to publish the document and send a link instead.

Find documents/items easily from Outlook

    • Locate a document/item using back/forward navigation, history, and favorites, as in a web browser.
    • Search the contents of documents/items in your current SharePoint Site or library

Work on SharePoint documents

    • Right click to check out and edit a document. When you are done making edits, check in your changes.
    • Edit document properties, directly from Outlook. When you are finished, harmon.ie reminds you to check in your changes. If your company uses required document properties, harmon.ie prompts you to fill them in when uploading your documents.
    • Approve documents, view the document history, and more.


To launch harmon.ie

To launch harmon.ie and display the harmon.ie sidebar, open Microsoft Outlook and click the harmon.ie toolbar button. Clicking the button again hides the sidebar.

Note: If the sidebar was open when you last closed Outlook, the sidebar opens automatically with Outlook.

The harmon.ie sidebar can also be accessed in an e-mail message, meeting and appointment. To show the sidebar, click the Show Sidebar button in any of these items.


To add a SharePoint on premises Site

To add the SharePoint Site(s) you want to access from Outlook:

  1. In the SharePoint Documents sidebar, click Add Site (+) in the SharePoint Sites' drop-down list. The Add SharePoint Site dialog opens.
  2. Enter the URL (Internet address) of the SharePoint Site you want to add.
  3. Specify credentials for connecting to the Site.
  4. Click the Test Connection button to ensure you have a valid connection.

You can now start working with the product. For more information, read Adding and editing SharePoint Sites.


To add a SharePoint Online Site

To add the SharePoint Site(s) you want to access from Outlook:

  1. In the SharePoint Documents sidebar, click Add Site (+) in the SharePoint Sites' drop-down list. The Add SharePoint Site dialog opens.
  2. Enter the URL (Internet address) of the SharePoint Site you want to add.
  3. Specify credentials for connecting to the Site. Use the browser authentication!
  4. Click the Test Connection button to ensure you have a valid connection.


To find SharePoint content

Once you add a SharePoint Site to the application, you can use the harmon.ie sidebar to find a SharePoint location, document, list or list item.



  • Use the sidebar's document list to navigate the document libraries, folders, lists, documents, and items of the added SharePoint Sites.
  • Use the navigation history to quickly navigate back and forth between visited locations.
  • Add a location/list to your Favorites list and then quickly navigate to it using the Favorites drop-down button.
  • Use the search icon to search for content in the added SharePoint Sites.

For more information, read Finding SharePoint documents.


To work with SharePoint documents


You can use the harmon.ie toolbar to create, upload, edit, and delete documents on SharePoint.

  • Right-clicking a SharePoint document opens a context menu that gives you access to common SharePoint operations. You can use this menu to copy documents and links to e-mail messages, meetings, contacts, and to your computer; share documents; check in and check out documents; view version history and document properties; publish and approve documents; etc.
  • You can download documents to your computer, and work on local copies.
    You can also synchronize document libraries on your computer so you can work on documents when you are offline.

For more information, read Working with documents.


SharePoint and e-mail

Integrating e-mail and SharePoint is easily accomplished using harmon.ie:

  • Drag e-mail messages and attachments to the harmon.ie sidebar to publish them on SharePoint. If your company uses required fields, harmon.ie automatically prompts you to fill them in.
  • Drag-and-drop one or more SharePoint Sites, libraries, lists or documents/items to your e-mail message, calendar appointment or task to create a link to them. Hold the Alt key while dragging and dropping a SharePoint document to create an actual attachment.
  • Automatically share OneDrive and Microsoft 365 team Sites documents with your SharePoint recipients when sending an e-mail message.
  • Use the harmon.ie ribbon button to replace attachments with links and send e-mail, in one step.
  • Use the harmon.ie ribbon button to save incoming and outgoing e-mail messages to SharePoint.

By using harmon.ie for Outlook, Enterprise Edition, you will get additional features when saving e-mail on SharePoint. Message headers will be automatically converted to SharePoint document properties.

For more information about e-mail in harmon.ie, read the help topic Working with e-mail.

View the e-mails in the SharePoint Site

It is not possible to create such a view in a SharePoint online site, because SharePoint Online does not own the necessary columns.

OpenDXM Use Cases

Data can be exchanged with OpenDXM either

  • manually (Interactive File Transfer) or

  • automatically (Automated File Transfer)

Sending Data to Business Partners

With OpenDXM, you can send data to your business partners (both internal and external) either

  • interactively (Interactive file transfers)

    or

  • automatically (Automated File Transfer)


Interactive file transfers are those file transfer activities that a large majority of our company's employees normally engage in.
The sender uploads the data via OpenDXM to one or multiple recipients (eihter internal users or external business partners).


Automated file transfers: OpenDXM is able to forward your files and make them available for download to your business partner(s). (See here for further details.)


There is an automatic e-mail notification system to alert users of data transfers – both incoming and outgoing.


Examples

  • Bosch employees of the marketing department send raw footage of videos to an external studio for further editing or review.
  • Bosch employees send large CAD files to their counterpart working with Bosch OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer).
  • Project "KBWS": To protect Bosch from potential Know-How leakage to the competitors, the decision has been taken to set up the engineering environment based on the new 3D-VDI external cloud workplace solution. VDI-Clients (triggered via SmartTeam) provide files via OpenDXM to business partners.
  • Different Project Teams within Bosch send data automatically to Porsche  e.g. Project related MS Office data or project related failure analysis/data (exported/imported from IBM Rational TeamConcert/ClearQuest/ClearCase)
  • Unidirectional Difference-zip file transfer to 30 business partners. Small OpenDXM-Transferclient-tool provided to customer. Transferclient creates diff-zips based on a big source directory (50 GB of size). Transferclient provides diff-zip files to partners via OpenDXM.


Preconditions for sending data

Both sender and recipient require OpenDXM Access.  You can find Information on Requesting OpenDXM access here.

In case of automated transfers, please contact OpenDXM Team



Receiving Data from Business Partners

With OpenDXM, you can receive data from your business partners (both internal and external) either

  • interactively

    or

  • automatically


To receive files, a file transfer must be initiated on the business partner's side.

The recipients are notified by email that data is available to be downloaded via their OpenDXM account.

There are the following options for the external partner to send data to the Bosch Group:

  • Via EDI (OFTP) 

If the external business partner is connected to Bosch via EDI (OFTP), they can send data to recipients at Bosch.
Precondition
The reciepients (Bosch users) require OpenDXM access, and they have to be registered as contacts in the business parter's  data exchange system.
The external parners have to be registered as contacts in OpenDXM. (See example: Data Exchange with Daimler)


  • Interactive via OpenDXM

External business partner can access OpenDXM interactively via browser and send data to any Bosch user registered in OpenDXM.
Precondition:
Both sender and recipient require OpenDXM Access.  You can find Information on Requesting OpenDXM access here.


  • Automated transfer

    • Via SFTP (using Bosch SFTP server)
      Precondition: The external parners have to be registered as contacts in OpenDXM.

    • Or: via API interface (REST)
      To consider:
      • This has to be set up at the external partner's side first
      • The setup usually takes longer than 1 week - depending on how the business partner's IT is structured.
      • Precondition:
        • Both sender and recipient require OpenDXM Access.  You can find Information on Requesting OpenDXM access here.

In case of automated transfers, please contact OpenDXM Team.

Automated further processing of the received data

If required, the received data can be stored on a network drive  (further details see here)


Examples

  • Bosch employees receive large CAD files from their counterpart working with Bosch OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer).
  • Employees of the university in Karlsruhe carried out a simulation during a publicly funded project and sent 700 GB to Bosch.
  • Vehicle fleets of JLR (Jaguar / Landrover) send measurement data to Bosch via SFTP (100 - 400 GB per day) 
  • Volvotruck sends data to Bosch via SFTP (6-8 TB per week → Data Transfer Rate: 100-120 Mbit/s)

Overview

If so and you’d like to find out more about the automated file transfer use cases of OpenDXM, please don’t hesitate to contact us on OpenDXM Team.

"Benutzer weiterhin gültig...". Warum diese Email?

Nach dem Versand an meinen externen Datenaustauschpartner, erhalte ich folgende Email:



Normalerweise werde ich über das Passwort meines Datenaustauschpartners informiert.

Was ist des Hintergrund?


Hintergrund:

Das ist das erwartete Verhalten der Applikation, wenn Benutzerkonten/Accounts von Datenaustauschpartnern bereits existieren und noch gültig sind, und Sie diesen währenddessen Daten zuschicken.
Accounts von Datenaustauschpartnern haben eine Gültigkeit von 7 Tagen. Während dieser Zeit wird kein neuer Account angelegt, sondern der bestehende weiterverwendet.
Sollten Sie also die o.g. Email erhalten, dann müsste der Datenaustauschpartner über seine Accountdaten bereits informiert worden sein (durch Sie oder einen anderen Bosch Sender).

Dieses Feature stellt (aus der Perspektive der Datenaustauschpartner) die beste Lösung dar.
Die Alternative wäre gewesen bei jedem Datenaustauschvorgang neue Accounts zu generieren. Stellen Sie sich nun vor, dass Ihre Datenaustauschpartner auch von anderen Bosch Sendern adressiert würden. Als Ergebnis würden alle beteiligte Datenaustauschpartner (auch Sie) jegliche Übersicht hinsichtlich Gültigkeit und Aktualität von zu verwendenden Benutzernamen und Passworte verlieren.

page_name: "Account still valid..." e-mail: Why do I get this?
html_content:
"Account still valid..." e-mail: Why do I get this?

After having sent file(s) to my external business partner, I get following mail:


I usually get business partners password.
Why do I get this e-mail instead?


Solution:

This is the intended behaviour of the application while accounts of business partners are still valid and you send them files .
Please remember: Accounts of business partners are valid for 7 days. During this time no new credentials (new user name and password) are generated. Instead, the due date of valid accounts of business partners is extended for another 7 days.

You did not send any file(s) to the business partner before or the last 7 days?
=> So it is very likely, that another Bosch user has sent files to the affected business partner!

Be assured, that the business partner has been already informed about their user name, and the Bosch sender, who initiated the account generation (for the business partner), has forwarded the password to the business partner accordingly.
=> The business partner should use the user name and password they used the last time:

  • user name: The business partner finds the user name in the e-mail notification with the subject “Account created...”  (automatically sent by the application)
  • password: Either the business partner has received their password via voice message, or the Bosch sender (who initiated the account creation) has already forwarded the password to the partner

Ask your business partner to check this.

This behaviour is the best solution from the perspective of business partners.
The alternative behaviour (not really an option....) would be that the application creates new accounts (new user name + password) for each file transfer: Imagine several Bosch users sending files to the same business partner.... . The business partner as well Bosch senders would get many "Account created..."-mails, and they would be "lost in accounts" and confused (which one to use/forward....)! This alternative scenario is not really an option.

page_name: Benefits of OpenDXM for the user
html_content:
Benefits of OpenDXM for the user

Exchanging data with OpenDXM has significant benefits for the users, as they don't have to worry about file size or file formats limitations, security, traceability, reliability, performance, tracking and compliance, all of which will be handled in the background by the OpenDXM server.


Standard Data Exchange Solution@Bosch

  • As part of digital workplace, OpenDXM is a preferred solution for exchanging data within Bosch and with external business partners worldwide
  • It is approved by SC-ITE (Steering Committee IT in Engineering) as the preferred solution within Engineering
  • It is recommended by the IT Security Department, see Blog


Compliant with all currently valid regulations (e.g. AIM, GDPR, Export Control,…)


Easy and convenient:

  • Easy to use - No training required
  • No client installation required (web based application → All you need is a browser)
  • Access and usage via a WAM (Web Access Management) link

  • Addressing of multiple recipients within one upload transfer task


No limitations:

  • No file size limit (So far 350GB have been successfully transferred within one task!)
  • Support of all file types


Conform to Bosch-Norm:

  • Browsers: Microsoft Edger or Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox

  • Permanent further development according to RB IT rules

  • User registration through the central Identity Management System (IdM)

  • A preferred solution in digital workplace
  • Approved by SC-ITE as the preferred solution within Engineering (SC-ITE → Steering Committee-Information Technology Engineering)

  • Recommended by the IT Security Department, see Blog

Traceability (important in case of legal issues, e.g. product liability):

  • Monitoring and documentation of data exchange tasks (logging and inquiry functionalities)
    Metadata is stored for over 10 years
  • Automatically generated email notifications to sender and recipient

 

File transfer/Connections:

  • Connection of external partners either via WAM (e.g. suppliers without any data exchange system) or via standard interfaces (Odette: e.g. Daimler, BMW, PSA, John Deere…) 
  • Support of automotive standards (ENGDAT, OFTP, OFTP2) according to VDA 4951 
  • Support of FTP standards (SFTP, FTPS)
  • Support of various transmission paths (ENX, Internet)
  • Support of various interfaces (REST, Web Services,...)

 

Additional Features:

  • Setting substitutes via special IdM roles/groups

  • Automated provisioning of users and roles from IdM via web services

  • Optional routing of exchanged files into specific division file shares according to requirements of the division 
  • Coupling of systems for automated file transfers
  • Automated transfer of files directly from windows explorer

 

Security:

  • SSL/TLS encryption (https)
  • Data security classes C-SC0 to C-SC3 are supported
  • Automatic check of incoming data by a virus scanner
  • Access via Web Access Management System (WAM)
  • Unique UserID and password for every user (WAM credentials)
  • Annual penetration tests of OpenDXM by security companies

  • Authorization concept specified by data exchange coordinators of divisions

Why can't I modify my Inbox-Rules?

The main problem is, that a rule which is created with Outlook on a Windows Client can't be checked, read and opened by the Outlook for Mac Client.

To solve the issue, follow the steps below.

  1. The error message that appears:
    1. Click on <OK>
    2. Select the Exchange entry and click again on your mailbox
  2. The rules wizard will now read the rules inside your mailbox. This need a short time.
  3. You will see then all available rules.

    Information: The rules which have a grey Check-Box are client based rules from the Windows client and they did not work with Outlook for Mac.

    Click on each rule, which have a blue Check-Box.

  4. If a rule has a question mark in the conditions, this rule is corrupt and did not work on Outlook for Mac.
    In this example, the text "KMS Pilot System" is not correct and not an possible E-Mail-Address or entry from the global address book at BOSCH.
    1. Remove the wrong text and add a correct conditions. (E.q. E-Mail-Address or a valid entry from the address book)
    2. Click on OK if you modified the conditions.

  5. If all rules with "bad" conditions are modified, press save to finish the wizard.
  6. The rules wizard will open correct in future.

Important: When the rule wizard did not open the rules (always pop up with the message <Rules could not be saved because there is an error in the rules.>) you has to logon to your mailbox via Outlook Web App (OWA) and repair the rule(s) in OWA.
Link to OWA: https://rb-owa.de.bosch.com/owa


Why can't I modify the retention Policies in Outlook?

With the Outlook for Mac App V16.63 (22070801) it is only possible to get the retention policy information on an received email.

To see the retention policy information, the customer has to use the <New Outlook> feature.

Screenshot from the retention policy information of a received email.

Currently, there is no way to change the retention policy inside the Outlook for Mac App on manual created folders. This has to be done inside OWA.

Enhanced PowerPoint presenting (PowerPoint Live)

Microsoft will offer a bundle of functionalities, to enhance PowerPoint presenting via Microsoft Teams.

#1 New Layout: Share Content


#2 Presenter View

Presenter View gives you all the tools to present confidently. The view you see as the presenter is yours only - review notes, engage in chats, and see your audience - all in one panel view. This private view allows the presenter to see everything in one place while the audience sees only the active slide. For example, view a slide, and next to it your slide notes - so your talking points are never far away. Using the thumbnail strip, you can see what slides are coming next and jump to one. The grid view enables you to easily find your place in a large presentation.  


#3 Seamless transition between presenters

If you have co-presenters, they can seamlessly “take control” and instantly get access to the #2 Presenter View as well. Control can also be easily shared between any number of presenters, so no more fumbling during the presentation to give control to someone else, or worse, asking someone to move to the next slide for you.


#4 Custom layout (rolling out now)

Custom layouts allow a more dynamic content viewing experience and enable presenters to customize how content shows up for participants during a meeting:

  • Standout, shows your video feed as a silhouette in front of the shared content.
  • Reporter places content as a visual aid above your shoulder just like a news story.
  • Side-by-side displays your video feed next to your content. Presenter mode will be available soon.


#5 Interactive presentations

It’s just as important for audiences to feel engaged and included during a presentation. Often, people in the audience have different needs - some want to be able to see what’s ahead, while others need to refer to the previous slides or change the view to high contrast view so they can see better. With interactive presentations, we want to ensure that you have the right tools to interact, engage, and follow along in a way that fits your needs.


#6 Translate Slides (open, coming soon)


#7 Annotations in PowerPoint Live

The presenter is able to annotate a PPT Live Presentation or use a laser pointer when presenting.

Presenters can now pin an individual video feed for all attendees to see during a Microsoft Teams meeting. Once pinned, the individual identified as the spotlight will be the main video shown to all participants. This applies to PC, Mac, mobile (view only) and Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows.Bosch / BSH

Meeting organizers and presenters can now prevent attendees from unmuting during the meeting and enable specific attendees to unmute when they raise their hands. This can be helpful for press conferences and classrooms scenarios where you want to be in control of who’s speaking.

Organizers can jump in between meetings on their own—or when requested by a participant—, provide announcements to the individual rooms, and recall everyone back to the meeting at any time. Any collaboration and coauthoring done during the breakout can be shared back to the larger meeting once everyone is back together.

How to remove the Public Telephony Service as Bulk?


This article is outdated and currently in rework. 


If you want to delete/remove a bulk of Public Telephony services you need to perform the following steps:
