page_name: Create and Manage a Team (Team Room Owners)
html_content:
Create and Manage a Team (Team Room Owners)



🔎 TIP: Use Ctrl + F to find the content you are searching for on this site.

💬 If you do not find the answers here, see here how to get support.

This page provides information for team room owners. For general information on how to work within your team as a team member, please refer to Work with Teams.


PLAN

1. Idea

I'm thinking about creating a team room. What should I consider?

We recommend to consider the following questions:

  • Why do I need this team?
  • How do my colleagues / project team members perceive "collaboration"?
  • Do we have a long-term or short-term project? Creating a teams room is only adequate when you are aiming at long-term communication, see What is the difference between a team and a group chat in Teams?
  • Do we have many documents that we need to work on together? Then a team room can be very useful.


Does creating a team result in any additional costs?

Creating a team room itself has no additional costs, but every team room has its attached SharePoint Online site in the background and these sites are charged per data volume stored on a monthly basis by the SharePoint Online team.

For further information please refer to the following Docupedia page. You can also check a blogpost on Bosch Connect site. SharePoint Online: what is the cost of the used storage space? - News Blog - Digital Workplace (bosch.com)


2. Design

What can help me design a first idea?

Please ask yourself the following three questions:

  • Goals: Why do I need the team room?
  • Target group: Who should be part of the Microsoft Teams room?
  • Outcome: What should change?

For better visualization, have a look at this "Target Triangle":

This method is very sustainable, as you can clearly define what should change once you set-up a new Microsoft Teams room.


What is the difference between a public, private and a shared team room?

When thinking about the team room, decide whether you want your team room to be public, private or shared (check the difference here).

  • Private - Only team owners can add members
  • Public - Anyone in your organization can join
  • Shared - For collaborating with people inside and outside your team or organization*. Note, that this kind of channel is only needed in special collaboration scenarios – check out this use case.



Important

NOTE 

When changing a Teams room to public, the group “Everyone without external users” is automatically added to the Members of the respective SharePoint Site. Please remove this group on site level immediately, because Everyone with EDIT access is not allowed at Bosch. This is a separate access right in SharePoint and it will not affect the access rights of your public Teams room.

  1. Go to your team room SharePoint
  2. Click on Settings → Site permissions

      3. Change permissions in Site members - limited control section

You can find a documentation on how to remove the Everyone access in the chapter Oversharing here.





CREATE

3. Creation

How can I create a team room?
  1. A team room needs to be ordered via the IT Service Portal. To do so, click here.
    If the link doesn't work, go to the ITSP and search for "Microsoft Team Room + SharePoint Online Site Creation"
    ⚪ For BSH, the direct link to the order form might not work correctly. Go to the ITSP (use Chrome or Edge) > sign-in with your Bosch account > search for "Microsoft Team room + SharePoint Online site creation" > click on order. Please use Cost Center as 873000.
  2. Fill in your information.
  3. Click on submit. Your team will be created within 3 hours after Master of Role (MoR) approval.

 Please note, that it is obligatory that every team has at least 2 OWNERS to ensure consistency in case of your absence.

To assign the second owner:

  1. Go to your team
  2. Click on the three dots
  3. Click on Manage team
  4. Click on the member you want to appoint as an owner
  5. Select Owner in the drop-down menu


How should I name a new team?

Usually teams are created in two different ways:

  • If work is structured like the organizational structure use the organizational name (BU, department,...), e.g. "Peer Group XY"
  • Another way is to create a team for a special group of people who need to work together for a special topic or project, e.g. "Bots at Bosch"

Hint: It is not possible to use special characters (~ # % & * { } + / \ : < > ? | ' " ..) for your team name.


Can I rename a team after creation?

Yes, an owner can rename a team at any time.


Can I assign custom access rights to different channels?

You can create a Private Channel.

However, please make sure to read and understand the Limitations of a Private Channel.

All other "regular" channels are visible to everyone that is part of the team room. There is no possibility to block single users (e.g. from other GBs / regions / countries / etc.)


What is included when ordering a team?

The following things are included:

  • Team chat
  • Channels → the channel "General" is included by default and cannot be removed
  • SharePoint Online for file storage (1TB)
  • An owner and member permission group
  • Default Wikipage (we recommend to delete this and use OneNote instead)
  • Default OneNote
  • App integrations


How much does it cost?

Creating a team automatically involves creating SharePoint online, which is paid and its costs are specified here.



4. Set-up

CHECKLIST: What are the first steps after I created a team?

When your team room creation has been successful, you will receive a confirmation e-mail and your team will automatically appear in your Microsoft Teams client.

You can follow this checklist to start off:

Structure your team by creating meaningful channels and tabs.

Add your colleagues to your team room. For easier onboarding, you can use WOM Groups.
Define a second owner as your deputy for your team room. Every team room should have at least two owners.
Add a logo to your team room.
Move all communication, collaboration and documents to your team room:
  1. Store your documents in the team room (SC3 & data from externals are not allowed). The documents are automatically stored in SharePoint online in the background.
  2. Pin most used documents and files
  3. Sharing your thoughts, structure, and ideas with your colleagues is crucial: Explain your structure and invite for an alignment-call

As team room owner you are responsible for your team room. Please share common DOs and DON'Ts with your team and and encourage everyone to participate in the relevant trainings.

For further information on managing your team, click here.


How should I structure / organize a new team?

Basically you have 3 levels of structure in Microsoft Teams: The team itself, the different channels within the team, and tabs within a channel (or chat).

Channels are are a kind of sub-group of a team to give your team more structure. Similar to folders in SharePoint or a file share, they help you to cluster and organize your team room according to topics.
You can create up to 200 channels to separate your communication and collaboration in different focus topics. Permissions are the same for a team and its channels.


Hints

  Make sure to think of adequate names for your channel in advance. While you can still rename the channel in Microsoft Teams any time, the names of the SharePoint Online folders of every channel will keep their original name.

Use meaningful icons when naming your channels:

Don't create too many private channels: You will lose interaction and transparency.


Tabs are used to structure each channel.

When clicking on the + Symbol, you can add tabs such as a Website, OneNote, Excel,...


Hints

Keep the structure as simple as possible. Replace the tab "Wiki" with your teams' OneNote.

Keep the name of a tab short. This way, none of the tabs are hidden automatically.

Don't create too many tabs, as they will be grouped automatically and be hidden, based on the screen size. Rather think of 2-4 meaningful tabs everybody can work with.

Instead, you can use a SharePoint site or a PDF as a linke collection


How can I add others to my team?

Please note:

  • Make sure that all members you are inviting to a team room have already installed Microsoft Teams.
  • Hint: Users should not download the Microsoft Teams app from the link provided in the automatically sent email from Microsoft. Although you can access and download the app with your Bosch account, you will have problems logging in and the application will also have issues updating in future.  

  

You have several options:

  1. Click on the three dots next to your team
  2. Click on Manage team
  3. In the tab Members, you can see an overview of owners, members, and guests.
    Click on the button Add member to add one or more members.
  4. Once you have added the members, you can use the dropdown menu next to the members to change their roles: Owner / Member / Guest
    You can use the Search for members search bar, to find members quicker
    You can also onboard a whole distribution list to your team (see next question WOM Group)
  1. Click on the three dots next to your team
  2. Click on Get link to team
  3. Now you can send out the link via e-mail.
    1. If your team is private, only team owners can add members. The person with the link can then send a request to join the team. All team owners will get a notification to either accept or deny the request.
    2. If your team is public, anyone in your organization can join automatically, without a request.
  1. Click on the three dots next to your team
  2. Click on Manage team
  3. Click on the tab Settings
  4. Click on Team code.
  5. Click on Generate. This code serves as a "direct key" to your team: Share this code so people can join the team directly - you won't get join requests
  6. Then you have the possibilitiy to
    1. View the code in full screen: Helpful if you are in a meeting room with many people and you just want everyone to join the team directly.
    2. Reset or Remove the code: Please do so after your people have joined the team. Otherwise, this code will always serve as a key to join directly. It is like a key to your house laying around - make sure to reset it after you've used it!
    3. Copy the code: To send it out to others, e.g. via chat, e-mail, etc.



WOM Group: Can I onboard / add a whole distribution list to my team?

Yes, you can use WOM groups (Worldwide Organization Management).

Just do the same procedure as when adding a single member to your team:

  1. Click on the three dots next to your team
  2. Click on Add member
  3. Instead of typing a name, type in the name of your organizational distribution list (WOM group), e.g. BD/CBV


WOM Group: What are the limitations?
  • WOM group ≠ Outlook distribution list: The WOM group is not equal to every distribution list you find in Outlook. WOM groups are organizational distribution lists. If you create e.g. an own distribution list like "Project XY", you will not be able to add this list to your team. Adding Outlook distribution lists will be avaialbe sometime later.
  • Non-dynamic: If the WOM group changes after you have staffed your team room, the membership of your team does not sync automatically. You will have to up-date new members manually - up-dates are non-dynamic! This sounds inconvenient at first, but think of it as if you would write an e-mail to a distribution list: Once you have clicked on "send", the e-mail is sent to exactly those members who have been in the distribution list at that point in time. When you change the distribution list 4 weeks later, the new members do not receive the first e-mail you sent earlier. The same applies to WOM groups - thay can simplify the onboarding process, but are not a dynamic tool to track and up-date your team room.
  • Private Channel & Group Chat: The usage of WOM groups in private channels and group chats is not supported.
  • Maximum 10.000 members: Please keep in mind that a team room cannot exceed 10.000 members. This is a restriction by Microsoft.
  • Removing members: You cannot remove members of a team by using a WOM group. Once onboarded, the WOM list is expanded (similar to expanding an Outlook distribution list). Once expanded, Teams will replace the WOM group list with its members. You will not be able to collapse it again. To remove members from your team room, you need to delete every single one.
  • Microsoft Teams Users: If the WOM group comprises members that are not using Microsoft 365 yet, naturally, they cannot be onboarded to the teams room. Only colleagues who are using Microsoft Teams can be onboarded to your Teams room.


How many members can be added to a Microsoft Teams room?

You can find the current numbers here: Limits and specifications

Please note that Microsoft has blocked teams/channel @mentions for teams with over 25,000 members.


Will all links to files stored in the SharePoint still work after renaming the team?

Yes, this is ensured.


Why is a master of role (MoR) needed when I order a new team?

To be AIM compliant, it is necessary to involve the master of data in the ordering process.

The MoR is responsible for the data and must be an organizational office. Please enter a valid organizational office name. A single user ID is therefore not possible. Only a single organizational office will be accepted. Example: XY/ABC1.

Please keep in mind that the assignment of access rights must always be needs-based and in accordance with the minimum principle. If you are the MoR of a Microsoft Teams room with an integrated SharePoint Online site, it is therefore essential to regularly check the access rights granted and remove them if they are no longer required.

Attention: As things stand today, access management controls can only be carried out by site owners with the standard functions provided by SharePoint Online. Click here for more information.


How can I change the master of role (MoR)?

You can do it via THIS order form (SharePoint Site – New on premises / Change on premises and Online) by naming Access Right Owner.


  1. In the Select Action window you have to choose Change Site
  2. Copy the Site URL from the browser
  3. Here you can change not only Access Right Owner, but also Sensitive Data and Cost Center


Roles in a team

Every member in Teams has a role, and each one has different permissions. 

Owners: Team owners manage certain settings for the team. They add and remove members, add guests, change team settings, and handle administrative tasks. There can be multiple owners in a team.

Members: Members are the people in the team. They talk with other team members in conversations. They can view and usually upload and change files. They also do the usual sorts of collaboration that the team owners have permitted.

Guests: Guests are people from outside of your organization that a team owner invites, such as partners or consultants to join the team. Guests have fewer capabilities than team members or team owners, but there's still a lot they can do.

The following table shows the capabilities available for each role:

Capability

Owner

Member

Guest

Create a channel

Participate in a private chat

Participate in a channel conversation

Share a channel file

Share a chat file


Add apps (such as tabs, bots, or connectors)


Can be invited via any work or school account for Microsoft 365



Create a team


Delete or edit posted messages

Discover and join public teams


View org chart


Add or remove members and guests



Edit or delete a team



Set team permissions for channels, tabs, and connectors



Change the team picture



Add guests to a team



Auto-show channels for the whole team



Control @[team name] mentions



Allow @channel or @[channel name] mentions



Allow usage of emoji, GIFs, and memes



Renew a team



Archive or restore a team



NOTE Shared channel owner and member roles in Microsoft Teams - Microsoft Support


How to manage team settings and permissions

If you’re a team owner, you're in control of many settings and permissions of your team. 

  1. Go to the team name, and select More options (...) → Manage team.
  2. In the Settings tab, check or uncheck the options or permissions that you want to use about member permissions, but also guest permissions, mentions or tags.

     


MANAGE

5. Go-Live

What should I consider when going live?

We recommend to invite everyone in your team for an alignment-call and define the rules how you want to work together:

  1. Explain that all communication and collaboration (documents) is now moved to Teams.
    Hint: Whenever someone accidentally uses the 'old systems' like Skype for Business or e-mails, please lead the conversation back to the team room.
  2. Explain the purpose of your team to all members and define the rules / how you want to work together with everyone. It is helpful to provide answers to the questions you have asked yourself in the planning-phase.
  3. Share common DOs and DON'Ts with your team and and encourage everyone to participate in the relevant trainings.

Now, bring in your team and let the collaboration begin!

 

6. Working Mode

How can I see the activities in my team / channel?

With channel-based analytics, you can easily see the analytics of each team and channel. You can see things like the number of users, posts, replies, storage used, and how many apps are used. To get access to the analytics:

  1. Click on the three dots next to a team
  2. Click on Manage team
  3. Click on Analytics

Active user: Measures the number of unique users who perform an action in Microsoft Teams during the specified date range.

Active channel: Measures the number of channels of a team in which users perform an action during the specified date range.

 

Is it possible to merge two team rooms into one?

Unfortunatley, this is not possible.


7. Restructuring

What points do I need to check on a regular basis?

Please consider these questions for your team on a regular basis

  • Is the team still used for the purpose it was created for?
  • Do you need further / less channels for specific topics?
  • Is the information posted relevant for all members?

 

 



CLOSE

8. Closing

What should I do when a team is not needed anymore?

The team can be archived and deleted by one owner:

Delete: When you decide to delete a team, all relevant team items will be deleted. The items are:

  • Team chat
  • SharePoint for file storage
  • An owner and member permission group
  • Default Wikipage
  • Default OneNote
  • App integrations

Freze: In this case the chat and all team activities are frozen. For all your members / guests, the team will disappear in the Microsoft Teams client of the participant.
This is not an "archiving" in the sense of the CD 02981. If you have further questions, please contact your local DSO.

  1. Click on the gear wheel on the bottom left
  2. Click on the three dots next to the team you want to archive
  3. Click on Archive team

This will freeze all your team activity but you and the team owners will still be able to view and un-freeze it.

You can un-freeze your team anytime.


More information can be found on this Microsoft Page.


How to restore a deleted team room

The Master of Role (MoR) can restore a team room within 30 days after deletion.

  1. As the MoR, raise a ticket at the IT Service Desk: 📞 Call 3311 or 📧 write an e-mail to ITServiceDesk@bosch.com
  2. In the ticket, please state the name of the deleted team room and when it was deleted – if this information is known.
  3. Please note that the restoration can take up to 24 hours after the IT ticket was processed.
  4. After successful restoration, the team should appear again in your teams list and all existing content within the tabs, including channels and conversations will be restored as well.

FAQ - SMR

TIP:
Use Ctrl + F to find the content you are searching for on this site.

Didn't find an answer here?
Please feel free to ask us in the SMR Forum.



Question - General

Answer
Where can I find information about Smart Meeting Rooms (SMR)?
Primary source for users to get informed about Smart Meeting Room is in the Docupedia: https://bos.ch/SMR
It explains how to use Smart Meeting Rooms.
It describes what to do before the meeting to book the room via eRoom, when users walk into the room to Enter the meeting explaining the use of the devices and what they can do During the meeting.
Further material that can be shared with the user is the MTR flyer and the FAQ
Which type of SMR are available?

Currently there are SMR bundles for focus rooms, functional offices, mid-sized, large and project rooms. Focus rooms and functional offices are non-bookable, mid-sized, large and project rooms need to be booked.

How can I make a reservation in an SMR?

You can book an SMR via the eRoom plugin in Outlook.

Why is it not possible to find a room in the eRoom application in my location?

Potential cause: Due to missing permission

Resolution: Please ask your local UCC-SR or the eRoom team (Gruppenbriefkasten eRoom BD/PWS2: <Gruppenbriefkasten.eRoom@de.bosch.com>) for providing the corresponding permission.

How can I include a Skype or Teams meeting in my SMR reservation?

You can add a new Skype or Teams meeting to your invitation in Outlook.

Do I need to check-in when entering the meeting room?

This depends or your local policies. If check-in is enforced, you need to check in within 15 minutes after the beginning of the meeting.

Why is Screen Sharing via Miracast not possible?
  1. Focus rooms and functional offices: The miracast adapter is not working or defective => In this case create a ticket as the local UCC-SR has to check this onsite.
  2. You are probably in a mid-sized or large meeting room with a MTR. In these rooms there are no miracast adapters. Screen sharing is working via Teams or Skype meeting (disabled audio on your laptop). Alternatively you can use the HDMI IN cable.

Question - SMR Focus rooms

Answer

How can I share my screen on the front display in an SMR focus room?

You can connect your Windows laptop via wireless display. Press Win+K to find the correct display that has the name of your current room. More information on the wireless presenting (Miracast) feature can be found here.

How can I include remote participants in an SMR focus room?

You need to connect the speakerphone to your laptop via USB.

After connecting the speakerphone, you need to start the Skype or Teams meeting on your laptop.

How can I switch on the display in an SMR focus room?

The display needs to be switched on using the remote control in the room.

 Please don't remove any remote control (or other components) from the room and contact the IT Service Desk instead.

What to do if speakerphone has not been detected or bad audio quality is observed?

Potential cause: USB-cable was connected after the Skype/Teams meeting was joined or display was detected as speaker

Resolution: Check used microphone and speaker in Skype/Teams. Both should be the speakerphone. Restart Skype/Teams and join the meeting again.

What to do if display shows wrong source or remains black?

Potential causes:

  • Display power was unplugged?
  • Remote control ran out of battery?
  • If using an HDMI cables, has it been disconnected?
  • If using Miracast, has it been removed or is unavailable?

Resolution: Use remote control to switch to HDMI 1 for Miracast (wireless display) or HDMI 2 for cabled connection. Restart PC if HDMI signal of the PC is not detected.

Question - SMR Midsized and Large rooms

Answers
How can I switch on the table device, displays and camera?

When the infrared-sensor of the table device (underneath its display) detects movement, the device will automatically wake up. Display and camera will be automatically switched on with no user interaction needed.

What shall I do if the table device does not wake up when I walk in front the of the device?

Potential cause: The infrared-sensor only responds to movement in front of the table device display. The sensor could be obstructed by objects standing in front of the device or the delivery protective film has not been removed from the sensor.

Resolution: Turn the display facing in your direction, remove potential obstacles and remove the protective film of the sensor, if it's still attached.

How can I join the meeting that has been included in the Outlook invitation?

If you've booked the room via eRoom and a Skype or Teams meeting is part of that invitation, the meeting name will appear on the table device and you can click on the "Join" button to join the meeting.

What shall I do if I don't see the meeting name on the table device display?

Potential cause: The room has not been selected in the eRoom booking or another room was selected by mistake.

Resolutions: Join the meeting on your laptop without audio and video. Then add the conference room name as participant. You can see the room name (e.g. "R Fe 710 J2.02 Conference Device") displayed on the front display and on the table device.

What shall I do if I see the meeting name on the table device display, but no "Join" button?

Potential cause: Either the invitation has not been created with a Skype or Teams meeting or the meeting information have been copied from another meeting invitation (e.g. the invitation of another person).

Resolution: Join the meeting on your laptop without audio and video. Then add the conference room name as participant. You can see the room name (e.g. "R Fe 710 J2.02 Conference Device") displayed on the front display and on the table device.

How can I join a meeting that I've already joined on my Bosch-laptop?

Make sure that you've joined the meeting without audio and video. Then add the conference room name as participant. You can see the room name (e.g. "R Fe 710 J2.02 Conference Device") displayed on the front display and on the table device.

Which meeting platforms can I use in SMRs?

You can use the Bosch meeting platforms Microsoft Skype and Teams.

How can I change the front screen layout to display content-only?

Select the display layout button on the table device. You can find it in the bottom menu bar. Please note that the button might not be available when no meeting is ongoing.

How can I mute the microphones?

Select the microphone button on the table display. You can find it in the bottom menu bar. Please note that the button might not be available when no meeting is ongoing. You will observe the red ring of light which indicates your muted microphone. Reactivate the microphone by clicking on the same microphone button.

How can I modify the volume of the speakers?

Select the speaker button on the table display. You can find it in the bottom menu bar. Please note that the button might not be available when no meeting is ongoing.

How can I disable the camera?

Select the camera button on the table device to disable the camera. Your camera window on the front screen will disappear and the camera itself will move into downward-facing parking position. Reactivate the camera by clicking on the same camera button.

How can I change the position of the camera?

The camera is always having a total view of the entire room. It is not zooming to a particular person or spot. Speaker-detection has been disabled to avoid irritation and issues.

Where can I find the remote control for the camera?

SMR is designed to provide a single interaction point. As the table device controls all connected devices, no dedicated remote control is available.

Where can I find the remote control for the display?

SMR is designed to provide a single interaction point. As the table device controls all connected devices, no dedicated remote control is available. If the display remains black for several minutes even after the table device was automatically activated, please contact the IT Service Desk.

How can I add other participants to my meeting?

During an ongoing meeting, you can use the search bar to search for names of the Bosch associates that you'd like to add to your meeting. After confirming the selection, they will be called to join the meeting.

How can I share my screen on the front display in an SMR mid-sized or large room to remote and local participants?
If a Skype or Teams meeting is ongoing, you can use your laptop, join the Skype or Teams meeting without audio and video and use the screen sharing feature. Alternatively, you can use the HDMI-cable on the table.
How can I share my screen on the front display in an SMR midsized or large room to local participants?

If you only like to present to a local audience and no Skype or Teams meeting is used, please use the HDMI-cable on the table.

How can I avoid audio feedback loops (loud beeping noise)?

Whenever you join a Skype or Teams meeting on your laptop and want to have audio and video provided by the room, you need to join on your laptop without audio (both microphone and speaker disabled).

How can I switch on the display in an SMR midsized or large room?

You need to move in front of the table devices which has an infrared-sensor to automatically switch on the table device and all connected components like displays and camera. If the display remains black for several minutes even after the table device was automatically activated, please contact the IT Service Desk.

How can I modify the room lights or window shutters?

The conference devices are not connected to the room's lighting or windows shutters. If available, you need to use the wall panels for the particular systems.

What is a Microsoft Teams Rooms System (MTR) and where can I find technical details?
  • Detailed user instructions: User manual for MTR
  • eRoom booked meetings that include a Skype/Teams meeting will appear on-screen during the meeting time.
  • The Teams Rooms System is a network connected device that represents an endpoint in the Bosch Skype/Teams environment.
  • It is the central component and connects all conference periphery in the room such as front display, audio equipment and camera (as defined in the SMR Bundles)
  • It automatically wakes up when IR-sensor is triggered and goes to sleep after not being in use for some time.
  • In case the device does not work as intended, it can be rebooted by selecting “More” > “Reboot”. Rebooting takes between 3-5 minutes.
  • In case the device does not respond, a hard reboot can be performed by pressing the reset button for 10 seconds.
Where can I find a quick guide (print-out) with instructions on how to use the MTR?

MTRs are designed to be operated without separate instructions needed. If you need dedicated instructions to be placed in the room, please download the MTR Flyer here.

What can be done if the camera is displaying only a small section of the room and not the entire room?
  • For ease of use, all cameras in Smart Meeting Rooms are set to a total view, meaning they should show the entire room. This is the default and recommended setup.
  • On rare occasions, the local BD Support Team has decided to provide the separate remote control for the camera, that allows manual control of the camera picture.
  • Push the camera preset button to let the camera move to total view. If that's not the case, manually zoom out and position the camera according to the table setup. You can save the current position by pressing and holding the camera preset button for 3 seconds.
  • For the Logitech Rally Cam, you can download the camera manual here.
How to start and use MTR Room Remote?

Hint: Room remote is only available for Teams meetings!

  1. Plan Teams Meeting with MTR
  2. Start the Teams meeting on your mobile phone

  3. Click on the small "down" arrow next to "Participate now"

  4. Click on “Participate and add a room”

  5. The name of your nearby room system should now be displayed

IMPORTANT Bluetooth must be switched on on your smartphone and on the MTR!

Select the room system - and it will be transferred to the bar. Now click on “Join”.

   

  6. The system will now receive the call and connect as usual.

What is new, however, is the bar in the upper part of the call screen. If you click on "Control" here, a further connection to the room system will be established and you will be provided with the control options.

     

What is "Proximity Join"?

Proximity Join allows you to spontaneously connect to a Teams Meeting Room using Bluetooth from your laptop or mobile phone.

HINTS

What is the difference between Bosch Connect and Teams?

Teams does not replace Bosch Connect. In Bosch Connect, you can share information Bosch-wide. The scope is not limited. Furthermore, you can connect with others and enlarge your personal network via Bosch Connect. Microsoft Teams aims at long-term project- or team-oriented communication and collaboration. If you need to communicate and work with a certain group of people on a regular basis, a team room is more helpful and offers a wider variety of possibilities than Bosch Connect.

Why is Microsoft Teams still working without active VPN connection?

When you start Microsoft Teams for the first time, you need to be connected via VPN to receive an authentication token. Without this token, the sign-in process will fail. If you have received this token once (active VPN connection), the connection to Microsoft Teams can be established again without active VPN connection. This is the case until the token is checked for the next time. The token check happens every couple of hours. If you have no active VPN connection while the token checking process starts, the checking process will fail and your Microsoft Teams client will stop working.

Is this still safe? Yes! Even without an active VPN connection but active Microsoft Teams client, all your connections from your Microsoft Teams client to the Microsoft cloud are encrypted by industry standards.

Skype for Business (SfB) and Microsoft Teams


What is the difference between SfB and Microsoft Teams?

Microsoft Teams is announced as the successor product of Skype for Business (SfB) by Microsoft. However, Microsoft Teams is much more than just a tool for communication. It offers much more functionalities in terms of collaboration than SfB: You can upload and work on documets, you can include web pages, you can have group conversations and everyone in this team room directly has the necessary access rights for the documents.


Will SfB be deleted soon?

Often we hear things like 'Skype will be deleted soon' or 'Skype will not work anymore as soon as everyone has Teams' or 'Microsoft will shut down Skype next year' or similar phrases.

Let's get things straight:

Yes, generally, Microsoft Teams is the successor product of SfB. In the future SfB will be completely replaced by Microsoft Teams (which is really good - think about the status updates etc.). You can also see this on our roadmap.

But: No, it will not just be shut down by end of 2023.
There will be a phase-out of the old product.

How and when SfB will then be shut down within our organization is not defined yet as many many dependencies need to be clarified first. So please - help us to spread the word towards the real facts!

As soon as there are news, we will share it with you on the Digital Workplace Welcome Page or in the digital workplace Community.


Can I use Microsoft Teams and SfB at the same time? Are they connected?

Basically, you can use Microsoft Teams and SfB at the same time during the conversion period but you should avoid it whenever possible. They are not connected.

Try to move all of your conversation and collaboration within your working group to Microsoft Teams. Create a team room there and try to exclusively chat there. Avoid e-mails and SfB-chats.

page_name: Does the Ad hoc Data Exchange password policy for business partners meet the requirements of a strong password?
html_content:
Does the Ad hoc Data Exchange password policy for business partners meet the requirements of a strong password?

  • Both user name and password are always created new and valid only for 7 days.

  • The password is trivial and consists only of numbers, so that the user understands the announcement via voice call as a voice call message in English has to be understandable for non-native speakers as well and numbers can be better understood on the phone than letters or special characters.
    BUT
  • The user name is as complex as a strong password should be. (user name is the real (unofficial) password)
    Here is an example of an Adhoc user name: adhocX3dtc7bL4DiMA
    Such a user name meets all the requirements of a strong password according to the C/ISP requirements to protect C-SC2 data (CD02900 A.9.3.1 (Password Rules) & A.9.4.1 (Information Access Restriction).

  • User name and password are communicated to the business partner in 2 different ways (user name via an e-mail to the user only and password via a voice call message or via their Bosch business partner).

The proceeding above was accepted and approved by C/ISP  during the development of the application.

  • Das Passwort ist trivial und besteht nur aus Zahlen, so dass der Benutzer die Ansage per Sprachanruf in Englisch verstehen kann. (Die Sprachansage muss auch für Nicht-Muttersprachler verständlich sein und Zahlen können am Telefon besser als Buchstaben oder Sonderzeichen verstanden werden).
    ABER
  • Der Benutzername ist so komplex, wie  ein sicheres Passwort sein sollte. (Benutzername ist das echte (inoffizielle) Passwort)
    Hier ist ein Beispiel für einen Adhoc-Benutzernamen: adhocX3dtc7bL4DiMA
    Ein solcher Benutzername erfüllt alle Anforderungen an ein sicheres Passwort gemäß den C/ISP-Anforderungen zum Schutz von C-SC2-Daten. (CD02900 A.9.3.1 (Passwortregeln) & A.9.4.1 (Informationszugangsbeschränkung)).

  • Benutzername und Passwort werden dem Geschäftspartner auf zwei verschiedene Wege mitgeteilt (Benutzername über eine E-Mail nur an den Benutzer und Passwort über eine Sprachansage oder über seinen Bosch-Geschäftspartner).

Update March 2021:

With version SAC2008, which has been distributed since mid-March 2021, Office 365 Pro Plus has been renamed to Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise.

Basics

What is Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise?

It is the next Microsoft Office version which will be the successor at Bosch for Office 2016.
Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise is still a local installed Office (not in the web) which contains all the already know applications: Access, Excel, OneNote, Outlook, PowerPoint, Publisher, Skype for Business, and Word.

What is the difference between Microsoft 365 and Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise?

Microsoft 365 is the complete office workplace from Microsoft with a lot of applications (e. g. Teams) and services.
Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise is a part of this workplace.

What is the difference between Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise and Office 2016?

Microsoft 365 Apps for EnterpriseOffice 2016

Always up to date, due to regularly feature updates (twice a year)
Therefore the naming doesn't contain any year

Didn't get additional features since release

License must be activated in the Internet

License must be activated inside Bosch

64-bit32-bit

Can I install Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise and Office 2016 on the same PC?

No. That’s reasonable, as both Office versions use on the one hand different installation technologies ("msi" versus "click to run (c2r)") and on the other hand different architectures (64 bit versus 32 bit) that doesn’t fit together on the same PC. If you update from Office 2016 to Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise the Office 2016 version will be removed and the new version installed.

What happens with Office 2016?

With the introduction of Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise, we will continue to make Office 2016 available in parallel. The user will have the choice which Office version to use.
Our recommendation is to use Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise and have fun with the new features, but also test your environment (e. g. macros) with the new Office.

Will the usage of Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise result in any additional costs?

No, the costs will stay the same as for Office 2016.
However, there would be a separate cost for the separately available Visio (if needed).
If the online version is sufficient for Visio, you can use Visio online with the normal Office license, there are no separate costs.

How can I get back to Office 2016?

  • Assign the Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise uninstall package from the IT-Service Portal first
  • After successful uninstallation assign the Office 2016 installation package

General information about OneNote notebooks

OneNote is an electronic notebook and as such it should support you, e.g. while preparing of meetings; in researching; or in gathering ideas. Please note: OneNote is not suitable as a mass storage or as a storage for business relevant data.


Structure of OneNote 

OneNote consists of notebooks. These notebooks consist of sections and within the sections the various pages store the information.

This structure is important because there are properties that are linked to certain parts of the notebook. For example, it is possible to create only one page of a notebook. You can then insert content into this page - but it will not contain a trash can or versions of the page.

The wastepaper basket belongs to each notebook.

OneNote Limitations

Maximum values must be observed when using OneNote notebooks on the Windows PC and iOS device:
Microsoft recommends a maximum size of a notebook of 2 GB, a section should not exceed a size of 300 MB.

If a section exceeds 200 MB in size, the user should split the contents of the section into several other (smaller and newly created) sections and remove all unneeded data

We strongly recommend not copying large files in one section, as the contents have to be sent to the server and problems may occur during synchronisation.
We do not recommend inserting e-mails into notebooks.

Our OneNote best practices and recommendations:

  • Avoid having a lot of large content in the same section, including file printouts, images, and attached files. Large content makes synchronization slower because the content must be sent/received over the internet. Below are the options to reduce large content in one section:
    1. Instead of mounting files, upload them to a common location (such as OneDrive or OneDrive for Business) and add a link to them.
    2. Delete unnecessary pages with large content.
    3. Try to break down large pieces of content into multiple sections instead of packing them into a single section.
    4. Try to divide content into different notebooks. Store archived notes that you don't need to access every day in different notebooks and keep archived notebooks closed. You can reopen these notebooks at any time if you need them from the “More Notebooks” option.
    5. If there is content that you want to continue to access daily, split it into different sections within the same notebook.

  • If the notebook is stored on OneDrive, is used by multiple users in different locations around the world and the pages are usually edited at the same time, there may be a conflict.
    If there is a conflict with changes you are making at the same time as another user, you should receive a message allowing you to select the version you want to merge for the cloud. In this case, select which final version of the page should be updated.

  • Make sure that the notebook does not exceed the size of 2 GB per file, which is the limit for syncing OneDrive/SharePoint files: Restrictions and limitations in OneDrive and SharePoint (microsoft.com).

  • Avoid that the sections of the notebook have a content of more than 300 MB; in case they are approaching this size, you should create a new section.
  • f notebooks have been moved to OneNote/SharePoint, it is important to ensure that these files are moved properly through the app so that the correct structure of the OneNote file (notebook) is maintained: OneNote syncing best practices (microsoft.com)
  • In case you encounter a sync issue, and you think there is a difference between your local copy and the cloud file, you can open the notebook in the browser and compare between the local and cloud file. Any content that is missing from the browser file will also be missing from all users who have opened the notebook in question using the OneNote client. To open a notebook in the browser, just right-click on the notebook in the client -> click on "Copy link to notebook" -> paste the link into the notepad and copy the first line -> paste the link into the browser's address bar and press Enter. If this link does not take you to the notebook, it could indicate that the notebook has been moved, deleted, or that you cannot access it (possible communication, authentication or permission problems, etc.)

Important instructions for using OneNote

OneNote is intended as a tool for quickly collecting and structuring information. A OneNote notebook is neither a filing system nor a documentation system. 
Business-critical data must not be stored in a OneNote notebook.

Most synchronisation problems result from the inappropriate use of OneNote:

  • OneNote notebooks are misused and used as file storage, i.e. entire files are stored in a notebook
    We strongly advise against saving files in a notebook. This leads to a significant increase in the size of the notebook and can result in 

o    Different versions of files being in circulation. 
o    The notebook cannot be synchronised without errors

We therefore recommend saving files in SharePoint and linking to these files in OneNote. These files can be opened and edited quickly via this link.

  • OneNote notebooks are stored on network drives and not in a SharePoint library..

    OneNote notebooks stored in a SharePoint library are less vulnerable to errors as OneNote has been optimised for use with SharePoint.
    For example, only the changed part of the notebook needs to be synchronised for changes. This reduces the load on the network and minimises the potential for errors. 
    It is also possible to resolve synchronisation conflicts. 
    Another advantage is that you can see directly in OneNote who is authorised for the notebook.

    You can find a guide to moving a notebook under How to move a Notebook in the docupedia Office


FAQ

Why don’t I get the Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise package installed in time?

Even the Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise package has already been assigned it might be the case that it isn’t offered for installation within one or more days in the Software Center of the IT Workplace Toolkit. To workaround this issue please try the following:

  • Open the IT Workplace Toolkit from the task bar 
  • Select "Disable Software Distribution"

    and wait for the notification in the Action Center
  • Afterwards activate the software distribution again
  • The missing software should appear in the Software Center after some minutes

How do I get Visio and Project installed?

Visio and Project 365 are available in the IT Service Portal (Order form "Request for Cloud Software License (except M365)"):

Important

If you update from Office 2016 to Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise, Visio 2016 and Project 2016 will be uninstalled.

New: If you still need Visio or Project, you have to request the corresponding license.
You can assign and install the associated package during the ordering process.
After your order was processed and you start Visio or Project it might occur that the product seems to be not activated. Reason for this is that the actual license assignment will take place up to 48 hours.
But that´s not a problem, because you can work with the application without limitation for 5 days ("Grace mode") until the license activation takes place automatically in the background.

If the license wasn’t activated within 48 hours after you first started the Visio or Project application please contact IT Service Desk.

There is no difference between Standard and Professional version – only one version for each product.

What to do if my license for Project or Visio got lost?

One reason could be, that you have installed Project/Visio for the first time. Please read the chapter above.

The other reason could be that you haven't used the software for over 90 days. This is part of the ratio process, which gives the license free to save costs.
Your trial to start the software again triggers the reassignment of your license. This normally will happen within 48 hours. But, that it´s not a problem, because you can work with the application without limitation for 5 days ("Grace mode") until the license activation takes place automatically in the background.

If you have problems with the trial mode, you can activate the license almost immediately by ordering it again using ITSP order form. If assignment has been approved before, no new approval is required.

If the license wasn’t activated within 48 hours after you first started the Visio or Project application please contact IT Service Desk

I’m using files with macros/VBA code inside, might there be a problem with Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise?

Yes and no, it depends.
As we not only switch the Office version but we also switch from 32-bit Office 2016 to 64-bit Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise you should test your files with macros/VBA code inside.
In some cases there might be macro/VBA programming adjustments necessary to work also in a 64-bit environment.
While the most macros should work also with 64-bit there are some differences that Microsoft describes in the following article (Internet access required).
E. g. you can combine the new PtrSafe attribute with a Declare statement and use the LongPtr data type instead of just the Long data type.

How can I get support for macro customization/conversion?

If you are responsible for a macro or add-in and need support for customization/conversion, then you can contact Bosch colleagues at SX/BSA,
who offer a complete service (with costs) that also includes code changes/programming.
Details on who to contact and how to proceed can be found here.

Which Office Add-Ins are available with Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise?

Currently not all Office Add-Ins are available in the 64-bit version to be compatible with Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise.
Please refer to the linked list to check the status of your Add-In.

Where will my Outlook mailbox be under Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise?

With the current release of the M365 products you get the whole bundle of M365 products which includes also a Exchange online mailbox in the cloud.

When will new features be available?

As there are different update channels new features will be released first in early update channels like e. g. „Current Channel“.
We at Bosch use the „Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel“ as update channel. This update channel gets twice a year feature updates in Q1 and Q3.
So if you are missing a feature that was already released in an early update channel we will get it in our „Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel“ in Q1 or Q3.

Example: if a new feature was first introduced in May 2022 (version 2205) in „Current Channel“ we will not get it directly in Q3/2022 when
„Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel“ version 2202 is released, but it is likely that it will be part of version 2208 that will be released for „Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel“ in Q1/2023.

Prerequisites


You need to have the following IdM permission role: "Internet Web Access".

Please check first, whether your country is among the restricted countries.

If available, you have two options to request the role

  1. Request the role via IdM Self Service Link
  2. Order the role via ITSP
    • Click here to open the ITSP Order Form

    • Click on Order for Self

    • Application: Internet Web Access

    • IT Role: Description: Internet Web Access
      Name: CN=RB_InternetAccess,OU=SECURITYGROUPS,OU=Ci-idm2bcd,OU=Applications,DC=de,DC=bosch,DC=com

    • Reason: Accessing Microsoft 365/Teams

    • Click on Submit

You also need access to the Microsoft Edge browser. If you have troubles with this, call the IT Service Desk (3311).

Please be aware of these key points:

  • Add-Ins/Macros:
    Nearly all known Add-Ins available as SCCM package are compatible with Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise - please check this Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise Add-in Overview for more details.
    While most macros should also work with 64-bit, there are still cases that require some customization. You can find hints for customization and support in our FAQ.
  • Visio/Project:
    If you update from Office 2016 with already installed Visio or Project software, Visio/Project 2016 will be removed automatically and you have to assign the new packages for Visio or Project in the IT Service Portal separately    .
    There is a separate license process for MS Viso and Project - please find all information in our FAQ.



Installation


2 steps to get started

Installation

Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise is part of Microsoft 365, a comprehensive cloud software package.

Click here for instructions (EN + DE) to get the complete Microsoft 365 Package, including Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise.

Sign in


With the first start of an Office application, e. g. Word you have to activate your Office license at Microsoft.
If you first start Outlook there are some additional inputs necessary, which are described in the next section.

  1. Select “Sign in”

    (If you get an error message while signing in, please log off an on again, wait some minutes (2-5) then try again, because there is a policy in background which must be updated first)

  2. Please enter your UPN in the window “Activate Office" (UPN = UserID@bosch.com, e. g. xyz9fe@bosch.com) and click on "Next".
    Next, the "Sign In" window is displayed; please enter your Windows password here and click on "Sign In"


With the first start of Outlook you have to configure your email profile.

  1. In the following dialog enter your regular email address (GivenName.LastName@de.bosch.com)

    Then choose “Connect”

  2. The next window requests to choose the account type.
    Please select the account type "Exchange" (instead the pre-selected type "Office 365")

  3. The next window confirms the end of the account setup

    Please just click "Done".
    Afterwards Outlook opens and the mailbox content is synchronizing.

New features in 2024

What's new in Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise (SAEC 2308)?

  • Excel

    • Automate tab and Action Recorder (See blog post)
      You can record Office Scripts. Perform the actions you want in Excel, and the ​
      recorder will create an Office Script to replay those actions for you.
       

    • Accessibility ribbon (See blog post)
      Open the "Accessibility Checker" on the "Review" tab, then the "Accessibility" tab will be visible
    • Performance improvements
      - e. g. faster filtering when cells contain unique or duplicate conditional formatting rules​
  • Outlook

    • External labeling of mails
      If you receive mails with external email addresses they will be labeled with "External" in your inbox
       

    • Notifications
      You may see notifications if someone mentions you (you can customize this)
       
    • Reactions
      You can send reactions and see them in the mail
       
  • PowerPoint

    • All Accessibility features are at one place (See blog post)
      Select “Review” tab and select “Check Accessibility” to show “Accessibility” tab

    • Add closed captions to audio objects (See blog post).
      Select the audio objects and select "Playback" tab - Insert Captions
  • OneNote

    • New layout/view - requires more space between sections and pages
      Unfortunately, this setting cannot be changed.

    • New layout option - Vertical Tabs
        '

    • Take notes using just your voice with Dictate see more on Microsoft support pages

New features in 2023

What's new in Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise (SAEC 2302)?

  • Excel

    • Speed-up filtering: When your workbook contains lots of conditional formatting rules, it can slow down applying a filter such as a color filter. No longer! By optimizing the underlying data structure Microsoft sped up filtering.

    • Improved smooth Sscrolling. Scrolling in your sheet is now much smoother - no snapping to rows and columns. (This feature was already announced for version 2208 but it seems that it was improved). See more on Microsoft support pages
    • New Text and Array Functions: We’ve added fourteen new text and array functions to supercharge your spreadsheets: TEXTBEFORE, TEXTAFTER, TEXTSPLIT, EXPAND, TAKE, DROP, VSTACK, HSTACK, CHOOSEROWS, CHOOSECOLS, TOROW, TOCOL, WRAPROWS and WRAPCOLS. See more on Microsoft suport pages.
  • Outlook

    • New location for Outlook bar see more on Microsoft support pages
      So far you were used to switch the Outlook modules by clicking on the symbols in the lower left corner. Now these symbols moved to a new vertical position at the top left.

                         
      This setting can be controlled in Outlook Options – Advanced: “Show Apps in Outlook”


  • PowerPoint

    • Presenting with cameo. see more on Microsoft support pages
      With cameo, you can insert your live camera feed directly on a PowerPoint slide.

    • Record improvement  see more on Microsoft support pages. 
      Make your presentations more impactful by recording videos with narration
    • Save Media with Closed Captions (See blog post).
      Now when you save media to a file in PowerPoint, the closed captions associated with the media are also saved.
  • Word

    • Read aloud improved see more on Microsoft support pages
      The Read Aloud Toolbar features new, natural sounding voice options  


What's new in Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise (SAEC 2208)?

  • Excel
    • Copy data from the status bar like "Sum", "Average" and "Count" , see more on Microsoft support pages
    • Improved scrolling experience. Scrolling through your sheet just got smoother, see more on Microsoft support pages
  • Outlook
    • Suggested replies, see more on Microsoft support pages
      When you receive an email message that can be answered by a short response,
      Outlook can suggest three responses you can use to reply with just a couple of clicks.
      To turn it off go to “File > Options > Mail > Replies and forwards” - Clear the check box for ”Show suggested replies”
    • Show multiple mini-months in Calendar To-Do Bar
    • Changed behavior in search in address book, see more on Microsoft support pages
      When you typed a name in the address book the search for the name started automatically.
      Now you have to click on the small arrow next to the search field (or type return) to start the name search.
      To change this behavior back to the former setting you have to select "Name only" instead of "All columns" in the search field.
  • PowerPoint
    • Text Anchored Comments. As part of PowerPoint's modern comments, customers will now have the ability to anchor comments to specific ranges of text.
    • Lock objects in PowerPoint - just right click on the object and select "Lock" from the context menu.
  • Word
    • One-click writing suggestions, see more on Microsoft support pages
      Click directly on the underlined word to get suggested corrections for spelling and grammar
    • Say it another way with "Rewrite Suggestions", see more on Microsoft support pages
      When you want to say it differently just right click on the word and select "Rewrite Suggestions" from the context menu.
      (Currently available for texts written in English language)

New features in 2022

What's new in Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise (SAEC 2202)?

Note: This time the new semi-annual channel update "2202" contains mainly bugfixes and only few new features.

  • Common feature
    • Office Apps now support OpenDocument Format (ODF) 1.3, see more on Microsoft support pages - Internet access required
  • Excel
    • Create a custom data type in Power Query, see more on Microsoft support pages - Internet access required
  • Outlook
    • If a received email is from extern, you will see a hint in the email

  • Common features
    • Save shapes as pictures, see more on Microsoft support pages - Internet access required
      In just a few clicks, save a shape, icon, or other object as a picture file so you can reuse it elsewhere

      When you include a link to a file on OneDrive or SharePoint,

      You can change permissions so all recipients have access.

      So you no longer need to remember to click the Teams Meeting option.

      With Tabbed Panes you can switch between multiple panes using a tab UI. The UI will only be visible when you have 2+ panes open.

html_content:
Upload Files via OpenDXM REST APIs

OpenDXM provides REST-APIs for internal and external (non Bosch) clients.

The documentation for internal users can be found here: OpenDXM_REST_API_for_internal_users.pdf

The documentation for external users can be found here: OpenDXM_REST_API_for_external_business_partners.pdf


Currently, it is possible to send/upload files automatically to recipients who are registered in OpenDXM.



These demo scripts give you a first impression of the REST interface and (hopefully) make it easier for you to get started:
  • Powershell demo: Powershell_RestUploadDemo.zip (Recommended)
  • Bash demo Bash_RestUploadDemo.zip (Recommended)
  • Deprecated: Windows Batch Script demo: opendxmDemoRestUpload.zip

Sending Data to Business Partners

With OpenDXM, you can send data to your business partners (both internal and external) either

  • interactively (Interactive file transfers)

    or

  • automatically (Automated File Transfer)


Interactive file transfers are those file transfer activities that a large majority of our company's employees normally engage in.
The sender uploads the data via OpenDXM to one or multiple recipients (eihter internal users or external business partners).


Automated file transfers: OpenDXM is able to forward your files and make them available for download to your business partner(s). (See here for further details.)


There is an automatic e-mail notification system to alert users of data transfers – both incoming and outgoing.


Examples

  • Bosch employees of the marketing department send raw footage of videos to an external studio for further editing or review.
  • Bosch employees send large CAD files to their counterpart working with Bosch OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer).
  • Project "KBWS": To protect Bosch from potential Know-How leakage to the competitors, the decision has been taken to set up the engineering environment based on the new 3D-VDI external cloud workplace solution. VDI-Clients (triggered via SmartTeam) provide files via OpenDXM to business partners.
  • Different Project Teams within Bosch send data automatically to Porsche  e.g. Project related MS Office data or project related failure analysis/data (exported/imported from IBM Rational TeamConcert/ClearQuest/ClearCase)
  • Unidirectional Difference-zip file transfer to 30 business partners. Small OpenDXM-Transferclient-tool provided to customer. Transferclient creates diff-zips based on a big source directory (50 GB of size). Transferclient provides diff-zip files to partners via OpenDXM.


Preconditions for sending data

Both sender and recipient require OpenDXM Access.  You can find Information on Requesting OpenDXM access here.

In case of automated transfers, please contact OpenDXM Team

Receiving Data from Business Partners

With OpenDXM, you can receive data from your business partners (both internal and external) either

  • interactively

    or

  • automatically


To receive files, a file transfer must be initiated on the business partner's side.

The recipients are notified by email that data is available to be downloaded via their OpenDXM account.

There are the following options for the external partner to send data to the Bosch Group:

  • Via EDI (OFTP) 

If the external business partner is connected to Bosch via EDI (OFTP), they can send data to recipients at Bosch.
Precondition
The reciepients (Bosch users) require OpenDXM access, and they have to be registered as contacts in the business parter's  data exchange system.
The external parners have to be registered as contacts in OpenDXM. (See example: Data Exchange with Daimler)


  • Interactive via OpenDXM

External business partner can access OpenDXM interactively via browser and send data to any Bosch user registered in OpenDXM.
Precondition:
Both sender and recipient require OpenDXM Access.  You can find Information on Requesting OpenDXM access here.


  • Automated transfer

    • Via SFTP (using Bosch SFTP server)
      Precondition: The external parners have to be registered as contacts in OpenDXM.

    • Or: via API interface (REST)
      To consider:
      • This has to be set up at the external partner's side first
      • The setup usually takes longer than 1 week - depending on how the business partner's IT is structured.
      • Precondition:
        • Both sender and recipient require OpenDXM Access.  You can find Information on Requesting OpenDXM access here.

In case of automated transfers, please contact OpenDXM Team.

Automated further processing of the received data

If required, the received data can be stored on a network drive  (further details see here)


Examples

  • Bosch employees receive large CAD files from their counterpart working with Bosch OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer).
  • Employees of the university in Karlsruhe carried out a simulation during a publicly funded project and sent 700 GB to Bosch.
  • Vehicle fleets of JLR (Jaguar / Landrover) send measurement data to Bosch via SFTP (100 - 400 GB per day) 
  • Volvotruck sends data to Bosch via SFTP (6-8 TB per week → Data Transfer Rate: 100-120 Mbit/s)

OneDrive

GENERAL INFORMATION

Let's start with the basics.

GET ACCESS

Get OneDrive.

WORK WITH ONEDRIVE

FAQs, guides, best practices.

WHAT'S NEW?

Version history and new features.

Known restrictions and pending features.

General information about OneDrive

TIP: Use Ctrl + F to find the content you are searching for on this site.

 Tip: Accessing your OneDrive for the first time


What is OneDrive (for Business)?

OneDrive is the Microsoft cloud service that connects you to all your files. It lets you store and protect your files, share them with others, and access them from anywhere on all your Bosch managed devices. When you use OneDrive with an account provided by your company, it is sometimes called OneDrive for Business (ODFB).

OneDrive helps protect your work through advanced encryption while the data is in transit and at rest in data centers. OneDrive also helps ensure that users adhere to your most rigorous compliance standards by enabling them to choose where their data lives and providing detailed reporting of how that data has changed and been accessed. OneDrive connects you to your personal and shared files in Microsoft 365, enhancing collaboration capabilities within Office applications.

With OneDrive on the web, desktop, or mobile, you can access all your business related personal files plus the files shared with you from other people or teams, including files from Microsoft Teams and SharePoint.

And what‘s the difference between OneDrive for Business and OneDrive Online?

See topic: SharePoint & OneDrive: on premises vs. online

OneDrive vs. U/H drive (Personal Home Drive)

OneDrive is a cloud service that provides access to your files from anywhere. With the sync feature, you can work offline as well.

  • OneDrive and U/H drive are not intended for business records!
  • Data on OneDrive is stored in the cloud. You can easily share files with others and work on them simultaneously.


OneDrive vs. U-/H-Laufwerk (Personal Home Drive)

OneDrive ist ein Cloud-Service, der von überall aus Zugriff auf Ihre Dokumente gewährt. Mit der Synchronisierungsfunktion können Sie auch offline arbeiten.

  • OneDrive und U-/H-Laufwerk sind nicht für Geschäftsunterlagen gedacht!
  • Die Daten auf OneDrive werden in der Cloud gespeichert. Sie können ganz einfach Dateien mit anderen teilen und gleichzeitig daran arbeiten.


Why deploy OneDrive at Bosch?

With OneDrive, Bosch users can:

  • Access files from all your devices. Access all your personal files and those files others share with you on all your devices, including mobile, Mac, and PC as well as in a web browser.
  • Share inside (with Bosch Active Directory User) or outside (with External Collaboration User) your organization. Securely share files with people inside or outside your organization by using their email address, even if they don’t have a Microsoft Services Account. This common sharing experience is available in the web, mobile, and desktop versions of OneDrive. Note: Bosch has restricted sharing within the organization and external sharing is disabled purposefully.
  • Collaborate with deep Microsoft Office integration. Document coauthoring is available in the Office web apps, Office mobile apps, and Office desktop apps, helping you maintain a single working version of any file. Only OneDrive provides coauthoring capabilities in Office apps across all your devices.
  • Quickly find files that matter most. Finding content in your OneDrive is simplified through the intelligence of the Microsoft Graph application programming interface. This technology simplifies finding what’s important by providing file recommendations based on your relationship to other people, how you received various files, and when you last accessed them.
  • Protect your files with enterprise-grade security. OneDrive has many security and compliance features, enabling you to meet some of the strictest compliance requirements out there.

What are key features of OneDrive?

The features listed in this section address common customer concerns, specific compliance requirements, or provide unique functionality available only in OneDrive:

  • Known Folder Move
  • OneDrive Files On-Demand
  • Modern attachments
  • Real-time team collaboration: Coauthoring in full versions of Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Seamlessly connecting files to conversations
  • OneDrive Files Restore
  • Recycle bin
  • Data loss prevention (DLP)
  • eDiscovery
  • Auditing and reporting
  • Encryption of data in transit and at rest
  • Customer-controlled encryption keys
  • Microsoft 365 Customer Lockbox

What is OneDrive Sync Client?

With OneDrive Sync Client, you can sync files between your computer and the cloud, so you can get to your files from anywhere - your computer, your mobile device, and even through the OneDrive website at OneDrive.com.

If you add, change, or delete a file or folder in your OneDrive folder; the file or folder is added, changed, or deleted on the OneDrive website and vice versa.

You can work with your synced files directly in File Explorer and access your files even when you’re offline. Whenever you’re online, any changes that you or others make will sync automatically.

Even though you can upload, download, and interact with your OneDrive files from a web browser, the ideal OneDrive experience comes from the Windows and Mac sync apps and the iOS and Android mobile apps. Note: All devices must be Bosch Managed Devices.

OneDrive is available for most operating systems and browsers and requires minimal hardware. 

How to store C-SC3 data on your assigned laptop while using OneDrive OneDrive Sync Client?

C-SC3 data in not allowed in OneDrive. Only data which is classified below C-SC3 can be stored in OneDrive. To avoid the risk of accidental upload of C-SC3 data in OneDrive while Syncing known folders, please create a folder under C:\Users\UserID\FolderName e.g. C:\Users\kxx1mtp\Secured. 

Folders created at this location are secured for a logged-in user only and is not synced to OneDrive


Be aware that offline deleted files will be deleted as soon as you are online again. Any changes that you or others make will sync automatically.

Restore:

  1. File was saved directly in OneDrive.

Open the recycle bin of your computer and restore the document.

2. File was deleted from a MS Teams room.

Jump to the conected SharePoint Site and go to the recycle bin of the site.
You will see all deleted files, even those which were deleted by other users.

OneDrive is part of Microsoft 365, a comprehensive cloud software package.

The location-based rollout throughout the whole organization started in February 2021. Microsoft 365 is being introduced simultaneously in all regions depending on the feasibility. Overview

First steps after migration from OneDrive on-premises to OneDrive in the cloud

The following applies to the rollout of Microsoft 365. | Für den Rollout von Microsoft 365 gilt Folgendes.

During the location-based rollout the whole Microsoft 365 software package will be installed on your device.
After that, your mailbox and OneDrive for Business (on-premises) will be migrated to the cloud. In the meantime you can use both applications as usual.

If you have been using OneDrive on-premises (also known as MySite), please read and (if applicable) follow these key points AFTER you have been informed about the successful migration:

  • After the migration, your OneDrive on-premises data is put in read-only mode.

  • The OneDrive on-premises data will be deleted after 30 days.

  • Check authorizations
    Authorizations (also via the Share feature) are not migrated to OneDrive in the cloud. The authorizations have to be granted manually again. Learn how to share files and folders (including video).

  • Check links
    Links to OneDrive on-premises, e.g. to folder or files, do not work anymore after the migration to the cloud. Please update or delete them.

  • Check your OneNote notebooks
    Have your notebooks been stored on OneDrive on-premises? Does it still contain relevant data you need? If yes, the OneNote storage location has to be changed to the new OneDrive. Click here for instructions.

  • Followed Sites/documents
    Have you been following Sites or documents in SharePoint on premises? If yes, the followed Sites and followed documents information is exported automatically during the migration in an Excel file named “SocialFollowing.xlsx” in your OneDrive in the cloud.

    The “follow function” for on-premises Sites is not available in OneDrive in the cloud. If you want to continue using your existing links please save each link as a favorite (bookmark) in your web browser.

    After migration is complete, your on-premises OneDrive for Business will be in read-only mode.

Compare: Following a SharePoint Online Site

Questions? Use the forum “SharePoint and OneDrive”.

Während des standortbasierten Rollouts wird das gesamte Microsoft 365-Softwarepaket auf Ihrem Gerät installiert.
Danach werden Ihre Mailbox und Ihr lokales OneDrive for Business (on-premises) in die Cloud migriert. In der Zwischenzeit können Sie beide Anwendungen wie gewohnt verwenden.

Wenn Sie das lokale OneDrive verwendet haben (auch „Mysite“ genannt), lesen Sie bitte und (falls zutreffend) folgen Sie diesen wichtigen Punkten NACHDEM Sie über die erfolgreiche Migration informiert wurden:

  • Nach der Migration werden Ihre Daten auf dem lokalen OneDrive in den schreibgeschützten Modus versetzt.

  • Die Daten des lokalen OneDrive werden nach 30 Tagen gelöscht.

  • Prüfen Sie die Berechtigungen
    Berechtigungen (auch über die Share- bzw. Teilen-Funktion) werden nicht nach OneDrive in der Cloud migriert. Die Berechtigungen müssen wieder manuell erteilt werden. Erfahren Sie, wie Sie Dateien und Ordner mit anderen teilen können (inklusive Video).

  • Prüfen Sie Links
    Links zum lokalen OneDrive, z.B. zu Ordnern oder Dateien, funktionieren nach der Migration in die Cloud nicht mehr. Bitte aktualisieren oder löschen Sie diese.

  • Prüfen Sie Ihre OneNote-Notizbücher
    Wurden Ihre Notizbücher auf dem lokalen OneDrive aufbewahrt? Enthält es immer noch relevante Daten, die Sie benötigen? Wenn ja, muss der OneNote-Speicherort auf das neue OneDrive umgestellt werden. Klicken Sie hier für Anweisungen.

  • Sites und Dokumente, denen Sie folgen (Follow)
    Sind Sie in SharePoint on premises Sites oder Dokumenten gefolgt? Wenn ja, dann werden die Informationen zu gefolgten Sites und gefolgten Dokumenten während der Migration automatisch in eine Excel-Datei exportiert. Diese heißt "SocialFollowing.xlsx” und liegt dann auf Ihrem OneDrive in der Cloud.

Die "Folgen-Funktion" für SharePoint on premises Sites ist in OneDrive nicht verfügbar. Wenn Sie die bisherigen Links verwenden möchten, speichern Sie diese bitte als Lesezeichen (Bookmarks) in ihrem Webbrowser.

Instructions

Accessing your OneDrive for the first time and activating the sync feature

OneDrive can be accessed via browser.

If you activate the synchronization feature you can also access via File Explorer:

  • your OneDrive

  • synchronized SharePoint Online Sites

All changes like adding, editing or deleting files and folders are being synchronized then.

      

   

Option 1: via browser

Use the direct link https://portal.microsoft.com/OneDrive.

Tip: Save the OneDrive URL as a bookmark/favorite in your browser.

Option 2: via File Explorer

For access via File Explorer, please activate the OneDrive sync feature by following these steps:

  1. Click on the Start Menu , search for OneDrive and click on the icon  to launch it.

  2. On "Set up OneDrive" enter UserID@bosch.com, e.g. kbc1de@bosch.com, and click on Sign in.



  3. Enter your password on the next screen.

  4. Your OneDrive folder is created under "C:\Users\UserID\OneDrive - Bosch Group". We recommend not to change the location!

Click on Next.


5. Your OneDrive is ready. Click on Open my OneDrive - Robert Bosch GmbH folder.

 

After activating the sync feature you can use the cloud symbol in the task bar to access your OneDrive as well.

Das erste Mal auf Ihr OneDrive zugreifen und die Synchronisierungsfunktion aktivieren

Auf OneDrive kann über den Browser zugegriffen werden.

Wenn Sie die Synchronisierungsfunktion aktivieren, können Sie auch über den Explorer auf Folgendes zugreifen:

  • auf Ihr OneDrive

  • auf synchronisierte SharePoint Online Sites

Alle Änderungen, wie das Hinzufügen, Bearbeiten oder Löschen von Dateien, werden dann synchronisiert.

        

       

   

Option 1: über den Browser

Nutzen Sie den Direktlink https://portal.microsoft.com/OneDrive.

Tipp: Speichern Sie die OneDrive-URL als Lesezeichen/Favorit in Ihrem Browser.

Option 2: über den Explorer

Für den Zugriff über den Explorer aktivieren Sie bitte die OneDrive-Synchronisierungsfunktion mit folgenden Schritten:

  1. Klicken Sie auf das Startmenü , suchen Sie nach OneDrive und klicken Sie auf das Icon  , um OneDrive zu starten.

  2. Bei "Set up OneDrive" fügen Sie UserID@bosch.com ein, z. B. kbc1de@bosch.com, und klicken Sie auf Sign in.



  3. Geben Sie auf dem nächsten Bildschirm Ihr Passwort ein.

  4. Unter "C:\Users\UserID\OneDrive - Bosch Group" wird Ihr OneDrive-Ordner erstellt. Wir empfehlen, den Speicherort nicht zu ändern!

   Klicken Sie auf Next.




5. Ihr OneDrive ist einsatzbereit. Klicken Sie zum Öffnen auf Open my OneDrive - Robert Bosch GmbH folder.

 

Nach dem Aktivieren der Synchronisierungsfunktion können Sie das Wolkensymbol in der Taskleiste verwenden, um ebenfalls auf Ihr OneDrive zu gelangen.
