Working with Graph API


Why would I be interested to work with Apps & Integrations?

While working with Teams or M365 in general you might have stumbled upon a situation where you might have been asking yourself things like:

  • Why do I have to add all team members by hand, can I not just use a list?
  • How can I get this Teams post into a mail?
  • Can I push these folders to another SharePoint site?

If you have ever asked yourself something like this or just had ideas how you can improve your or your team’s productivity this topic might be interesting for you.


What do we offer?

For Teams and for all other M365 cloud-applications (SharePoint, Exchange, Planner, …) there are a lot more options, functions and capabilities that can be achieved using the Graph-API. Microsoft’s Graph API is a powerful API by Microsoft which allows software developers and end users to work with M365 services. Programmers can use this API to extend the functionality of their software. For example, if you want to gather user information for your application you can use API calls to the Azure Active Directory (AAD) in our Tenant.  

We decided to allow the usage of the Graph-API within Bosch to allow all of you to get the most out of our products. For some of the API-calls permissions are necessary and every central M365 service owner has the governance on their product’s respective permissions. But this will be explained in detail in the following parts.


Graph-API and Graph Explorer

Microsoft offers you a user interface based website where you can try out different Graph-API calls. The website also helps you finding errors in your API-call.

Try it out and run the example on the graph explorer website:  Graph Explorer | Try Microsoft Graph APIs - Microsoft Graph. The get request calls the AAD and requests the information on your own profile. The answer will contain some basic information on you such as email, name, Phone number or office location.


Where can I get an overview of the possibilities?

In the Teams context it does behave just the same. You can find all the capabilities here Use the Microsoft Graph API to work with Microsoft Teams - Microsoft Graph v1.0 | Microsoft Learn. You can create channels, manage them, delete them and a lot more. You can transfer calls or add participants. The capabilities of how you can use the API are endless as you might have figured by now. You can find the general documentation and information on the possibilities and restrictions here: Microsoft Graph REST API v1.0 endpoint reference - Microsoft Graph v1.0 | Microsoft Learn


How do Permissions work and where do I apply?

For most of the API calls specific permissions are necessary. The permissions can be split up in two different types:

  • Application Permissions
  • Delegated Permissions  

Application permissions will not be granted to any use case, application, or automation.

The reason for this is simple. Let’s have a look at an example:

Let’s think about a Bot or an Application which should schedule meetings based on the Calendar of a User.  How do I access a user’s calendar?

If I want to read a user’s calendar with graph I would need the permission for Calendar. Read (Get calendar - Microsoft Graph v1.0 | Microsoft Learn) . Note, that permissions differ between application and delegated permission.

Using the application permissions, I could gather every information of EVERY user’s calendar in our Azure AD tenant. That means, I, in this case the App/Bot, could see all your meetings and appointments without even having to be signed in. If it is a delegated permission the App/Bot can just see my own meetings and appointments.

As it should already be clear, application permissions are a lot more powerful than delegated permissions. To transfer this to Teams, if an App-Developer needs access to Chats, giving him applications permissions means, he could theoretically access every chat from every user within Bosch. Delegated permissions would only allow him to access chats from the currently signed in user.

These are the basics, however, applying for delegated permissions does not always mean that the permission can be granted without a second thought. Some permissions could cause harm to end-users or might be a critical topic thinking from the perspective of the workers council.


To get the topic more tangible, we can refer to the following example:

Every user at Bosch can just search the name of a user and see their current presence status, may it be busy, do not disturb or available. So why can’t I just grant everyone the delegated permission to read a user’s presence state via graph?

Well, looking at the presence gives us the state at the exact moment we look at the user’s profile, if I could do this every day in the interval of, for example, one minute, I could easily track any workers availability through the day. With this information I could summarize the time the user is on “appear away” and could see if the time sheet matches the Teams status. This is a very sensitive topic which can lead to issues with the end-users as well as with the workers council.

There are also very normal, uncritical use-cases for this permission, for example to transfer a call to an available employee.

To apply for permissions you can just follow THIS guide.


Best-Practice

During your app development, just use and request the permissions that are absolutely necessary for your use-case and use only delegated permissions. Please refer to THIS page for more information on the API-Permission approval process  and keep the “Least privileged API permissions” approach in mind!

(“The admin-consent-process is following the least-privileged-principle and therefore we're reviewing the requested and configured permissions against the provided justification. If a reasonable justification is missing or we see less critical permissions for your demand, we will deny your request...”)


NOTE The Graph-API is connected to the M365 cloud services, that means, if your application you plan to use, is hosted on premise, you will need to use a proxy to allow connection to the M365 cloud. Check THIS page for more information.

Example: Post a message to a teams chat step by step. To post a Teams message to a chat using the API is rather quick. How you want to implement the request is fully up to you. You can go with a simple request on the graph explorer, using an http-connector in Power Automate or go as far as running such requests in you c#-application.

  • Get delegated permission for ChatMessage.Send and Chat.ReadWrite
  • Generate the message based on this JSON-scheme: chatMessage resource type - Microsoft Graph v1.0 | Microsoft Learn and pass this as a body for your following http-request
  • Use the following http-request url: POST /teams/{team-id}/channels/{channel-id}/messages (replace everything in brackets with your information)
  • Send the request

That’s already it. If you run this your intended message should appear in the target channel!

QuestionAnswer
What is Microsoft Whiteboard?

Microsoft Whiteboard is a freeform digital canvas where people, content, and ideas come together. You can use Microsoft Whiteboard for collaborating with your team to accomplish many activities — whether your team is in the same place or in multiple locations. Team members can work collaboratively using their own devices.

So like with good old physical whiteboards, it is essential to keep the audience in mind, make it clear to the participants who shall have access to it and to export and erase it when the meeting or workshop is completed.

You can use it for example for...

  • Spontaneous creation of sketches / drawings to support your presentation
  • Ideation process
  • Getting participants more engaged in a meeting, e.g. with sticky notes and templates
  • Cluster and organize your ideas
On which platforms can I use Microsoft Whiteboard?

There are dedicated Microsoft Whiteboard apps for Windows 10 and for iOS devices. It can be used within the Microsoft Teams clients and via browser going to https://whiteboard.microsoft.com/

What should I consider when creating content in Whiteboard?
  • Microsoft Whiteboard is a collaboration tool to create content in a dynamic and flexible approach. It does not fulfill the data management according to [Central Directive CD 02900, formerly CD 02981]. LINK
  • After the content in a board has reached a quality to be processed in other tools to be finalized or documented, it needs to be exported and saved.
  • Microsoft Whiteboard is not meant to keep [business records] of content that you've created or which you were part of. Business records underlie various requirements like versioning, retention and need to satisfy legal requirements.
  • Ownership of a whiteboard lies with the creator of the whiteboard. In case the account of the owner is deleted, all whiteboards owned by that person are deleted as well.
  • Do not share C-SC3 data, Personal Information (PI) and Sensitive Personal Information (SPI) in Microsoft Whiteboard.
  • New Whiteboards are stored in your OneDrive account, old whiteboards (created prior to July 2022) will remain on the original Azure storage. To both storages the above applies.
  • If you are uncertain of the right storage location, please consult the Digital Workplace Storage Guide
Where is a new Whiteboard stored by default?

With the activation of OneDrive as data storage for MS Whiteboards, all new Whiteboards are created in OneDrive. Sharing of Whiteboards works identical to the sharing of other files in OneDrive. Old Whiteboards that were created in June 2022 and earlier will remain on the original data storage.

Is the Whiteboard stored on my personal cloud storage?

All new whiteboards are created in OneDrive and you can find Whiteboard that you own in your OneDrive file section in the folder "Whiteboards".

What will happen to Whiteboard content if the owner account (creator) is deleted?
  • The owner of a whiteboard is in control of the content and its sharing with others.
  • If the owner of a whiteboard is deleted (e.g. when leaving the company), their owned whiteboards are also deleted.
  • Please ensure to export and save relevant business information prior to an account deletion.
  • The above applies to whiteboards stored on OneDrive and the original Azure storage.
Can I use Microsoft Whiteboards with external (non-Bosch) participants?

Currently, Whiteboards can only be shared with other associates within the Bosch Group. External guests cannot access your Whiteboards and will see a notification when used in a Teams meeting.
In these cases a screen sharing session to display the Whiteboard on your desktop is recommended.

 Microsoft is planning to allow Whiteboard collaboration with external participants during a meeting. Access will be revoked after the meeting.

Why can't I start a Whiteboard in a Microsoft Teams direct call?

Whiteboard is only available within Scheduled Meetings (via Outlook Add-In) and Ad-hoc (channel) meetings.
When you directly calling someone (e.g. from a direct chat) whiteboard is unavailable. The workaround for this is to manually create a Whiteboard and invite your colleague.

I see a "Something went wrong" message when I select Whiteboard from the share tray in a Teams meeting. How can I resolve this?

Some Microsoft Teams meetings that have been created as recurring meetings a longer while ago and do not support Whiteboards yet. They might show the "Something went wrong" message. The easiest way is to replace the recurring meeting series by a new invitation in Outlook.

There are some ways to get access to a whiteboard:

  1. You can ask the owner of a whiteboard to invite you to that board.
  2. If the owner has shared a link to the whiteboard, you can use it as well.
  3. If you are member of an Microsoft Teams meeting in which a whiteboard is created, you will automatically be added as participant.
How to invite others to access a whiteboard

Whiteboards in OneDrive can be shared by clicking the share button at the top right menu of the whiteboard canvas.

You can also share a whiteboard by using the share button in the OneDrive folder view.

Sharing options are to share with participants by name or by link and assigning viewer or editor rights.

How to see that a whiteboard is shared with others in Microsoft Whiteboard

In the dashboard you will see a blue circle with two persons in it, marking the whiteboard as being shared. Opening the share menu, you can see who your whiteboard is shared with.

How to leave a whiteboard
In the Whiteboard App dashboard, click on the "..."-button. Here you find the "Leave" button. If your are the owner of a whiteboard, you will see "Delete" which delete the whiteboard for you as the owner and all participants.
How to duplicate a whiteboard

This is not possible. But as a workaround we suggest to just copy everything with the lasso and then copy it into a new whiteboard.

You can duplicate the whiteboard file in your OneDrive folder and assign a new name and sharing rights.

How to delete a whiteboard

In the Whiteboard App dashboard, click on the "..."-button. Here you find the "Delete", if you are the owner of the whiteboard and would like to delete it for you and all participants.

If you see "Leave" instead, you are a participant and not the owner of the whiteboard and can just leave the whiteboard. It will still be there for the owner and the other participants.

How to restore a deleted whiteboard
This is not possible. Make sure you export your results as images for future reference.
How to organize my whiteboards
As the Microsoft Whiteboard apps do not provide any functions to sort or search for whiteboards to which you have access to, it is essential to keep the numbers low and do not store any whiteboards for a longer duration. It is recommended to export and delete whiteboards as soon as you've completed a meeting or workshop.
Is it possible to save a board (not export) at a certain point, so that no further edits are possible?

You can duplicate the whiteboard file in your OneDrive folder and remove access rights for other users.


How will the storage of MS Whiteboard change with OneDrive? (2022 July release)

Microsoft is shifting the data storage for MS Whiteboard from Azure to OneDrive. For our Bosch environment, this change will be put into effect on July 22, 2022. The change will have some impact on the way how MS Whiteboards will be shared with other users as you can see below.
All whiteboards created after the change will be stored in OneDrive, all earlier ones will remain in the old Azure data storage.


QuestionAnswer
How will the storage of MS Whiteboard change with OneDrive?
  • With the activation of the OneDrive data storage, all new whiteboards will be created in OneDrive.
  • Sharing with other users will be performed by using the OneDrive sharing features.
  • The creator of the whiteboard will find new whiteboards by their assigned whiteboard name with the ending ".whiteboard" in their OneDrive file storage under the folder "Whiteboards"
  • Whiteboards are online-only, why they cannot be downloaded as files. Still you can duplicate and copy them across OneDrive folders.
What can I do, if my MS Whiteboard does not provide the OneDrive sharing features yet?

If you use MS Whiteboard in your browser, you can clear the cache and remove cookies to ensure that the app is loaded anew. Afterwards, you shall see the new sharing features with your new whiteboards. Old whiteboards will still have the old sharing link mechanism.

If you use MS Whiteboard in the Win10 App, please update the MS Whiteboard app via the MS Store for Business first. After that, start the MS Whiteboard App, log out and log back in again.

Navigation in Whiteboard App - Sharing a new Whiteboard (using OneDrive method)

Navigation in OneDrive 
  1. Whiteboards folder:

  2. Find your new Whiteboards:

   3. Share Whiteboard with colleagues or copy a link:

What will happen to old Whiteboards that were created before the change

Old whiteboards that have been created before the change will remain on the original Azure data store. These can be shared as before by distributing the whiteboard share-link:

Can I move all my old Whiteboards to the new OneDrive storage

Currently, Microsoft does not provide a process to migrate selected or all whiteboards of a user to OneDrive data storage, yet. Microsoft is working on a transition phase for user-selected whiteboards, but does not plan to transfer all content in an automated approach.

Can I move individual content into a new Whiteboard on OneDrive

It is possible to mark all content in an old whiteboard, put in the clipboard (Ctrl+C) and paste it (Ctrl-V) into a newly created whiteboard.

If I modify old Whiteboards, will they be moved to the new storage

No, whiteboards on the old platform will remain on that platform even when you edit them.

Please create a new whiteboard and copy the content manually.

How can I differentiate which Whiteboard is on which storage

Unfortunately, current situation is that you need to open the share dialog of a whiteboard to know which platform it is using. This inconvenience has been addressed to Microsoft.

When are Whiteboards on the old platform deleted

Currently, Microsoft has not published a date by which old whiteboards on Azure will be deleted


Work with Microsoft Whiteboard App on Windows 10 (2022 release)

 Please note, that prerequisite is to re-install Whiteboard app


QuestionAnswer
Why has the user interface been changed

In an approach to unify the user interface across the platforms Microsoft Teams, the Windows 10 app, iOS and browsers, Microsoft has decided to convert the user interface and features. All future development will be targeted to the new UI.

How the new user interface looks like

On desktops, laptops, and tablets, inking tools and content creation menus are separated to reduce cognitive load, while an app bar at the top of the canvas provides all of your collaboration and board-specific properties. On mobile, the creation panel & board controls are hidden to optimize real estate for viewing and collaboration. Large, colorful icons make it easy to use for mouse, touch, and pen users alike.

Can I keep the old user interface of the MS Whiteboard app
Unfortunately, that is not possible. Microsoft won't be supporting the old user interface in the future and all new installations and updates of the Microsoft Whiteboard App via the Microsoft Store for Business will replace the old UI.
Which new templates are available

There are over 40 new, fully customizable templates dedicated to brainstorming, agile rituals, problem solving, group projects and many more.

How can I manage access to my whiteboards

For whiteboards that are stored in OneDrive, you will see the OneDrive sharing dialog. For whiteboards that have been created in June 2022 and earlier, the old data store is used. You will see that as the sharing section only allows the creation of a share link.

How can I assign individual access rights to my whiteboards

Microsoft was shifting Microsoft Whiteboard data storage to OneDrive. With that, you are able to see your whiteboard as files in OneDrive. Like with other files in OneDrive, you will be able to assign access rights then.

How can I change the pen size or color
Click on the selected pen a second time. This opens the menu to change size, color or direction arrows.
How can I zoom in the Whiteboard canvas
In addition to the mouse wheel or by using pinch&zoom if you have a touch-enabled display, you can use the zoom buttons in the lower right corner or fit the content into the current view.
How to change background format

You can customize your board by changing the background color and pattern with attractive colors and grid designs to suit your needs. To do that go to Settings and select Format background.

More sticky notes

Sticky notes now offer more variety with an array of 12 colorful shades to choose from. What is more, you can sorting them by different color categories. You can also organize note grids by adding a title to them.

Reactions

You have set of eight reactions to quickly communicate your thoughts and feelings on other’s ideas.

React / voting mechanism for sticky notes

You can use note grid, have participants vote and filter note grid by number of votes.

Note, that reactions do not automatically get sorted by votes, so you might need to collate them to your liking:

Insert images

You can add photos and images to convey visual ideas more impactfully.

Insert shapes

Basic shapes, lines and arrows can now be added with the click of a mouse or the tap of a finger. Once added, you can resize, rotate and recolor the shape fill and border.

New inking tools
  • Whiteboard now has 15 new pen and highlighter color options and a range of thicknesses to help visualize your content and bring your ideas to life.
  • You can also add a single or double arrowhead to the end of your ink stroke automatically.
  • To draw a straight line just press the Shift key as you draw and done. Your line will automatically snap to 0, 45, and 90 degrees and to the nearest stroke end. If you need a little more flexibility, you can release the Shift key.
  • All the ink shapes you draw with a mouse will be automatically converted

 You can switch between ink tools seamlessly using keyboard shortcuts:

FunctionShortcut
Switch to Draw ModeAlt + W  / Alt + W + 1
Pen 2Alt + W + 2
Pen 3 Alt + W + 3
HighlighterAlt + H 
EraseAlt + X
Arrow modeAlt + A
Double arrowAlt + Shift + A
BeautifyAlt + B
Bring to Front and Send to Back

This feature helps you re-arranging and layering objects.

Locking objects to the canvas

You can lock your object, what will make it impossible for other users to move or delete it.


Work with Microsoft Whiteboard

QuestionAnswer
How to improve the performance due to the current limitations?
  • The Microsoft Whiteboard application (desktop app) can be used for meetings with up to 10 participants with less than 200 items.
  • The web-based Microsoft Whiteboard application can be used for meetings with up to 20 participants and 400 items.

Extra hints:

  • Externals without Bosch account cannot work with Bosch associates on the Whiteboard. More details, please see here.
  • The same hints apply for BSH, and BSH colleagues cannot use the Windows 10 application as the log-in does not work yet. Please use the web-based application in the meantime. We are working on a solution.
How to draw on whiteboards
All Microsoft Whiteboard apps and the browser interface provide a toolbar from which you can select multiple pens, eraser or the selecting / scrolling tool.
Can I use my fingers to draw?
Do I need a particular pen?
You can use your fingers or pens that have been delivered with your laptop for drawing on its touch-enabled display. There are capacitive pens in the market that can be used on touch-enabled displays, but these have neither been tested nor certified. Please make sure you do not use devices that damage or scratch the surface of your displays.
Can I use the mouse to work on whiteboards?

Yes, you can use your mouse to make drawings in the same way like you would by using touch capabilities.

In the toolbar, you can switch between drawing mode and selecting/zooming mode.

To configure the tools in the toolbar, you double-click in the toolbar.

You can use right-click to access the context menu.

Can I use touch-enabled displays to work on whiteboards?

Yes, you can use your touch-enabled displays to make drawings in the same way like you would by using a mouse.

In the toolbar, you can switch between drawing mode and selecting/zooming mode.

To configure the tools in the toolbar, you long-press in the toolbar.

You can use long-press to access the context menu.

How to scroll and move the whiteboard in Microsoft Whiteboard

Zooming can be done by using the scroll-wheel of the mouse, pinch&zoom with a touch-enabled display or using the buttons in the lower right corner.

How to undo / redo activities

Use the shortcuts CTRL+Z and CTRL+Y to allow undo and redo or use the arrows in the top left menu.

How to clear the canvas

Use the right-click (or touch long-press) to access the context menu and select "Clear canvas".

How to change the background

You can access the settings menu in the upper-right corner (marked with three lines) and navigate to "Format background".

How to export a whiteboard
  1. Open the whiteboard that you like to export 
  2. Click on "Export image" in settings
  3. Save as Standard or High resolution
Is the Microsoft Whiteboard the same tool as used in Microsoft Teams?
Yes. You can open it separately or directly in Microsoft Teams.
How to insert a whiteboard (link) to a Microsoft Teams channel

This is how you share the link to the Whiteboard in the channel conversation:

  1. Open Microsoft Whiteboard

  2. You can access the share section in the top-right menu

  3. Create a share link for your whiteboard by using the OneDrive sharing features.

  4. Paste the share link into the Teams channel.

This is not connecting user access rights between Teams channel and whiteboard, both are managed separately.

How can I create a whiteboard independently of an individual Teams Meeting
  1. You can create a whiteboard via browser or Whiteboard app which is independently of any Teams meeting.
  2. Within the whiteboard you can enable the share link and share it with your team. Every Bosch associate with the link can access the board then. It has no connection to any Teams meeting and won't have.
  3. If you want to share this whiteboard in a Teams meeting, share the share link in the meeting chat so that all users can open it in a browser tab. To make it visible to all in the meeting use "Share > Screen" to show your desktop.

NOTE Other users can only edit the whiteboard that has been opened on their end by following the share link. They won't be able to edit, if you only share your screen.

How can I create a whiteboard as a part of a scheduled Teams Meeting
  1. You need to enter the scheduled Teams meeting and click on "Share > Microsoft Whiteboard" to create a new whiteboard. This whiteboard is connected to that particular meeting. Access is provided to all Bosch associates who are part of the Teams meeting. As it is automatically using the sharelink for that, the sharelink for that board is enabled per default.
  2. Whenever any presenter in your Teams meeting clicks on "Share > Microsoft Whiteboard", all participants are taken to that particular whiteboard and can edit it within the Teams meeting.
  3. Your whiteboard will also appear in the Whiteboard browser interface and in the Microsoft Whiteboard app by the name "Whiteboard Meeting". Users who are participants of your meeting will also see the whiteboard in their dashboard and can access it there.

NOTEIf you disable the sharelink or delete the whiteboard manually, it will lose any connection to the Teams meeting. Then using the "Share > Microsoft Whiteboard" interface would not work as it is trying to access the original whiteboard link and does not create a new board.

How to use sticky notes

Select the sticky note button on the toolbar to create a new note. You can type to create text or selecting a pen to draw on it.

Attribution support for sticky notes

It allows you to see who added a sticky note to a Microsoft Whiteboard, and who updated it last.

If you enable or don't configure this policy setting, everyone on the whiteboard can view attributions. When enabled, board owner of the whiteboard can disable attributions for that whiteboard from Settings Panel → Authors → Show note authors.

How to use templates, lists, follow-up lists and node grids

You can select templates from the toolbar under the "+"-section. After placing a template on your whiteboard canvas, you can modify it and rename sections. It is not possible to create or save personal templates.

A workaround here is creating a whiteboard with no participants and prepare a setup that you can copy & paste to new whiteboards.

Are there any plans that Bosch templates are provided?
No, this is not planned yet.
How to add images to whiteboards
You can open the image menu from the whiteboard toolbar to add images from your desktop.
Which images am I allowed to use from the "Bing Image Search"?

Bing search is currently disabled by Microsoft, but shall be re-activated soon.

Bing search will only be available if you've selected "Enable optional connected experiences" under "Privacy and Security".

What is auto-shape ("ink to shape") detection in?

This is a service that tries to automatically detect tables you are drawing and make them resizable. You can find "Enhanced inked shapes" in the settings of the dashboard.

How to enable / disable the share link for a whiteboard

This will be handled by OneDrive sharing features.


How to work with Microsoft Whiteboard on an OSD client (Linux)

Microsoft Whiteboard on on Linux OSD (Bosch Open Source Desktop) clients can be accessed via browser https://whiteboard.microsoft.com.

⚪ For BSH, Linux is not suppoted.

How to work with Microsoft Whiteboard on Virtual Workplace Lite, Virtual Workplace Group (WTS)

Microsoft Whiteboard on Virtual Workplace Lite or Virtual Workplace Group (WTS) clients can be accessed via browser https://whiteboard.microsoft.com. 

⚪ For BSH, providing the full app on the Virtual Desktop is in preparation, but not ready yet.

Is there some kind of history

No there is no history and also no fallback points. You can "undo" also only your drawings, but not from other people. As shown in our demo, someone can delete the whole screen and you cannot undo it.

Is it possible to fill in video data
No, this is not possible.
How to create new Loop components in a Whiteboard
  1. Open the Whiteboard in which you want to create a new Loop component
  2. Select the "..." from the bottom chrome menu

    3. Select the Loop components option

    4. Choose from a Table, Task list, Voting Table, Progress Tracker or Checklist to insert on canvas. If using a mouse, please click on the canvas to insert the Loop component.

NOTE To live copy/paste a Loop component from a Whiteboard to other M365 applications:

  1. Select Copy link in the upper right corner of the component.

  2. Open the host (Teams chat, Outlook mail or other M365 application) in which you want to paste the component.

  3. Paste using the paste option in the right-click context menu (long-press if using touch) or keyboard shortcut (Ctrl + V).

How to copy/paste loop component to the Whiteboard

You can live copy/paste existing Loop components from MS Teams onto a Whiteboard and edit them inline with changes saved across instances in real-time.

  • Insert a new Loop component in Teams chat,  or select an existing one.

  • Select Copy link in the upper right corner of the component.

  • Open the Whiteboard in which you want to paste the component.

  • Paste using the paste option in the right-click context menu (long-press if using touch) or keyboard shortcut (Ctrl + V).

NOTE Currently only Loop components that are shared with everyone in your organization can be pasted into Whiteboard.

How to edit Loop component

  • Using a Mouse: Hover & then double click on the portion of the Loop component you want to edit

  • Using a Keyboard: 

    • Use Tab to bring focus onto the Loop component.

    • Press Enter to take focus onto the Loop component header.

    • Press Tab to take focus onto the Loop component content.

    • Press Enter to take focus inside the Loop component content and edit as desired.

  • Using Touch/Tap: Double-tap on the portion of the Loop component you want to edit.

How to delete Loop component

  • Select a Loop component.

  • Select Delete in the component’s context menu or the delete key on your keyboard.


How to add timer to the Whiteboard

To add timer to your Whiteboard just click on the clock icon on the top menu:

How to create an own template

If you want to keep your whiteboard as template for reuse:

  1. Click on Create button + and Templates

   2. Select My templates

   3. Click on Create new template

How to work with Ink Color Picker

Now you can add new colors to the palette and enjoy more color options for inking in Whiteboard. In addition to the color picker feature, there is also a slider to change the opacity level of pens. Colors recently used are also available on the color palette and the color picker feature.  

To get started select Inking (pen icon) from the left-hand menu or press Alt + W.

Get Access to Whiteboard

Microsoft has disabled the Microsoft Store for Business, why it is not possible to install or update the Microsoft Whiteboard App for Windows 10 using that method anymore. Please use the Microsoft Whiteboard app https://whiteboard.microsoft.com/ in your Edge browser or the whiteboard access within your Microsoft Teams client, if you are facing difficulties with the standalone Windows 10 App.


🔎 TIP: Use Ctrl + Fto find the content you are searching for on this site.



💬 If you do not find the answers here, see here how to get support.





Prerequisites


You are already enrolled to Microsoft 365 (e.g. you can access Microsoft Teams, OneDrive and other M365 services). If you don't have access to Microsoft 365, please follow the Microsoft 365 Docupedia for further instructions.



Recommended clients


Microsoft Whiteboard is available with identical feature set via multiple clients.

Installation and sign in procedures vary based on the selected clients.


Basic:

Microsoft Edge browser web application https://whiteboard.microsoft.com


  • Flexible way of accessing web-based applications
  • Open multiple whiteboards in different tabs at the same time
  • To avoid even more open tabs in your browser, you may open your Whiteboard dashboard and "Install Microsoft Whiteboard" from the Edge menu under "Apps". This creates a shortcut in your Windows client to make the browser tab look like a standalone Windows app in a separate window.
Embedded app in your Microsoft Teams client.
  • Advantage of this client is that you have all your whiteboards available within your collaboration tool.
  • Attach the Whiteboard dashboard to your Teams navigation bar.
  • Create new whiteboard or select existing ones from within your Teams meetings, within Teams channels and Teams chats.
  • Pop out the Whiteboard window to keep your Teams conversations visible during your Whiteboard session.
Using Mobile Workplace and Mobile Workplace Lite service on mobile devices
  • Please follow the Mobile Workplace Docupedia for further instructions.
  • The Microsoft Whiteboard app needs to be installed via the Enterprise Portal.
  • The Microsoft Authenticator app is mandatory for authentication.

In case of difficulties with the above, these clients are available:

Firefox, Chrome or Safari browser web application https://whiteboard.microsoft.com

Microsoft Whiteboard is optimized for the Microsoft Edge browser, therefore that browser is recommended.

Standalone Windows app
  • Please be aware that the Standalone Windows app is considered for future removal as Microsoft is focusing on the browser- and Teams-based access. Dedicated communications on this will be done in due time.
  • Microsoft had been distributing and updating the Whiteboard standalone app via the Store for Business before discontinuing the Store for Business in early 2023.
  • To remediate this, Microsoft Whiteboard has been added to "Add/Remove Software" order form in the IT Service Portal.




Installation and signing in


Use cases
Whiteboard via Browser-based access
  • No additional installation required
  • Microsoft Whiteboard URL to be entered in your browser:  https://whiteboard.microsoft.com
  • Single-Sign On and log in with <nt-user>@bosch.com
Whiteboard via Microsoft Teams access
  • No additional installation required
  • For your convenience, you can "Add Whiteboard to the Teams navigation bar"
  • Single-Sign On using your Teams login <nt-user>@bosch.com
Whiteboard via mobile devices

  • On Bosch-managed devices, please follow Mobile Workplace Docupedia for further instructions. Microsoft Authenticator and Whiteboard apps are required.
  • On personal-owned devices as Bosch associate, please follow Mobile Workplace Lite Docupedia for further instructions. Microsoft Authenticator and Whiteboard apps are required.
  • On BSH-managed devices, please install Microsoft Authenticator and Microsoft Whiteboard via XenHub.
  • Login via Microsoft Authenticator app and using <nt-user>@bosch.com
Whiteboard in the standalone Windows app
  • On SCCM-managed Windows machines, Microsoft Whiteboard can be selected for installation using the "Add/Remove Software" order form in the IT Service Portal.
  • Single-Sign On and log in with <nt-user>@bosch.com




Adding Whiteboard to the Teams navigation bar


Microsoft Whiteboard can be added to MS Teams menu bar as app.

  • Microsoft Whiteboard is included in MS Teams as app. If you don't see it in your menu bar, you can add it via the expansion menu "..."
  • The Whiteboard app in Teams lets you navigate your whiteboards, create new ones, work on existing ones and share them with your colleagues.
  • It provides the identical feature set like the standalone Microsoft Whiteboard App or the browser-based app.

Search Content in OneDrive


Getting Started

Go to https://bosch-my.sharepoint.com

If you are not yet logged in to your Microsoft 365 account, you will be asked to log in. Enter your user in the format

NT-User@bosch.com (e.g. xyz4fe@bosch.com)

You will have to enter the user name once again in combination with your Windows password.

For overall information see the OneDrive documentation.


Training


There is a Use Case Training that covers both the Enterprise Search and the M365 Search - if you would like to have a guided introduction, feel free to sign up:

https://connect.bosch.com/wikis/home?lang=en#!/wiki/W28a4d914c7f7_491a_9502_8a0b6dbb3c17/page/Use%20Case%2023%20-%20Search%2C%20find%20and%20share%20information%20with%20Microsoft%20365


What can be found?


Please note:

You will only get search results if you have access to the respective channels, files etc.


As soon as you click in to the search slot, you will get suggestions with relevant documents.

When you type a search term and press 'Enter', results will be shown from

  • your OneDrive
  • Microsoft Teams sites where you have access
  • documents in other users' OneDrive, provided they have shared them with you

The location column will provide information where the result is stored.

Clicking on the filter icon will provide you with options to further refine your search results. If you know that a document has been worked on by a specific colleague or has been shared in a specific meeting, you can also use the corresponding filter options on the left to identify the right file more easily.

If you want to return to the document overview, just click on 'My files' at the top of the left-hand menu.

Microsoft 365 Search FAQ

What can be found where?

The Microsoft 365 Search is sensitive to the context where you are searching, so you will not find all documents in all environments. Here is a quick overview:

Where can I searchWhat can I find there?Find out more
Microsoft Teams
  • Messages
  • Teams
  • Channels
  • People
  • Apps
  • Files stored in Teams (i.e. SharePoint Online)
Search content in Microsoft Teams

www.microsoft365.com

  • Files in SharePoint Online
  • Files in your OneDrive (or shared with you)
  • People
  • SharePoint Online sites
  • Apps
  • Bookmarks
  • Teams messages (in the Conversations tab)
  • e-mails (in the Conversations tab)
  • Power BI reports (in the Power BI tab)
Search content in www.microsoft365.com

  • Files in this site
  • Folders in this site
  • News in this site
Search content in SharePoint Online

  • Files in SharePoint Online

Search Content in OneDrive
Outlook (Web version only)

  • Microsoft Teams messages

Can I get a search experience similar to the one in SharePoint today?

You can always have the look and feel of the current SharePoint on-premise environment if you click 'Return to Classic SharePoint' in the bottom left corner of the SharePoint Online window. This will change the page layout and also the search options.

Furthermore, the classic search experience is directly available under https://bosch.sharepoint.com/search/Pages/default.aspx

Why does my Delve page (My Office profile page) not show any documents?

The functionality to provide also documents is currently not enabled for Bosch (cf. Search in your Office Profile)

Why am I not able to find what I am looking for?

The Microsoft 365 Search only provides results if the following conditions are met:

  • You have been granted access to the document
  • You are searching in the right context (e.g. you will not find PowerBI reports in Teams) cf. the chapter What can be found where?
  • The document is stored in the cloud - locally stored data (like Bosch Connect, BGN, SharePoint on premise) is not available through the Microsoft 365 Search

Please check whether you have access to the document and whether it is actually stored in the cloud and not, for example on a SharePoint instance hosted within the Bosch network!

Where can I find more information?

There is a Use Case Training that covers both the Enterprise Search and the M365 Search - if you would like to have a guided introduction, feel free to sign up: https://connect.bosch.com/wikis/home?lang=en#!/wiki/W28a4d914c7f7_491a_9502_8a0b6dbb3c17/page/Use%20Case%2023%20-%20Search%2C%20find%20and%20share%20information%20with%20Microsoft%20365

An overview of the cloud-based Microsoft Search can be found here (not all features enabled for Bosch yet!):

  • https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/t5/microsoft-sharepoint-blog/search-that-works-wherever-you-re-working/ba-p/576431  

If you want to find out more about searching in www.office.com, feel free to check out the Microsoft documentation:

  • https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/find-it-with-search-at-office-com-82db9126-8571-4ca0-b897-4c610d86221e
  • https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/find-what-you-need-with-microsoft-search-d5ed5d11-9e5d-4f1d-b8b4-3d371fe0cb87
  • https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/learn-about-microsoft-search-in-microsoft-365-b8bf5a2c-7515-40a9-9a6a-b8ed382c86bc?ui=en-us&rs=en-us&ad=us

The Microsoft documentation for searching in Microsoft Teams can be found here:

  • https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/search-for-messages-and-more-in-teams-4a351520-33f4-42ab-a5ee-5fc0ab88b263

Please note, however, that not all features described might be available to you (yet) or that your environment might look slightly different.

Search in your Office Profile



Getting Started

When you are working on https://www.microsoft365.com or SharePoint Online, you can click on your profile icon in the top right corner and access your Microsoft 365 profile. This will lead you to a Delve page where you can see and update the information stored about your account. This page can also be used to suggest other associates and documents which might be relevant to you, based on your activities in Microsoft 365 so far, but this functionality is currently blocked. The account page also has a search slot to actively search for people and documents to the extent that you have access and that this functionality is enabled by your organization.

What can be found?

As the display of documents is currently blocked, you can only use the search slot to find other associates - this also happens regardless of whether you are choosing 'Search people' or 'Show all' while typing in your search terms. Clicking on a result will open that person's Delve page with contact data and further information that you are entitled to see.

For more information about the mechanics used by Delve to determine relevance etc, please check the official Microsoft communication:
https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/what-is-office-delve-1315665a-c6af-4409-a28d-49f8916878ca

 to the English version of this page

Voraussetzungen


Sie benötigen die IdM-Rolle "Internet Web Access" (IdM = User Identity Management).

Bitte überprüfen Sie zunächst, ob Ihr Land in der Liste der Länder mit Einschränkungen aufgeführt ist.

Wenn verfügbar, haben Sie zwei Möglichkeiten die Rolle zu beantragen:

  1. Beantragen Sie die Rolle im IdM Self Service
  2. Beantragen Sie die Rolle im IT Service Portal (ITSP)
    • Klicken Sie hier um die ITSP Orderform aufzurufen
    • Klicken Sie auf Auftrag für mich
    • Anwendung: Internet Web Access
    • IT-Rolle: Beschreibung: Internet Web Access
      Name: CN=RB_InternetAccess,OU=SECURITYGROUPS,OU=Ci-idm2bcd,OU=Applications,DC=de,DC=bosch,DC=com
    • Begründung: Zugriff auf Microsoft 365/Teams
    • Klicken Sie auf Submit

Es ist außerdem notwendig, dass Sie mit dem Microsoft Edge-Browser auf das Internet zugreifen können.
Sollte das nicht möglich sein, nehmen Sie bitte unbedingt mit dem IT-Service Desk (3311) Kontakt auf, bevor sie fortfahren.

Bitte beachten Sie diese wichtigen Punkte:

  • Add-Ins/Makros:
    Nahezu alle bekannten Add-Ins, die als SCCM-Paket verfügbar sind, sind mit Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise kompatibel - bitte überprüfen Sie den Status der von Ihnen benötigten Add-Ins in dieser Übersicht Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise Add-in Overview
    Während die meisten Makros auch mit 64-Bit funktionieren sollten, gibt es dennoch Fälle, die einer Anpassung bedürfen. Hinweise zur Anpassung und evtl. Unterstützung finden sie in unseren FAQ.
  • Visio/Project:
    Wenn Sie von Office 2016 auf Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise umstellen, werden bereits installierte 2016-Versionen von Project/Visio automatisch deinstalliert. Bitte weisen Sie Ihrem Rechner nach der Installation von Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise die entsprechenden neuen Pakete für Project/Visio im IT Service Portal zu.
    Bitte beachten Sie, dass Sie für die neue Version von Project/Visio eine separate Lizenz beantragen müssen - weitere Informationen finden Sie in unseren FAQ.



Installation


2 Schritte, um zu starten

Installation

Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise ist ein Teil von Microsoft 365, einem umfassenden Cloud-Softwarepaket.

Klicken Sie hier für Anleitungen (EN + DE), um das komplette Microsoft 365 Paket, inklusive Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise zu erhalten.

Der erste Start


Mit dem ersten Start einer Office-Anwendung, z.B. Word, müssen Sie Ihre Office-Lizenz bei Microsoft aktivieren.
Wenn Sie Outlook zum ersten Mal starten, sind noch einige zusätzliche Eingaben notwendig, die im nächsten Abschnitt beschrieben werden.

  1. Wählen Sie “Sign in”

    (Wenn während der Anmeldung eine Fehlermeldung ausgegeben wird, melden Sie sich bitte wieder ab. Warten Sie einige Minuten (2-5) und versuchen Sie es dann erneut)

  2. Geben Sie im Fenster "Activate Office" bitte Ihre UPN (UPN = BenutzerID@bosch.com, z.B. xyz9fe@bosch.com) ein und klicken Sie auf "Next".
    Als nächstes wird das "Sign In"-Fenster angezeigt; geben Sie hier Ihr Windows-Passwort ein und klicken Sie auf "Sign In"

Beim ersten Start von Outlook müssen Sie Ihr E-Mail-Profil einrichten.

  1. Geben Sie im folgenden Dialog Ihre reguläre E-Mail-Adresse ein (Vorname.Nachname@de.bosch.com)

    Klicken Sie dann auf “Connect”

  2. Im nächsten Fenster wird der Typ des Mailkontos bestimmt.
    Wählen Sie bitte den Kontotyp "Exchange" (anstatt dem vorausgewählten Typ "Office 365")

  3. Das folgende Fenster bestätigt, dass die Kontoeinrichtung nun beendet ist

    Klicken Sie auf "Done".
    Anschließend öffnet sich Outlook und der Inhalt des Postfachs wird synchronisiert.

html_content:
Unterstützt Ad hoc Data Exchange automatisierte file transfers?

Ad hoc bietet keine Automatisierungsmöglichkeiten an.
Dateien können nur interaktiv hoch- und heruntergeladen werden.
Sie können stattdessen die Applikation OpenDXM verwenden.
OpenDXM bietet hier verschiedene Lösungen an.

Microsoft Store for Business



The Microsoft Store for Business was an App Store for distributing software (Apps) on Windows 10/11 managed devices. It was deactivated in May 2023.

  • App deployment and Updates are not possible anymore by Store. All existing App installations are remaining on the clients. 
  • Installation sources / app updates are planned to be downloadable, at least till the official EoL.
    • If you as app responsible person, need this in relation to a SCCM package, please contact us. SCCM would still be the only currently known technical way within RB to distribute and update apps.
    • For questions regarding a SCCM package, please get in touch with Application Release Management (BD/PWS3) Application-Release-Management.CIPWS3@de.bosch.com.
  • The introduction of automatic updates for apps within RB will be checked again centrally by BD/PWT.


The Apps, which were formerly provided and updated by the Store will be handled as follows:
Windows Apps - All embedded Windows app like Calculator, Sticky Notes etc. are handled by the “Windows App Update” SCCM package.

Microsoft To Do - SCCM package available - How to install the Microsoft To Do App for Windows

Microsoft Whiteboard

How to use the tool:

  • Open Whiteboard via Edge browser https://whiteboard.microsoft.com/ or within the Microsoft Teams client.
  • The browser access does not require a specific installation and provides the identical feature set like the Windows app.
  • For further information, please visit https://inside-docupedia.bosch.com/confluence/x/m9n8Tg

How to get the Windows app:

  • The Microsoft Whiteboard app for Windows has been SCCM-packaged and will be distributed via global rollout.
  • The Microsoft Whiteboard app for Windows can be installed/uninstalled via ITSP software delivery.

How to update the Windows app:

  • The Microsoft Whiteboard app for Windows will be updated automatically based on SCCM-packaging.

How to get / update the Windows app (temporary solution):

Open https://whiteboard.microsoft.com in Edge browser and install the app via browser menu > Apps > Install Microsoft Whiteboard


Miracast/Wireless Display Adapter - SCCM package available

Brainloop Secure Client - Not supported anymore. Users have been informed via support. Uninstallation was triggered centrally.

Citrix Workspace App - SCCM packages available, App were uninstalled centrally.

PowerBI /PowerBI Desktop App - SCCM packages available, Apps were uninstalled centrally.

Pulsar for Salesforce - Not supported anymore, App were uninstalled centrally

SAP Cloud for Customer - SCCM package in preparation

SAP Field Service Management - SCCM package available.

smapOne - Updates handled by the user.

Neue Funktionen in 2024

Was gibt es Neues in Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise (SAEC 2308)?

  • Excel
    • Automatisierungs Tab und Action Recorder (siehe Blogbeitrag)
      Sie können Office Scripte aufzeichnen. Führen Sie die gewünschten Aktionen in Excel aus, und der  ​
      Recorder erstellt ein Script um diese Aktionen für Sie wiederzugeben.
    • Barrierefreiheit Tab (siehe Blogbeitrag)
      Klicken Sie auf "Barrierefreiheit überprüfen" auf dem "Überprüfen" Tab um das "Barrierefreiheit" Tab einzublenden
    • Performanceverbesserungen
      - z. B. schnelleres Filtern wenn Zellen eindeutige oder doppelte "Bedingte Formatierungsregeln" enthalten.
  • Outlook
    • Extern Kennzeichnung von Emails
      Wenn Sie Emails mit externen Email Adressen erhalten, werden diese mit "Extern" in Ihrem Posteingang gekennzeichnet
    • Benachrichtigungen
      Sie können Benachrichtigungen sehen, z. B. wenn Sie jemand erwähnt (diese Einstellung ist anpassbar)
    • Reaktionen
      Sie können auf Mails mit Symbolen reagieren. Diese werden anschließend in der Mail dargestellt.
  • PowerPoint
    • Alle Barrierefreiheits Funktionen sind an einer Stelle (siehe Blogbeitrag)
      Klicken Sie auf "Barrierefreiheit überprüfen" auf dem "Überprüfen" Tab um das "Barrierefreiheit" Tab einzublenden
    • Hinzufügen von Untertiteln zu Audioobjekten (siehe Blogbeitrag)
      Wähle das Audio Objekt aus und klicke auf das "Wiedergabe" Tab - wähle dann "Beschriftungen einfügen"

  • OneNote
    • Neues Layout/Ansicht - benötigt mehr Platz zwischen den Abschnitten und Seiten
      Diese Einstellung kann leider nicht geändert werden.


    • Neue Layoutoption - Vertikale Registerkarten

    • Erstellen Sie Notizen mit der "Diktieren" Funktion. Weitere Info siehe Microsoft Support Seite.

Neue Funktionen in 2023

Was gibt es Neues in Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise (SAEC 2302)?

  • Excel
    • Verbessertes Filtern: Wenn Ihre Arbeitsmappe viele bedingte Formatierungsregeln enthält, kann dies die Anwendung eines Filters, z. B. eines Farbfilters, verlangsamen. Damit ist jetzt Schluss! Durch die Optimierung der zugrunde liegenden Datenstruktur hat Microsoft die Filterung beschleunigt.
    • Verbessertes Scrollen - Das Scrollen in Ihrem Blatt ist jetzt viel sanfter - kein Einrasten an Zeilen und Spalten. (Diese Funktion wurde bereits für Version 2208 angekündigt, aber es scheint, dass sie verbessert wurde). Weitere Info siehe Microsoft Support Seiten
    • Neue Text- und Array-Funktionen: Wir haben vierzehn neue Text- und Array-Funktionen hinzugefügt, um Ihre Tabellenkalkulationen zu verbessern: TEXTBEFORE, TEXTAFTER, TEXTSPLIT, EXPAND, TAKE, DROP, VSTACK, HSTACK, CHOOSEROWS, CHOOSECOLS, TOROW, TOCOL, WRAPROWS and WRAPCOLS. Weitere Info siehe Microsoft Support Seite
  • Outlook
    • Neue Position für die Outlook-Leiste Weitere Info siehe Microsoft Support Seite
      Bisher konnten Sie die Outlook-Module durch Klicken auf die Symbole in der unteren linken Ecke wechseln. Jetzt sind diese Symbole an eine neue vertikale Position oben links gewandert

                       
      Diese Einstellung kann unter Outlook-Optionen - Erweitert gesteuert werden: "Apps in Outlook anzeigen"



  • PowerPoint
    • Mit Cameo können Sie Ihren Live-Kamera-Feed direkt in eine PowerPoint-Folie einfügen.


    • Verbesserung der Aufzeichnung. Steigern Sie die Wirkung Ihrer Präsentationen, indem Sie Videos mit Kommentaren aufnehmen. Weitere Info siehe Microsoft Support Seiten
    • Medien mit Untertiteln speichern (siehe Blogbeitrag). Wenn Sie jetzt Medien in einer Datei in PowerPoint speichern, werden auch die mit den Medien verbundenen Untertitel gespeichert
  • Word
    • Verbessertes Vorlesen: Die Vorlese-Symbolleiste bietet neue, natürlich klingende Sprachoptionen . Weitere Info siehe Microsoft Support Seiten

Was gibt es Neues in Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise (SAEC 2208)?

  • Excel
    • Kopiere Daten aus der Statuszeile wie z. B. "Summe", "Anzahl" und "Mittelwert" - weitere Infos siehe Microsoft Support Seiten
    • Verbessertes Scrollen - weitere Infos siehe Microsoft Support Seiten
  • Outlook
    • Vorgeschlagene Antworten - weitere Infos siehe Microsoft Support Seiten
      Wenn Sie eine E-Mail-Nachricht erhalten, die mit einer kurzen Antwort beantwortet werden kann,
      kann Outlook Ihnen drei Antworten vorschlagen, die Sie mit ein paar Klicks beantworten können.
      Um dies zu deaktivieren, gehen Sie zu "Datei > Optionen > E-Mail > Antworten und Weiterleitungen" - Deaktivieren Sie das Kontrollkästchen "Vorgeschlagene Antworten anzeigen".
    • Zeige mehrere Monate im Kalender in der Aufgabenleiste an
    • Geändertes Verhalten bei der Suche im Adressbuch - weitere Infos siehe Microsoft Support Seiten
      Wenn Sie einen Namen in das Adressbuch eingegeben haben, wurde die Suche nach diesem Namen automatisch gestartet.
      Jetzt müssen Sie auf den kleinen Pfeil neben dem Suchfeld klicken (oder die Eingabetaste drücken), um die Suche zu starten.
      Um das Suchverhalten wieder auf die vorherige Einstellung umzustellen wählen Sie "Nur Name" statt "Alle Spalten" im Suchfenster
  • PowerPoint
    • Textverankerte Kommentare. Als Teil der modernen PowerPoint-Kommentare haben Anwender jetzt die Möglichkeit, Kommentare in bestimmten Textbereichen zu verankern.
    • Sperren von Objekten. Klicke mit der rechten Maustaste auf das Objekt und wähle "Sperren" aus dem Kontextmenü aus.
  • Word
    • Schreibvorschläge mit einem Klick - weitere Infos siehe Microsoft Support Seiten
      Klicken Sie direkt auf das unterstrichene Wort, um Korrekturvorschläge für Rechtschreibung und Grammatik zu erhalten
    • Sagen Sie es anders mit "Vorschläge neuschreiben" (Rewrite) - weitere Infos siehe Microsoft Support Seiten
      Wenn Sie es anders ausdrücken möchten, klicken Sie einfach mit der rechten Maustaste auf das Wort und wählen Sie "Vorschläge neuschreiben" aus dem Kontextmenü.
      (Derzeit verfügbar für Texte in englischer Sprache)

Neue Funktionen in 2022

Was gibt es Neues in Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise (SAEC 2202)?

Notiz: Das neue halbjährliche Office Update 2202 enthält dieses Mal hauptsächlich Bugfixes und nur wenige neue Funktionen.

  • Allgemeine Funktion
    • Die Office-Anwendungen unterstützen jetzt das OpenDocument Format (ODF) 1.3
  • Excel
    • Erstellen eines benutzerdefinierten Datentyps in Power Query
      detaillierte Informationen finden Sie auf den Microsoft Support Seiten
  • Outlook
    • E-Mails von Extern sind mit einem Hinweis gekennzeichnet

Was gibt es Neues in Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise (SAEC 2108)?

  • Allgemeine Funktionen
    • Speichern eines Bilds oder einer anderen Grafik als separate Datei
      Mit einigen wenigen Klicks können Sie eine Form, ein Icom oder ein anderes Objekt als separate Bilddatei speichern
      (Diese Funktion ist neu in Word und Excel, in PowerPoint ist sie bereits verfügbar).
    • Bearbeiten von SVG-Bildern
      Sie können jetzt SVG-Inhalte aus Office in Anwendungen von Drittanbietern einfügen.
    • Animierte GIFs werden jetzt im Office-Editor unterstützt
      Wenn Dokumente animierte GIFs enthalten, werden diese nun automatisch abgespielt
  • Outlook
    • Übersetzungsfunktion für empfangene Nachrichten
      Wenn Sie eine Nachricht in einer anderen Sprache erhalten, wird oben in der Nachricht eine Aufforderung angezeigt, in der Sie gefragt werden, ob Sie möchten, dass Outlook die Nachricht in Ihre bevorzugte Sprache übersetzt

      detaillierte Informationen finden Sie auf den Microsoft-Support-Seiten - Internetzugang erforderlich
    • Verbesserte Links in E-Mails
      (Diese Funktion ist bereits seit Version 2102 verfügbar, aber es lohnt sich, sie noch einmal zu erwähnen )
      Wenn Sie einen Link zu einer Datei auf OneDrive oder SharePoint einfügen, ersetzt der Dateiname die URL. Sie können die Berechtigungen so ändern, dass alle Empfänger Zugriff haben.

      detaillierte Informationen finden Sie auf den Microsoft-Support-Seiten - Internetzugang erforderlich

    • Machen Sie jede Besprechung, die Sie erstellen, standardmäßig zu einer Teambesprechung, damit Sie nicht mehr daran denken müssen, die Option Teambesprechung anzuklicken (Datei > Optionen > Kalender - "Onlinebesprechung zu allen Besprechungen hinzufügen").

    • Besprechungen vorzeitig beenden oder verspätet beginnen
      Diese Einstelllung finden Sie unter Datei - Optionen - Kalender

      detaillierte Informationen finden Sie auf den Micr osoft-Support-Seiten - Internetzugang erforderlich
  • Excel
    • Verbesserte Dialoge für bedingte Formatierungen
      Dialogfelder für bedingte Formatierung können jetzt in der Größe verändert werden, und Sie können die Regel jetzt mit einem einzigen Klick duplizieren
      detaillierte Informationen finden Sie auf den Microsoft-Support-Seiten - Internetzugang erforderlich
    • Blenden Sie mehrere Blätter gleichzeitig ein
      Es muss nicht mehr ein Blatt nach dem anderen eingeblendet werden. Wählen Sie mehrere ausgeblendete Blätter auf einmal aus, um sie wieder einzublenden.

      detaillierte Informationen finden Sie auf den Microsoft-Support-Seiten  - Internetzugang erforderlich

Neue Funktionen in 2021

Was gibt es Neues in Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise (SAEC 2102)?

Hinweis: Dies ist eine Auswahl von neuen Funktionen, die für Benutzer interessant sein könnten.

  • Gemeinsame Funktionen

    • Verbesserte Oberfläche für die Fensterverwaltung
      Wenn Sie mit 2 oder mehrere Auswahlbereichen arbeiten (z.B. Kommentare und Formatierungsfunktionen) können Sie über Tabs zwischen den Bereichen wechseln, statt wie bisher zwei oder mehrere Fenster auf dem Bildschirm offen zu haben.
      Details finden Sie hier.

      In Word, Excel und PowerPoint können Sie häufig genutzte Ordner anheften, um das Speichern neuer Office-Dateien zu erleichtern.

      Sie benötigen keine "MS Access Database Engine" oder "MS Access Runtime" mehr.
      (Detaillierte Informationen finden Sie auf den Microsoft Support-Seiten - Internetzugang erforderlich)

    • Stellen Sie eine PDF-Verbindung her
      Verbinden, importieren, aktualisieren von Daten aus einem PDF
      (Detaillierte Informationen finden Sie auf den Microsoft-Support-Seiten - Internetzugang erforderlich)

    • Variablen zur Verwendung in Formeln erstellen
      Verbessern Sie Leistung, Lesbarkeit und Kombinierbarkeit mit der LET-Funktion.
      Mit dieser Funktion können Sie benannte Variablen in neuen oder bereits vorhandenen Formeln erstellen.
      (Detaillierte Informationen finden Sie auf den Microsoft-Support-Seiten - Internetzugang erforderlich)

  • Outlook

    • Schnelles erneutes Öffnen von Elementen aus einer vorherigen Sitzung
      Microsoft hat eine Option hinzugefügt, mit der Elemente aus einer früheren Outlook-Sitzung schnell wieder geöffnet werden können. Diese Funktion ist standardmäßig aktiviert.
      Unabhängig davon, ob Outlook abgestürzt ist oder Sie es geschlossen haben, können Sie jetzt Elemente schnell wieder öffnen, wenn Sie die Anwendung erneut öffnen.

      Um diese Option auszuschalten wählen Sie Datei > Optionen > Allgemein > Startoptionen


  • PowerPoint

    • Zeigen (und übersetzen) Sie Sprache als Untertitel während einer Präsentation im Diashow-Modus.

      (Weitere Informationen finden Sie auf den Support-Seiten von Microsoft - Internetzugang erforderlich)

      (Weitere Informationen finden Sie auf den Microsoft Supportseiten - Internetzugriff erforderlich)

Was gibt es Neues in Office 365 ProPlus (SAEC 1902) im Vergleich zu Office 2016?

Hinweis: Dies ist eine Auswahl von neuen Funktionen, die für Benutzer interessant sein könnten.

  • Gemeinsame Funktionen
    • Einfügen von svg-Dateien in Office-Dokumente, Arbeitsmappen, E-Mails und Präsentationen
    • Alte Gleichungen können in das neue Format konvertiert werden (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
    • Einfügen und Drehen (360°) von 3D-Modellen (Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Word)

  • Funktionen der Zusammenarbeit für Excel, PowerPoint und Word in Kombination mit SharePoint

    • Gemeinsames Bearbeiten
    • Freigegebene Dateien: sehen, wann eine Datei geteilt, editiert, umbenannt oder wiederhergestellt wurde
    • Freigegebene Dateien: sehen, wer Änderungen an geteilten Dateien vorgenommen hat
    • Für mich freigegeben: sehen, wer Dateien mit Ihnen geteilt hat

  • Funktionen der Zusammenarbeit für Outlook in Kombination mit SharePoint oder OneDrive

    • Überprüfung des Zugriffs auf freigegebene Dateien auf OneDrive oder SharePoint
    • Setzen von Berechtigungen für OneDrive- oder SharePoint-Anhänge
  • Access
    • Neuer Datentyp “BigInt” und dynamische Felder
  • Excel
    • Grundlegende Veränderungen durch 64-Bit-Architektur
    • Wenn Sie mit großen Datensätzen (z.B. von SAP-Systemen) arbeiten, wie unternehmensübergreifenden Excel-Arbeitsmappen mit komplexen Berechnungen, vielen Pivot-Tabellen, Datenverbindungen, Power Pivot, 3D Map, Power View oder Get & Transform. In diesen Fällen kann die 64-Bit-Version von Office besser funktionieren und erreicht nicht so schnell Begrenzungen.
    • Exportieren von Daten im „CSV UTF-8“-format -> hilfreich in asiatischen Ländern, um z.B. chinesische Schriftzeichen beizubehalten
  • Outlook
    • Keine Erinnerungen mehr für vergangene Ereignisse
    • Neue E-Mail: die Eingabe von @<BenutzerID> im Mailtext fügt den Benutzer zur Adressatenliste hinzu
    • Benutzen Sie "Laut vorlesen", um Ihre E-Mail anzuhören
    • Weiterleitung von Besprechungen deaktivieren
    • Die URL hinter Safe Links sehen
    • Warnung, wenn Sie in BCC gesetzt wurden
    • Verbesserte Unterstützung von hochauflösenden Anzeigen
    • Erinnerungen so einstellen, dass im Vordergrund des Fensters erscheinen, in dem Sie gerade arbeiten
    • Drei Zeitzonen sehen
  • PowerPoint
    • Nutzen Sie STRG+Klick, um während der Berabeitung einer Präsentation Hyperlinks zu öffnen
    • Nutzen Sie “Design Ideas” für Ihre Präsentation
  • Skype
    • Verbesserte Unterstützung für die Freigabe von Programmen auf 4K-Bildschirmen (64-Bit Eigenschaft)
    • Verbesserte UX für Anrufumleitung und -weiterleitung

Visio und Project

Visio und Project 365 sind separat im IT Service Portal verfügbar (Auftrag "Request for Cloud Software License (except M365)"):

Wichtig

Wenn Sie von Office 2016 auf Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise aktualisieren, werden auch Visio 2016 und Project 2016 deinstalliert.

Neu: Wenn Sie Visio oder Project weiterhin benötigen, müssen Sie die entsprechende Lizenz beantragen.
Bei dem Antrag kann das dazugehörige Paket gleich mit zugewiesen und installiert werden.
Nachdem Ihr Antrag bearbeitet wurde und Sie Visio oder Project zum ersten Mal starten, kann es vorkommen, dass das Produkt scheinbar nicht aktiviert ist. Grund dafür ist, dass die eigentliche Lizenzvergabe bis zu 48 Stunden dauert.
Das ist aber kein Problem, denn Sie können 5 Tage lang ohne Einschränkung mit der Anwendung arbeiten ("Grace-Period"), bis die Lizenzaktivierung automatisch im Hintergrund erfolgt ist.

Sollte die Lizenz nicht innerhalb von 48 Stunden nach dem ersten Start der Visio- oder Project-Anwendung aktiviert worden sein, wenden Sie sich bitte an IT Service Desk.

Es gibt keine Unterscheidung mehr zwischen Standard- und Professional-Version – Es gibt pro Produkt eine Version.
