TRANSITION FROM PHYSICAL TO DIGITAL EVENTS

  • Compelling events are about people
    Keep in mind that you should prioritize and keep the following key elemtns in mind:

    • The clarity of your message

    • The attendee experience

    • Your ongoing engagement strategy

  • Shorter sessions: Minimize the amount of information you are trying to share. Plan breaks for attendees to stretch, get a coffee, get some screen-free minutes in between.

  • Interactive content: use online polls such as the BBQ app, or the Bosch Inquiry Survey Tool.

PRESENTATION

Keep your slides simple and clear:

  • Corporate Design: Shape and color
  • Highlight key words in bold
  • Use pictures and icons
  • Use a simple slide layout - do not overload slides with long texts
  • Presenter skills: Your presenter is the heart of the event. Rehearse the content you want to present, the more you practice, the better it'll be! Also keep in mind that online presentation skills are more complex. You are not receiving non-verbal feedback from the audience (body languages, smiles, etc.)

LOCATION & LIGHTING

Take a moment to prepare your recording space

  • Your camera should be stable at, or slightly above, eye level
  • Make sure your face is in good, even light, with no harsh backlightIn addition, avoid mixing light sources (e.g., window and lamp light) as the different color temperatures will show up in the video
  • Do not sit in front of a window. Your webcam will compensate, which will cause your face to look dim or dark.
  • Reduce clutter and distracting or bright images in the background



AUDIO QUALITY

  • How to improve the call quality in Skype for Business
  • How to improve the call quality in Microsoft Teams

  • Power supply: Connect your computer to a power supply. You don't want to run out of battery while presenting!

  • Internet bandwidth: Make sure your connection is stable. If necessary, ask people sharing your network to pause their video games / streaming (e.g. Netflix) or other.

  • How to reduce background noise in Microsoft Teams meetings

1. What is Project Online?

Project Online is a cloud-based service, provided by Microsoft, for enterprise-wide solution for project management. It provides powerful project management capabilities for planning, prioritizing, and managing projects and project portfolio investments.

Project Online can be used by project and resource managers, team leads and members, also by administrators, portfolio managers and viewers.

Project Online is built on the SharePoint platform, and it stores data in the SharePoint data store. The Project workspace on SharePoint provides the collaboration for the project team.

Project Online can be used in two different ways:

  1. via the Project Web Application (PWA; web app) which is a cloud solution and accessible through the web browser by every Standard Identity (former Standard IT User).
  2. via the Project Online Desktop Client (desktop app) to manage projects and resources locally, by ordering Project 365 via the IT Service Portal. Desktop Client can also connect to PWA instances and manage the online projects and project teams.




2. What's in it for you?

  • Plan, track, execute the projects
  • Schedule tasks
  • Gantt chart view
  • Resource management
  • Time sheet
  • Role based security
  • Portfolio analysis
  • Share the projects to the team members
  • Share project documents to team members
  • Can be used for data up to Security Class 2 (SC-2)
  • Provided APIs for customization/reports
  • Project Online Desktop Client for local project/resource management


Notes: The out-of-box Project Online (PWA) is not provided at Bosch as specific customization is required.


3. Project Online Project Web Application (PWA; web app)

Project Online Project Web Applications are the classic Microsoft project sites that have been around for many years, and are very feature rich and robust for managing every aspect of projects in an organization.

The cloud solution is accessible through the web browser by every Standard Identity (former Standard IT User).

Features include:

  • Project Management - Add project tasks, view a Gantt chart, assign tasks, add custom fields to the project, build the project team, set milestones and dates, define project calendars, and more...
  • Portfolio management - Rank projects based on key driving factors, decide what projects to start executing and when, view reports over many projects, and more...
  • Resource management - Request resources on a project, create resource custom fields, view resource engagements over many projects, create resource costs, material resources, and more...
  • Permissions management - Define who can access information on the projects with very granular detail


4. Project Online Desktop Client (desktop app)

The Project Online Desktop Client is the new Microsoft Project client (desktop app) that can be used for local project management and editing of MPP files. Desktop Client can also connect to PWA instances and manage the online projects and project teams.

Formerly, the Project Online client was known as Microsoft Project standard or Microsoft Project professional (depending on what license you had for the software). With the move into the cloud, Microsoft has combined these two project software into one application called "Project Online client".

For more information on how to get the client, please see Get Access To Project Online.

Right now, Project Online Project Web App (PWA) is available for existing Project Server 2013 customers, as well as customers who need customization's built on top of Project Online in order to cater to their business processes.

The Project Online Client is available for anyone who has M365 E3 license to use if the license is requested and granted.

There are some confusions about "Project Online" and "Project for the web". They're two different offerings from Microsoft.  Some users have reported the following issue, that's a part of the "Project for the Web" and it's NOT released yet in Bosch Tenant.

What licenses are available for Project Online?

Project Online has 3 different license types, with each one enabling more features within the Project Online PWA tool. The licenses are:

License NameFeaturesCostAvailability
Project Essentials (PE)Team member capabilities (submit timesheets, update task progress), no Project online client$Special User Base
Project Plan 3 (P3)Project Online client, Team member capabilities, project management, resource management€8.59/person/monthYes
Project Plan 5 (P5)Project Online client, Team member capabilities, project management, enhanced resource management, enhance portfolio management$$$$Special Request

For more information on licenses, you can view Microsoft's documentation here.


How can I get the Project Online client?

The Project Online client (P3 only) can be obtained by navigating to the IT Service Portal, and requesting the software through a specialized request which can be found here. P5 and PE licenses can only be granted in very special cases.

The P5 licenses are limited, you do need one for advanced Portfolio/Resource management on your PWA instance, you can create a Change/Request ticket here and specify "Project Plan 5" in the description.

For more information on the Project Online client and how to install it, you can take a look at the Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise page here.

How is the Project license removed/revoked?

License Management group has the process to re-harvest/revoke the Project licenses from users if the Project Online client is not used in 90 days. For details, you can refer to section 1.8.4 at here. Those users who are added to any of Project PWA instances or PRIME instance will not be affected by the license re-harvest process. We have a monthly process to extract all Project users from PWA instances and provide the list of those PWA users to License Managment group, and they will be excluded from the re-harvest process.

How can I get the Project Online Web App (PWA)?

Before a Project Online PWA will be created and access granted, a requirements session will be held with the customer to determine if a PWA is right for them.

To request a session, use the ordering service for a Project Online PWA: Project Online New Instances (Dedicated Collaboration Application – New)

General information

Microsoft Teams (Teams) is the successor of Skype for Business (SfB). Currently most of us are using Teams for daily chats, calls and meetings, but some features are only possible with limitations. 

Migration process is two-track. You can migrate on your own (Fast Line) using ITSP form (link below) or wait until the CI starts the migration of your account (Rollout). HERE you can check details and see how the rollout plan looks like.

You have the choice to start your migration from SfB to Teams and receive a couple of useful advantages, but note, that currently the Public Telephony (PT) is provided only in some locations and your too early start of the migration might lead to loss this feature completely. Interoperability between SfB and Teams

  

If a user, who is using SfB Only mode, contacts a user who is in Teams Only mode, or vice versa, the interoperability technology will ensure the communication between both parties.



 Technical limitations
  • Conversations are text-only. This means that there is no rich formatting, @mentions, emojis or any of the other chat features that are available in Teams chat experience.
  • Conversations are 1:1 only. Group chats are not supported.
  • Skype users cannot call Teams users who set up a call forwarding to another user's number, a delegate's number, or a Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) number. Only voicemail is supported.
  • Interop escalation, group calls, and meetings are not supported.
  • The possibility for a delegate to call a Skype user on behalf of a Teams user is not supported.
  • Screen sharing with chat is not supported.
Data security issue

When you share something in a Skype meeting and someone tries to ping you, the message is not displayed (doesn't appear) because the presentation mode is automatically set to "Do Not Disturb" (DND).

In a Teams meeting, if you share anything in Skype, DND is not set automatically, so when someone pings you confidential at this point, everyone in the meeting can see a popup chat, which is a security risk.

In this situation, the presenter should manually set DND mode when starting the Teams presentation.

page_name: How to get a new Office Store Add-in (incl. Teams)
html_content:
How to get a new Office Store Add-in (incl. Teams)


If you feel that you and your colleagues would benefit from a new Add-in, you are free to start the corresponding request. The process described below ensures that

  • the stability of the overall infrastructure is not endangered
  • legal constraints (e.g. GDPR) are observed so that Bosch does not incur liabilities
  • there is support for users
  • there is somebody who takes over responsibility for this Add-in

Please have a look at the information below and consider carefully whether you are the right person to start the request.

But remember: With great power comes great resposibility

If you do not feel up to the task, your department might consider using the Software Product Management as a Service - SPMaaS offering instead!


1. Who can start the request for a new Add-in?

All Bosch associates who have Microsoft 365 installed can start the process.


Small hint before you start:

You should be able to answer questions about

  • open source classification
  • the licensing model
  • the need for cloud onboarding
  • support for the Add-in
  • potential approval requirements from workers' council

These details are necessary during the application process and are required to comply with the relevant regulations so that all Bosch employees can safely use this app in future. 

Starting the process will mean that you will become the person responsible for the Add-in and take over the process tasks and legal responsibilities this entails (open source obligations, GDPR). You will be in charge of maintaining the Bosch internal documentation for this Add-in and you will need to provide a way to provide support within Bosch. Normally, this means you will have to get a service defined in the IT Service Desk Tool (SMT) and assign a support group with a minimum of five members.

If you do not feel up to taking this over or if your manager has objections, do not start the process! Please check with your Head of Department that s/he is fine for you to bring this task into the department!

Thank you for your understanding.

2. How do I start the Process?

2.1. Check whether the Add-in is already available (but maybe not for your department)

Use the Client Software Catalog and filter the field 'RBCM-ID' for 'Office Store'



Alternatively, we haven an overview here: https://inside-docupedia.bosch.com/confluence/x/eLfMc

If the Add-in is already available for a limited user group, you might contact the existing Software Product Manager to discuss whether s/he will take on responsibility for your user group or whether a separate onboarding is required.

If you need to start your own onboarding, we recommend to have a first discussion with the Software Consulting Service to see to what extent the existing onboarding can be referenced (potential issues; GB-specific OSS regulations, separate contracting...)

2.2. Get information on your Add-in and make sure you understand the onboarding process

If both your Head of Department gives you the green light to go ahead, go to the Microsoft Office Store page https://appsource.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/apps?product=office&page=1 and search for your Add-in. Check whether it really covers your use case, you might also want to see what reviews and ratings have been left by other users.

At this point, please also make sure you have read through this page and are comfortable with the tasks ahead!

2.3. Have a first informal discussion with the Software Product Manager of the parent product

If you want to proceed with the onboarding, do a first check whether there are any major objections from the SPM(s) of the parent product(s) - for a list of SPMs see below. If you decide to do some initial tests at this stage, you will need a user for the Q9 test environment - see here for information how to get a Q9 user.

Please note:
For SharePoint Online, the SPM is responsible to discuss the request and its possible implications within the SharePoint Governance Board to make sure no undesirable side-effects will occur.

2.4. Check the License and Open Source Compliance

You need to ensure that questions in relation to Open Source and licensing are covered. This check is also required for proprietary software!


The Bosch-internal software provider is responsible to ensure license compliance for Ordinary Use on Bosch managed-devices according to Central Directive for Third-Party Software (CD03016) and Open Source (CD04505). The Software Product Manager (SPM) is the software provider in scope of the SCCM release process.
In case of any questions please contact your Third-Party Software Officer (LINK) and Open Source Officer (LINK).
Please note: In case BD takes over the role of SPM, BD-VA 65 (BD Policy for Third-Party Software) and BD-VA 75 (BD Policy for Open Source) applies.
The user (“der Nutzende”) takes over the responsibility for license compliance in case the intended use is beyond ordinary use (e.g. Integration in products, redistribution in any other way).
In case of an update of the software package, the license compliance confirmation may remain on completed unless the license terms have changed.


A first overview of Open Source Topics can be found in this Web-based Training: [IP-OSS] Open Source Software I–B (WBT 3222)


Available license types include:

  • Third-Party Software (Freeware)
  • Open Source Software (OSS)
  • BOSCH Intellectual Property (e.g. self-development)
  • Third-Party software with commercial license (User authorization will be charged)
  • Third-Party software with commercial license (license included in service LASL)
  • Third-Party software with commercial license (license needs to be procured by using department / local site)
  • Third-Party software with commercial license (management by license server (e.g. FlexLM or others))
  • Third-Party software with commercial license (Corporate license)


2.5. Do the SaaS onboarding

Please note:

Ususally, third-party Add-ins provide a link between M365 offerings and SaaS applications.

  • If this SaaS application has already been onboarded for the same user group as targeted by the Add-in (i.e. SaaS onboarding completed), no further SaaS onboarding is required (e.g. centrally provided IT services like Mentimenter).
  • If this SaaS application has only been onboarded with a limited scope with respect to target group, security class, use case etc, and if the Add-in does not have the same scope, a SaaS onboarding workflow is required. In this workflow you can reference the existing one for the SaaS application.

The SaaS onboarding is not required if one of the following conditions apply:

  • The Add-in is hosted fully on-premise and does not connect to third-party cloud offerings (e.g. Confluence Add-in)
  • The Add-in is provided as part of the M365 environment (not all available Add-ins have been enabled from the start, e.g. OneNote Add-in)
  • Bosch development based on Power platform for MS Teams: Power platform for MS Teams is already onboarded for data up to C-SC2 → currently no inclusion of additional third-party interfaces / connectors is possible, so onboarding can be considered as already done (premium version which would allow this is currently being onboarded but will only provide approved connectors)
  • Bosch development based on Cognigy: onboarded for data up to C-SC2, for more information cf. https://connect.bosch.com/wikis/home?lang=en-us#!/wiki/W21f5ccf95781_46df_8809_d8efca1baedf/page/Bosch%20Chatbot%20Suite 

To get started on your SaaS onboarding, please check the official information (https://inside-docupedia.bosch.com/confluence/x/jqo7kw), and the FAQ (https://inside-docupedia.bosch.com/confluence/x/Bvhsng). Consulting for the WorkON and SaaS onboarding can be requested at the BD Technology and Business Consulting Organization.

2.6. Prepare support

Define how support for this Add-in will be ensured. There are three main possibilities:

  • Recommended: create a new service in SMT and assign either an existing solution group or create a dedicated solution group; if there is already a thematically related service, you can also just add a keyword there like 'xxxx Add-in for Teams' or 'xxxx Add-in for PowerPoint'
  • Alternatively, provide a functional mailbox address where different people have access and are able to provide support
  • Minimum requirement: provide two named associates who will ensure that at least one is available to provide support

If you consider a different way of providing support, please contact Prommersberger Karin (BD/WPA-WCS4) to discuss options.

2.7. Get confirmation from your Head of Department

We have prepared an e.mail template which you can fill in and send to your Head of Department: HoD_Approval_for_Add-in.oft

  • Fill in your cost center

  • Fill in the WA ID (for a self-developed Teams Add-in use the Add-in ID that is assigned when uploading it to Teams)

    Go to the Microsoft Office Store page https://appsource.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/apps?product=office&page=1 and search for your Add-in; in the URL, take the WA ID and put it in the appropriate entry field

  • Enter the Base Product, that is the product in which the Add-in will be used (e.g. Word, PowerPoint, Teams)
  • Send the e.mail to your Head of Department and ask them to reply to your mail
    • with a signed e.mail
    • confirming that they are fine with the department taking over responsibility for the Add-in

You will need to attach this confirmation to your request workflow.

2.8. Start the workflow

Congratulations! If you have completed the previous steps, you are now ready to trigger the workflow.

  1. Go to https://rb-tracker.bosch.com/tracker17/servicedesk/customer/portal/17/group/705 and choose 'Office Store Add-In'
  2. Go to the Microsoft Office Store page https://appsource.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/apps?product=office&page=1 and search for your Add-in; in the URL, take the WA ID and put it in the appropriate entry field
  3. Fill out all further fields with the appropriate information as gathered in the previous steps

    Available license types include:

    • Third-Party Software (Freeware)
    • Open Source Software (OSS)
    • BOSCH Intellectual Property (e.g. self-development)
    • Third-Party software with commercial license (User authorization will be charged)
    • Third-Party software with commercial license (license included in service LASL)
    • Third-Party software with commercial license (license needs to be procured by using department / local site)
    • Third-Party software with commercial license (management by license server (e.g. FlexLM or others))
    • Third-Party software with commercial license (Corporate license)
  4. Add the confirmation from your Head of Department that s/he approves of the request and the tasks that will result of it (as stated in the previous chapter, please use this e.mail template: HoD_Approval_for_Add-in.oft )
  5. Start the workflow by clicking on 'Create' at the bottom; the workflow steps can be seen here: OfficeStore_WF.pdf

2.9. Be available for additional questions and testing

At this point at the latest, there will be some tests of the Add-in with a limited number of users. Depending on the base product, the tests will take place in the Q9 test environment and testers will need a user for the Q9 test environment - see here for information how to get a Q9 user.

Please note:
All self-developed chatbots will have to have at least two technical owners to ensure updates can still be uploaded when one of the owners is not available (e.g, has left the company).

2.10. Testing in production environment and rollout

Be available for testing in the production environment and for coordination of rollout schedules.

During rollout, you will have to answer the question which of the options should be applied to your Add-in:

  • Fixed: Automatically pre-installed, cannot be removed by the users
  • Optional: Automatically pre-installed, but can be removed by the users 
  • Available: Not installed automatically, the users can trigger the installation if they want to use the Add-in

2.11. Enjoy

If all required steps are completed successfully, the app will be made available in the parent application and will be listed in the Client Software Catalog

You will still receive regular requests to check your Add-in to make sure that information on license agreements, responsibilities etc are still up to date.





3. Who can I contact for questions?

For questions on this process, you can contact the Product and Service Manager for the Microsoft Office Store: Prommersberger Karin (BD/WPA-WCS4) (Proxy: Mitschelen Tanja-Iris (BD/WPA-WCS4))

General questions for software onboarding can be addressed to the Software Consulting Service.

The Software Product Managers of the parent products can also provide product-specific information see the list of SPMs below.


4. Who are the SPMs for the parent products?

The following colleagues have the Software Product Manager role for the parent products (or have been nominated by the SPMs to act on their behalf):

Microsoft Forms General Information

🔎 TIP: Use Ctrl + F to find the content you are searching for on this site.

💬 If you do not find the answers here, you can raise your questions in the Online Survey Tools @ Bosch Forum.

What is Microsoft Forms?

Microsoft Forms is an application for creating Surveys, Quizes, or Polls and visualizing the results. It is the successor of the previous “Survey” feature in Microsoft Office products.

It supports both Anonymous surveys and Non-anonymous as well as external and internal surveys.

You can create a new form from scratch or use a template.

It can be used to:

  • Create a Survey, Quiz, or a Poll with various question types.
    • Question Types available:
      • Choice (single or multiple answers)
      • Text
      • Rating
      • Date
      • Ranking
      • Likert
      • File Upload (only allowed for internal surveys)
      • Net Promoter Score
  • Share the survey to participants via a link, QR code or email:
    • Available settings for sharing:
      • Anyone can respond
      • Only people in my organization can respond
      • Specific people in my organization can respond
    • You can find more information below.
  • Evaluate the survey results in the built-in Dashboard, or export the survey results in Excel.
    • Functions:
      • Display Feedback summary
      • Display Individual feedback
      • Open all feedback data in Excel
  • Other functionalities:
    • Live poll in Microsoft Teams meeting
    • Visualize Open-Text Responses with Word Clouds (Insights)
    • Available in both Desktop and Mobile
    • AI-assisted poll creation for Teams meeting presenters

How to access Microsoft Forms

You can access Microsoft Forms by going to https://forms.office.com

Microsoft Forms Integrations

Microsoft Forms is integrated with many other Microsoft 365 Apps so that users can use them together.

*OneNote add-in currently not available

Access and Permissions

Survey Participants

  • Permissions: Survey owner can decide if this survey can be accessed by:

    • Anyone can respond (internal or external users)

      • This response will be anonymous, participants does not need to login.

    • Only people in my organization can respond (Any internal Bosch users)

      • This response can be set as anonymous or non-anonymous. For non-anonymous surveys, participants must login to provide responses.

      • Responses can be limited to one per user.

    • Specific people in my organization can respond (Specific internal Bosch users)

      • This response can be set as anonymous or non-anonymous. For non-anonymous surveys, participants must login to provide responses.

      • Responses can be limited to one per user.

The results are saved to an Excel file which can be directly viewed in Excel Online.

Depending on how the form was created, the Responses file location is different.

  • Normal Form: OneDrive
  • Group Form: Sharepoint

The Form, poll, question, and response limits

  • How many forms/quizzes can a user create?  Up to 400

  • How many polls can a user create?  Up to 400

  • How many questions per form/quiz are allowed?  Up to 200

  • How many responses can a form/quiz receive?  Up to 5,000,000

*Forms that exceed 50,000 responses will not have all of the same functionality online but can continue to collect responses and have those responses exported via .csv for further review.

*Groups have a separate limit of Up to 400 forms. The 400 forms you and your team can create are in addition to the 400 single forms you can create as an individual.

  • Specific people in my organization can respond - You can designate a total of up to 100 individual names or group names. Of the 100 limit, you can designate up to 20 groups (each group can contain up to 1,000 individuals). For example, you can collect responses from 80 individuals and 20 groups for a total of 100.

General Survey Use Cases in Bosch

Microsoft Forms not only supports survey, poll or questionnaire use cases, some other type of use cases like Audits, Registration, Workflow…etc. can also be created in Microsoft Forms.

Following are some examples of main survey types in Bosch, which are all supported by Microsoft Forms:

  • Internal or External Customer Satisfaction Surveys

  • Products and Services UX Survey

  • Employees / Associates Surveys

  • Registrations & Events feedback

  • Training feedback

  • Research surveys

  • Marketing surveys

  • Audits

  • ...etc.

More possibilities are supported by Microsoft Forms together with Power Automate.

Is it necessary to get a works council approval?

For all internal RB feedback surveys that include associates working in a country with works council presence, survey owners must obtain additional works council approval. (Even though a general approval from works council for using this survey tool in Bosch was already obtained before go-live)

Please note:

If your survey needs to include SC3 data (e.g. Auditing survey, ...etc.) or Special Categories of personal data (Definition of special categories of pD: see Art. 9 GDPR), please check below advices:

Strictly Confidential Meetings (C-SC3)


Check our Overview Secuirty Classes. If you are not sure about the security class of your meeting, please check with your local DSO first.

⚪ C-SC3 equals the "C3" classification for BSH.

Please note that Microsoft Teams meetings are hosted in the Microsoft Cloud. Click here for a detailed explanation of risks and measures.



Meetings with strictly confidential information (C-SC3)
require extra security measures to protect Bosch and our business


Together with Microsoft, Bosch has implemented industry standards to ensure the best possible security for strictly confidential (C-SC3) meetings.

The below measures are obligatory for all meetings in Microsoft Teams with strictly confidential content (C-SC3).

Always stay cautious and attentive!


Meeting options

Meetings with strictly confidential content (C-SC3) require more strict meeting settings than the default. You must set the meeting options as described below ⬇.

Check the identity of participants

Guests participating via Browser (Web App) can easily alter their displayed name and participate with a false identity in the meeting. Since external communication partners usually do not have a Bosch account, they frequently participate via Web App.

No strictly confidential (C-SC3) chats / attachments / documents

Do not put strictly confidential information (C-SC3) in any Microsoft Teams chat (1:1 chats, group chats, and meeting chats).

Do not upload strictly confidential documents (C-SC3) to the cloud. Details can be found here. Real-time desktop sharing of C-SC3 documents is allowed, but note that attendees can take screenshots or photos. 

No recording of strictly confidential (C-SC3) meetings

Please be aware that participants can always make screenshots or record the shared screen.

No dial-in via phone

...or any other external or mobile phone. Connections via the public telephone network are not encrypted. Instead use an Microsoft Teams endpoint (client, Microsoft Teams conference device, Microsoft Teams Mobile App). The safest solution is to use so called end-to-end encryption.



Microsoft Teams Meeting Options

You must set the meeting options as follows:

  1. Schedule a meeting in Outlook or directly in Microsoft Teams
     
  2. In the meeting footer, click on Meeting options


  3. Set the Meeting Options as follows:

or

Note: To turn off the "Allow Forwarding" setting of the Outlook meeting, go to Meeting > Response Options in the Outlook meeting invitation.

No (Default)

Yes (Default)

Note: The sound only appears for callers dialing in via telephone. If you are joining via Teams client, no sound will appear.
Please note that joining meetings by phone is pricey.

Who can present?

or

or

Note: Strictly confidential content (C-SC3) is not allowed in the chat  

Further information on meeting options can be found here: Microsoft Teams Meeting Options and  What is the meeting chat?

Please note that you cannot save these settings. Every new meeting will automatically appear with the default meeting options.


For advanced meeting protection check details in "Teams additional feature package" section.




SC3 calls

SC3 calls via PSTN to the public network
  • No admission for SfB.
  • No admission for Teams.
  • Encryption is not possible because the destination number can be anywhere in the world without any known technical requirements.


Internal SC3 calls
  1. Possible for SfB, as we are located within Bosch with the telephone infrastructure (SfB on Bosch hosts servers)
  • Of course, a third party could also "spy" on a conversation without authorization within Bosch.
  • Skype calls can be switched to cell phones on-the-fly and then you are back on the public network.

       2. Limited for Teams?

  • All calls go through the MS Cloud.
  • They are generally encrypted by Microsoft; which guarantees that Microsoft is not "listening in", but to secure your call you should use end-to-end encryption (check details HERE).
  • End-to-end encryption can be explicitly activated again, but this must then be agreed by both participants BEFORE (this is also an Microsoft solution in the end).

Conclusion: If you do not agree on end-to-end encryption in advance or generally distrust Microsoft, there is no solution for "switching" during a call if it "drifts" in the direction of SC3.

Teams Public Telephony

🔎 TIP: Use Ctrl + F to find the content you are searching for on this site.

💬 If you do not find the answers here, see here how to get support.

For BSH users

This article is not valid for BSH users except of BSH South Africa where Public Telephony is already implemented.

General Information

Teams Public Telephony is an optional service for Microsoft Teams. If this service is enabled for you, it will provide you the possibility to call internal and external telephone numbers like e. g. +49 711 811 3311.

In addition this service will provide you a standard landline telephone number to be called from standard telephone devices. 

The plan is to provide this service at all locations, where currently the Skype for Business Public Telephony service is offered.


For using Teams Public Telephony your user account needs to be migrated to Microsoft Teams Only mode!

The functionality of Public Telephony:

Main differences between SfB and Teams




Public Telephony was already available for Skype for Business. Generally, for Public Telephony in Microsoft Teams, the same features are available as for Skype for Business. Below, you will find differences in Teams Public Telephony:

FunctionSkype for BusinessTeams
Client


  • Independent client (just for usage of telephony, chat, remote and video)


Hub including extended features additionally to telephony, chat, remote and video:

  • Teams rooms
  • Extended calendar
  • Additional apps (One Note, Tasks etc.)
  • Access to embedded Sharepoint Online space
  • Interactive and powerful search bar
File exchange

  • File exchange limited focused primarily on local client storage. Pictures e.g. need to be downloaded and viewed from local drive.


  • "Files" - File exchange experience different by offering cloud-based storage (e.g Sharepoint online).
  • Local storage can be additionally used to store e.g. media.
Chat
  • Chat design has limited capability of text and pictures.

Chat layout has been optimized with extended capability of text and pictures (e.g. embedding videos, links, layout)
Chat history
  • Conversations button.
  • History can be found in Mail client Outlook
  • 1:1 chat & Group chat


Chat with different perspectives and purpose:

  • "Activity" showing overall conversations you're member of (Feeds) or personal activities (My Activity)
  • 1:1 chat & Group chat (ad hoc meetings and remote collaboration)
  • Teams rooms with several possibilities to collaborate with others
Calendar

  • Daily view
  • Participation in a particular appointment on limited time frame

  • Detailed Weekly overview (Pre-requiste: Exchange Online)
  • Scheduling of meetings within calendar possible (Pre-requiste: Exchange Online)
  • Scheduling meetings within Teams rooms
  • Planning of breakout rooms possible
Apps

  • Several possibilities to extend Teams client with functionalities of additional apps (e.g. OneNote, Tasks, PowerBI)
Mobile experience

  • User experience with mobile apps limited
  • Participation in meetings with app could be better
  • Usage of just one client allowed and possible



  • Different additional "nodes" (e.g. mobile apps, 2nd device) can be used and lead to a much better user experience
  • Different kind of audio channels can be used (e.g. Overear can be exchanged easily by an InEar headset)
  • One can join easily with a mobile client or desktop (and vice versa) to a group call
Software

  • Client on desktop crucial for a good user experience
  • Webclient usage possible, but limited functions
  • Sharing just on desktop client. On mobile devices this was not possible
  • Participating in meetings was easier with call back then with internet data connection. ( Possibility of additional costs and poor call quality)

  • With M365 Teams can be used additionally in a web based application environment as well e.g to open more than one platform
  • Seamless working by offering stable mobile app, desktop and web application (User is recognized as one login)
  • Easy understanding of handling
  • Sharing with Teams app on mobile devices now possible as well
New Features

  • Limited to client offered client versions

  • Evergreen approach offers continuously optimization of features (e.g. implementation of apps, bugfixes, search bar). This leads a complete new user experience.
  • Existing functions can be extended if required

How to set a simultaneous ringing

Simultaneous ringing can be directly set by using option "Also ring". First option would be to set a single number/person who is received a call.

Additionally a group can be created and set as proxy to ring.

Delegation (manager-admin/manager-assistant)

Delegation (also known as manager-admin/manager-assistant) is a feature, that enables you (manager) to grate another user (assistant) to answer,  make calls or forwarding calls on your behalf in Microsoft Teams.


How to set up delegation

  1. Click Setting and more (three dots next to your profile photo in MS Teams client).

  2. Select Settings>General, and then select Manage delegates.

       3. Select Your delegates and type the person's name.

       4. Select the Join active calls check box and select the Add button. 

Your delegate gets notified about their new status in the Teams chat.

Your new delegate will now appear in your delegates list, and this list will be a default selection in your call forwarding and simultaneous ring options.



NOTE

  • Delegates can see when you’re on a call and who it’s with.

  • Any calls made or received by you or on your behalf can be put on hold or resumed by you or your delegates.

  • You can view call history of delegators and delegates for calls made or received.

  • If a voice mail is set during your absence, your delegate will receive the voice mail.

    You can only set a delegate who is using PT

How to make and receive calls as a delegator

View and join active calls handled by a delegate.  


How to make and receive calls as a delegate
  • See all managers’ lines on the top bar and switch easily between lines. 

  • Delegates can view their fellow delegates, if any, for that delegate.

  • If permitted, join active calls on the manager’s line. 

  • View call history per manager line for calls made or received by you, as a delegate, on behalf of your manager.

 


How to change your manager`s call and delegate settings

As a delegate, you can view and edit call and delegate settings on behalf of someone else. 

  1. Select Settings and more   next to your profile picture at the top of Teams and choose Settings > General.

  2. Select Manage delegates under Delegation.

  3. Click People you support. Here, you'll see a list of the people you're a delegate for. Hover on any name in the list and hit More options  to see your choices: View permissions, Change delegates, and Change call settings.

  4. Choose View permissions to edit the permissions of any of your boss's delegates, Change delegates to add or remove delegates for your boss, or Change call settings to adjust their call settings for them.


Shared call history

Shared call history allows call delegators and delegates to track who made or answered calls and review detailed event history.

Delegation FAQs
QuestionAnswer
How are calls transferred in case the manager forwards a call to a delegate who has set their status on "offline"/"do not disturb"?The call forwarding still works
How are calls transferred in case the manager forwards a call to a delegate who is really offline?

Incoming calls are directly to the voicemail of the manager

How are calls transferred in case both manager and delegate are not reachable?

The manager gets the message of a missed call and gets the message on the voicemail

What will happen if the manager has set his configuration to "Also ring" (new/simultaneously ring)Calls addressed for the manager result in incoming calls of the manager and the delegate in parallel. 
What will happen if the manager is not available but has set simultaneously ring to his/her delegate which is available?Only the delegate receives the call.
Does the delegate need to be signed in to his Teams Client, once he has activated simultaneously ring to his mobile phone?Yes, if the delegate is not signed in to his Teams Client, incoming calls will be forwarded to the Voice Mail of the manager.
Is it possible to transfer a call from the delegates mobile phone to the manager?

Yes. 

Can the delegate receive calls when he/she is not available, but has set up simultaneously ring/also ring to his/her mobile phone?Yes.
Can the manager set a call forward to the delegates and his/her mobile phone, to ringing parallel if a call comes in?The manager can only configure simultaneously ring to either the delegates Teams or to his/her mobile phone.
Solution*: The manager configures simultaneously ring to the delegates Teams Client and the delegate configures simultaneously ring to the manager`s mobile phone.

 *Note: If the delegate is not available (Offline/DND) in Teams, simultaneously ring to the manager`s mobile phone will not work! 
How can I assign different delegation rights?If you want to know how to assign different rights for your delegates, click here. ("Assign different delegation rights") 
How can the manager ensure, that incoming calls will be forwarded to one of his/her delegates?The manager must assign within Teams settings that one of the available delegates, who can receive calls on his/her behalf.
What if the manager forgets to set another delegate?

The delegates should activate simultaneously ring to each other.
If delegate A is not available, calls will be forwarded to delegate B and the other way around.

 Note: It's recommended to use this solution as an exception only, because the delegates will not be able to see if the incoming call is for the manager or not.


Team call groups

This feature is useful if the user who gets the call isn’t at his desk or in another call for example.
Each user can create an own team call group with team members who can answer calls instead of her-/himself after a defined period of time. This can be configured in the call forwarding settings. When there is an incoming call, all team member phones ring and any user in the team can pick up the phone to answer the call.


For which settings you can set up a call group

You can set up a call group for the following settings: 

  • "If unanswered"
  • "Also ring" 
  • "Forward my calls" 
How to set the call group function

1. On the upper right hand corner, select your picture then Settings 

2. From the drop down, select Call Group

3. Add the names of the people you want to add to this call group


NOTE You can have a MAX of 25 users in your call group.


4. At the bottom of the screen, pick the order you want people in your call group to receive your calls. 

 

5. Select Save.

How to delete a user from the call group

Select the user and click on the "X" on the right of their name.

Does my number stay the same when I change my department?

If you move to a department in the same area (new location has the same number as the old one e.g. 0711 811 ...), you can keep the number.
If you move to a location with a different number, you need to get a new number.

As all of your other data needs be adjusted anyway (e.g. office location, cost center, ...), get in contact with your local IT partner to guarantee a smooth change with correct data.

How to quit Public Telephony


Before you make your final decision, please consider the following important notes:

  • Participation in internal as well as external Teams / Skype for Business conferences is still possible.
  • You will not be able to call any external phone numbers by your SfB or Teams client. This also applies for emergency calls, e.g. 112 or 911 and Bosch internal service hotlines, e.g. IT Service Desk (-3311) or HR Service hotline. You will have to use another phone to reach these numbers.
  • You will lose your fixed landline number with a geographical association to your location without any reservation for future use. You will no longer be able to receive internal and external calls on this number via Public Telephony feature.
  • All your current telephony configurations like call groups and call forwarding settings will be reset to default.

💡If you decide to unsubscribe from Public Telephony, you can request the service at any time if necessary.


If you notice low or no usage of your Public Telephony, consider removing the service via self-service. To do that:

  • Click here to open the ITSP form "Public Telephony (Teams, Skype for Business, Avaya)"
  • If the link does not work, try refreshing the page (F5 key)
  • Click on Order for Self and a new windows opens
  • Read and follow the instructions next to Important Note
  • Next to Select Extension, select the Public Telephony number
  • Next to Action, select Delete this extension
  • Click on Submit

If the ITSP order form is not available to you, please create the ticket.

What is Power Apps?

**Power Platform M365 is now live worldwide. 

Power Apps is a low-code suite of apps, services, connectors and data platform that provides a rapid application development environment to build custom apps for your business needs.

What's in it for you?

  • Using Power Apps, you can quickly build custom business apps that connect to your business data stored either in the underlying data platform (Microsoft Dataverse) or in various online and on-premises data sources (SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, SQL Server, and so on), even without much coding experience.
  • Power Apps also provides an extensible platform that let pro developers programmatically interact with data and metadata, apply business logic, create custom connectors, and integrate with external data.

For more information, watch Power Apps demos


Power Apps with Premium Feature

Power Apps Premium licenses offer the use of premium connectors in Power Apps and allow for the use of certain premium connectors in Power Automate that are within the Power App context. As Power Apps is a low-code development platform, users can easily create Apps even without mature coding experience.

Power Platform Premium is currently in the EAN phase until our planned Go Live in 2024.  The registration of Power Platform Premium use cases is currently only available for selected license variants:

  • Power Apps per user
  • Power Automate per user

How to request Power Platform Premium License?

  • Register Use Case: As an App Owner, please register your app/use case via Power Platform Use Case Registration App. After you have completed your Registration successfully, the Power Platform Admin Team will review your request, assign you the respective D & Q Premium environment and send a confirmation email with all required information after fulfillment.

    Note: To choose the right environment, please refer to our environment concept here.

  • Apply for Premium License via PPUMA: To apply for a Power Platform Premium license you need to submit the License Order Form and select the required premium license category, therefore the HOD approval and alignment with your respective BDO is required to confirm the request. After your request has been approved the Power Platform Admin Team will validate your order request and assign the required licenses to the respective users.

  • Develop/Migrate use case: After your premium license has been assigned to you, you can start to develop your app or flow in the assigned dev Premium environment. If your app is developed and hosted in a Personal Productivity or dev Standard Environment, you must migrate your app or flow to the provided dev Premium environment.


Note: When you migrate your app or flow, please refer to Export/Import Solutions from between environments
          When you develop your app or flow, please refer to Power Platform Development Guidelines


Power Apps Integrations

Power Apps can be used in four scenarios with Teams.

  • Embed a canvas app as a tab app: Use the Power Apps tab for Teams to embed a canvas app as a tab app in Microsoft Teams. The canvas app integrates business data from a wide variety of Microsoft and third-party data sources, including Dataverse.
  • Embed a canvas app as a personal app: Embed a canvas app as a first-class Teams personal app. The canvas app integrates business data from a wide variety of Microsoft and third-party data sources, including Dataverse.
  • Embed a model-driven app as a tab app: currently not supported in the standard Bosch Microsoft 365 License.
  • Create apps in Teams backed by Microsoft Dataverse for Microsoft Teams: Licensing and restrictions apply.


Data Security Regulations

Data with Security Class 2 (SC2) and below can be processed in Power Apps. SC3 is strictly not allowed and supported by Power Apps

  • For more details on security classes, please refer to this Document.


Do I need an additional license?

Currently Power Platform is included in Bosch Microsoft 365 E3 License. For Power Platform usage in the context of Microsoft 365, no extra license is required.

For Power Apps, this means that the usage is limited to Canvas Apps creation and Standard Connectors only. Model-Driven Apps and Power Pages are NOT included in the current Bosch Microsoft 365 E3 License.

Model-driven app design is a component-focused approach to app development.

What is Power Automate?

Power automate allows you to automate workflows across applications. You can use the automation flows to connect email and instant message alerts, synchronize files between applications, copy files from one application to another, collect data from one app and store it in another, and more.

What's in it for you?

  • Power Automate is very well suited for implementing workflows based on triggers. This enables tasks or chains of simple tasks to be automated.
  • You can use Power Automate to automate your manual and repetitive processes so that you can focus on higher-value tasks.

For more information, watch Power automate demos


What is Power Automate Desktop?

Desktop flows broaden the existing robotic process automation (RPA) capabilities in Power Automate and enable you to automate all repetitive desktop processes. It’s quicker and easier than ever to automate with the new intuitive Power Automate desktop flow designer using the prebuilt drag-and-drop actions or recording your own desktop flows to run later.

Leverage automation capabilities in Power Automate. Create flows, interact with everyday tools such as email and excel or work with modern and legacy applications. Examples of simple and complex tasks you can automate are:

  •     Quickly organize your documents using dedicated files and folders actions
  •     Accurately extract data from websites and store them in excel files using Web and Excel automation
  •     Apply desktop automation capabilities to put your work on autopilot

Desktop flows are addressed to home users, small businesses, enterprises or larger companies. They're addressed essentially to everyone who is performing simple or complex rule-based tasks on their workstations.

Power Automate Desktop supports security class up to SC2. SC3 is strictly not allowed and supported by Power Automate Desktop.


*The RPA Unattended Add-on requires a user to have a Power Automate Premium per user license variant as a pre-requisite. RPA Unattended license will enable users to run fully automated bots without manual intervention.

For more information, please check this doculink


Power Automate Integrations

Various connectors can be used for Power Automate to trigger flows or take actions from/in e.g. MS Teams, MS Forms, Outlook, Sharepoint Online...etc.

  • Click HERE to see general information about connectors

Using Power Apps, Power BI and Power Automate together can unleash huge benefits and enhance your solutions. One of the biggest advantages of using Power apps, Power BI and Power Automate together is the ability write back data to the source system.  Power BI is natively a read-only tool, allowing users to see their data. Power Apps and Power Automate provide a great way to be able to modify this data directly.


Data Security Regulations

Power Automate supports security class up to SC2.

SC3 is strictly not allowed and supported by Power Automate.

  • For more details security classes, please refer to this Document.


Do I need an additional license?

Currently Power Platform service is included in Bosch Microsoft 365 E3 License. For Power Platform usage in the context of Microsoft 365, no extra license is required.

For Power Automate, this means that the usage is limited to standard connectors and these types of flows: Automated cloud flow, Instant cloud flow, Scheduled cloud flow, and Desktop flow.

  • Click HERE to see more information about cloud flows.
  • Click HERE to see more information about desktop flows. (You will need to install the Power Automate Desktop to create desktop flows, more information will be shared here at a later point of time)

*Business process flows are NOT included in the Bosch Microsoft 365 E3 License.

  • Click HERE to see more information about business process flows in conditions in advanced mode.
  • Click HERE to see what are the Standard connectors
  • Click HERE to see what are the Premium and custom connectors
  • Click HERE to see general information about connectors

    Note: To choose the right environment, please refer to our environment concept here.

  • Apply for Premium License via PPUMA: To apply for a Power Platform Premium license you need to submit the License Order Form and select the required premium license category, therefore the HOD approval and alignment with your respective BDO is required to confirm the request. After your request has been approved the Power Platform Admin Team will validate your order request and assign the required licenses to the respective users.

  • Develop/Migrate use case: After your premium license has been assigned to you, you can start to develop your app or flow in the assigned dev Premium environment. If your app is developed and hosted in a Personal Productivity or dev Standard Environment, you must migrate your app or flow to the provided dev Premium environment.


Note: When you migrate your app or flow, please refer to Export/Import Solutions from between environments

What is Microsoft Copilot Studio?

Microsoft Copilot Studio is an adaptable Artificial Intelligence (AI) copilot, at your service. It can handle common questions and issues from external customers and the interior, freeing up staff to focus on complex requests and high-value interactions. You can easily create your own copilot without the need for developers or data scientists, by using a guided, no-code graphical interface.

What's in it for you?

  • Microsoft Copilot Studio lets you create powerful copilots that can answer questions posed by your customers, other employees, or visitors to your website or service.
  • These bots can be created easily without the need for data scientists or developers. Some of the ways that  Microsoft Copilots have been used include:
    • COVID-19 infection rate and tracking information
    • Sales help and support issues
    • Opening hours and store information
    • Employee health and vacation benefits
    • Common employee questions for businesses

For more information, watch Microsoft Copilot Studio Demos


Microsoft Copilot Integrations

Microsoft Copilot Studio is available as an app within Microsoft Teams, which means you can easily create your own chatbots that answer questions posed by other employees or team members.

You can add Microsoft Copilot Studio from the Microsoft Teams app store (the app is still named Power Virtual Agents) and begin to create, author, test, and publish your bot directly into the teams, all within the Microsoft Teams interface.

More Information: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/fundamentals-what-is-copilot-studio


Data Security Regulations

Data with Security Class 2 (SC2) and below can be processed in Microsoft Copilot Studio.

SC3 is strictly not allowed and supported by Microsoft Copilot Studio.

  • For more details security classes, please refer to this Document.


Do I need an additional license?

Microsoft Copilot Studio for Teams:

Microsoft Copilot Studio for Teams enables customers to build conversational interfaces within Microsoft Teams. The chatbots can use data stored in Microsoft Dataverse for Teams or many other sources using the supplied standard connectors.

For Power Platform usage in the context of Microsoft 365, no extra license is required. You can create chatbots using Microsoft Copilot Studio for Teams (the app is still named Power Virtual Agents):  https://aka.ms/PVAForTeams and share with your team member.


Microsoft Copilot Studio:

Currently it's still in EAN phase and not released. A Copilot Studio per user license is required for Premium and assigned to Bosch Tenant. See also the order page.

  • Premium connectors available for flows triggered from Copilot.
  • Ability to extend copilot with Microsoft Bot Framework skills.
  • Ability to use Microsoft Copilot Studio Web App

Release an App/Chatbot to other colleagues in Power Platform

Via Power Platform EAN access (Office 365 E3 License), you are able to develop basic Applications and Chatbots and release them to your colleagues/teams/departments. If you plan to release a team/department/organization App/Chatbots, please note:

  • It is recommended for all App/Chatbot makers to take the Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Fundamentals PL-900 training in order to ensure the quality of the application/chatbot; and to watch the Power Platform in Bosch introduction video to understand about Power Platform in Bosch.
  • You need to take full responsibility of your App/Chatbot in terms of development, quality assurance, compliance and operations/maintenance.
  • Regarding to data security / personal data handling, you should inform your users that what and how the personal data are being processed in your App/Chatbot. Power Platform supports data of security class up to SC2. SC3 data is strictly NOT allowed. You can consult your DSO if anything is unclear.

In Launchpad: https://inside.bosch.com/irj/portal/fiori#Shell-home

Im Portal gibt es 2 Möglichkeiten, um Launchpad zu starten (siehe Bild unten):

Auf der Übersicht der NGW (Next Generation Workplace) Produkte im Connect: https://connect.bosch.com/wikis/home?lang=de-de#!/wiki/W62210e629477_48ae_ae3c_52239b0630fe/page/Overview

Externals


🔎 TIP: Use Ctrl + F to find the content you are searching for on this site.

💬 If you do not find the answers here, see here how to get support.


Overview


Collaboration with externals can be clustered as follows:


A Bosch associate invites an external partner to join the collaboration.

An external partner invites a Bosch associate to join the collaboration.

Direct Chat / Call
Federation

  Federation is possible with external companies via Microsoft Teams and Skype for Business (SfB).


Meetings
similar to Skype for Business audio / video conferences

 Bosch employee can create a Microsoft Teams meeting and invite externals.

As always, everybody receives an Outlook meeting invitation.


Bosch employee can be invited from an external company to a Microsoft Teams meeting.

As always, everybody receives an Outlook meeting invitation.

Join a team
Collaborate with externals in a team room.

 It is possible to invite "EXTERNAL.max-smith@de.bosch.com" to a Bosch Teams room:

You need the role (1) External Standard Identity

 

 

Bosch employee can be invited to a Team from an external company.

  • Please be aware that the external company is the owner of all data shared in the external team. Please contact your Data Security Partner (DSP) if you have any questions.

  • The external company needs to invite the Bosch user via their Bosch e-mail address.

You need an IdM Role:

  • Instructions for RB users: Click here for instructions.
  • Instructions for BSH users: 

1. Go to BSH serviceportal: https://bsh.service-now.com/

2. Navigate to: Access and User Accounts > Internet > Internet Access

3. Select "Add".

4. Enter your name.

5. Select "Extended Internet Web Access".

6. Select "Non Bosch Office365-Tenants"

7. Enter the reason for this requirement, e.g. "required for collaboration with external company xyz".

8. Click on "choose options".

9. Finish your order process by clicking on check out and confirm it.

For further details, see here: Joining a team from an external company

  It is possible to invite "max-smith@porsche.com" to a Bosch Teams room:

You need the role (2) External Collaboration Identity 




External 


External identities are typically assigned to persons who have a working contract with companies other than the Bosch group but who work in the Bosch network. To get the user types, click here.

These allow you to invite an external person to a Bosch Teams room:


How to distinguish both user types:


(1) External Standard Identity

(2) External Collaboration Identity

📧 EXTERNAL.max-smith@de.bosch.com

📧 max-smith@porsche.com

External company address

How to get it?

1. User creation: ITSP link (choose user type)

2. License assignment: ITSP link

Bosch devices Can work with Bosch hardware Cannot work with Bosch hardware - use their own device
Non-Bosch devices Can only work with own hardware Can only work with own hardware
Chat, calling, working on the same files (via SharePoint Online) Can use full Microsoft Teams functionalities, just like any other Bosch employee

External Collaboration Identity can only start a chat or call with the Bosch employee who's in the same Teams room, and find the members via the search bar, after being invited to a certain Teams room. But External Collaboration Identity cannot approach all the other Bosch employee, and no search results will show up. More limitations for External Collaboration Identity, please check here.

As a Bosch user, you can contact an External Collaboration Identity directly. It is the same as approaching other Bosch colleagues: e.g. searching them, calling, chatting.

Private channel

 Can be added to a private channel Can be added to a private channel

Adding applications to a Bosch team

 Can use full Microsoft Teams functionalities, just like any other Bosch employee An External Collaboration Identity cannot add more applications to a Bosch team. The "+" button is not visible for External Collaboration Identity. However, once additional app is inserted in a team/channel by a Bosch associate, they can access and use them.

Network access

 They have an access because they have a Bosch hardware.

They don`t have an access except of Remote Shopfloor Access (RSA)

  • No access to IT applications within the Bosch network! (not applicable for RSA)
  • External persons are not allowed to log on via Cisco VPN (RSA allowed), "CoRASon for Externals", VDI (Virtual Desktop Infrastructure), etc.!

Assigning tasks

Can be assigned tasks by a regular Bosch associate

Can work on tasks

Finding public teams


 Can use full Microsoft Teams functionalities, just like any other Bosch employee External Collaboration Identity cannot actively find a public team room via the search function. If a Bosch user wants to invite an External Collaboration Identity to a public team, the External Collaboration Identity has to be added / invited manually

Working on documents


 Works just the same as for any other Bosch employee.

Once an External Collaboration Identity is invited to a Bosch team, they can work on the documents together with Bosch associates stored in the dedicated SharePoint Online Site. More details please go through here. Some known limitations of files and access for External Collaboration Identity, please check here.


How to work with two different external user identities?

(1) External Standard Identity

How to invite an External Standard Identity to a team room

The following describes the use case of inviting an External Standard Identity (e.g. EXTERNAL.Maxx.Smith@bosch.com) to join a Microsoft Teams team room hosted by Bosch.

Prerequisites

  • Externals need to have a Bosch account (e.g. abc5fe@bosch.com) configured with valid e-mail address like external.maxx.smith@us.bosch.com

  • Externals need to have a Bosch managed personal device to access the Bosch Teams platform.

Get access

  • A Standard External need to have a Teams license. The license will not be provided automatically. You need to order the license for the External. This can be easily done via this ITSP Service
  • Please follow the steps to invite them on the Get Access to Microsoft Teams page. Steps 2 + 3 need to be carried out by the External Standard Identity.


How to join a meeting via Microsoft Teams Web App?

Externals that are not using Microsoft Teams yet can join via the Web App:

These are the steps your external partner should perform:

  1. Right-mouse-click on the meeting link and Copy Hyperlink
  2. Use the web browser Chrome or Microsoft Edge to open the link. The following page will appear:
  3. Click on Continue on this browser
  4. A pop-up message will appear. Click on Allow
  5. This window will appear. Here, your external partner can Enter a name and then click on Join now to enter the meeting.




(2) External Collaboration Identity 


How to create an External Collaboration Identity?

To create an external collaboration user type, you can follow a step-by-step instruction here.

Hint: Once your external partner's collaboration identity is activated, please actively add them to the dedicated teams. Please see here. 

Once External Collaboration Identity role is created and activated, we highly recommend your external partners to access Microsoft Teams web app via Incognito mode (private browsing) in their web browser.

The external partner can access Microsoft Teams, but it's empty.


How to invite an External Collaboration Identity (e.g. max-smith@porsche.com) to a Bosch team in Microsoft Teams?

As the team owner, you can add External Collaboration Identity to a team.

By searching External Collaboration Identity's name or their e-mail address, the team owner can easily add them in. We suggest using the e-mail address for the invitation, this is faster.

Hint: the account format of collaboration identity is maintained as "External xxx (guest)".

Once a team owner invited an collaboration identity to a Bosch team, he/she can very soon see the team's name in the list. Meanwhile, he/she will also receive an e-mail notification.

 NOTE The invitation link will be sent directly from Microsoft. Unfortunately, this is not as reliable as expected. Microsoft called this a known issue and has no solution or workaround for this problem.

Workaround: You can send team link to Externals manually. To do that click on three dots next to the name of your team → Get link to team



How to manage a Bosch team that includes External Collaboration Identity?

As the team owner, you can manage "guest permissions" via setting function, e.g. if you do allow external collaboration identity to create/update channel or even delete channel.

Known limitations with External Collaboration Identity?

General:

  • cannot upload a profile image/picture
  • cannot request for Teams Public Telephony
  • cannot use the Federation feature
  • can only see the presence status of Bosch employees who have contacted the External Collaboration Identity directly 
  • can only see the presence status of people who are the members of the team/channel in which External Collaboration Identity is added
  • does not have a call tab in Teams main window
  • cannot create a new team/channel
  • cannot be the owner of a team/channel
  • cannot be a call delegate or group call member
  • does not have access to the Teams apps store
  • cannot use the feature to translate individual message
  • cannot install an app in a team/channel
  • cannot listed voicemails directly in the teams application

Teams Meetings:

  • cannot schedule a Teams meeting and send out an invitation. External Collaboration Identity can only initiate a meeting in a channel, by clicking the "Meet" button at right upper corner .
  • cannot become a Breakoutroom manager
  • does not have a calendar on the left side of the menu
  • cannot create a whiteboard and PowerPoint presenting

  • cannot start recording in Teams meeting

Files and Access:

  • can only access recordings after individual approval by meeting organizer
  • cannot use direct file exchange in 1:1and group chat, only file exchange in a team is possible
  • has no OneDrive for personal files





Joining a team from an external company


How to switch to team rooms that are hosted from external companies

Bosch employees can be invited to a team room from an external company (see Overview).

Once you are part of the external team, click on the arrow next to your profile picture:

All external companies you are in a teams room with are listed. Just switch back and forth between Robert Bosch GmbH and the others.


How to leave a team / tenant of a team room that is hosted from external companies
  1. Click on the three dots on the upper right corner of Microsoft Teams
  2. Click on Settings
  3. Go to Accounts. Here you can see all companies that you have access to (green).
  4. Click on Manage

  5. Your browser will open. Go to Organizations on the left
  6. Here you can click on Leave organization


How can Externals that are not using Teams join a Teams meeting?

This is possible with the Microsoft Teams Web App. See below:


How to join a meeting via Microsoft Teams Web App?

These are the steps your external partner should perform:

  1. Click right-mouse-click on the Meeting Link and Copy Hyperlink
  2. Use the internet browser Chrome or Microsoft Edge to open the link. The following page will appear:
  3. Click on Continue on this browser
  4. A pop-up message will appear. Click on Allow
  5. This window will appear. Here, your external partner can Enter a name and then click on Join now to enter the meeting.


Teams Guest User Usability

A guest user can:

  • a pending guest invitation within Teams app - when the guest user clicks Decline, Teams Tenant List will not show the tenant with the pending invitation and in the Account Management tab
  • initiate leaving an org (taking the user to the portal where the user can now leave a guest tenant) - when the guest user clicks Leave Org, user will be guided on how to leave a tenant from Teams and Azure Portal
  • manage guest tenant list by choosing to hide/show guest tenants - when the guest user clicks Hide/Show, the tenant will be shown (or hidden) in the Menu under the tenant list.

Inquery Survey Server

Inquery Survey Server

General Information

Inquery is a professional survey tool. It is provided by Inworks (external vendor) and is the standard Bosch solution for internal and external online surveys.
The previously used tool AskIT has been phased out.

Please note, that Inquery will not accept new users from 2022 based on Back To Profitability Program decision. We will keep documentation available here for the existing users. For the users who are now interested in using survey tools, we will recommend you to consider Microsoft Forms.

  • Test survey
  • Test survey results statistics center

Functionalities

Inquery supports any kind of online survey and offers a wide variety of functions, e.g.:

  • simple lists of one or several questions.
  • complex structures involving logically dependent sub-pages
  • target audience specific adaptations and customization
  • responsive survey display
  • advanced functionalities including customized scripting
  • html coding is supported
  • administration of frequent and/or recurring surveys
  • the Statistics Center for evaluating responses immediately
  • means, bar charts and other numeric evaluation directly in the tool
  • export of results to Excel, PowerPoint, RTF and PDF for presentations and further analyses
  • multilingual surveys
  • campaign management/360° feedback

The biggest advantage of Inquery is that it is a customizable tool and can fulfill various different types of survey requirements.

Charging

Each personal user account for Inquery is charged with 390 Euros/month. Users can carry out as many surveys as they like. Charging is always according to calendar months.

How does Inquery work?

The questions and/or survey items are entered into a project and saved in the tool.

(7) Click in the statistics center and analyze your results
