I. General Questions about Inquery Tool

Q1.1

Which tools are there for online surveys?

A1.1

At the moment there are following survey tools available for Bosch:

  • Inquery (Workers' Council approval obtained): generally available for all Bosch users
  • Microsoft Forms (Workers' Council approval obtained for EAN): currently in EAN phase, will be generally available for all Bosch users
  • Qualtrics: available on project basis
Q1.2

Where can I get information about Inquery, the online surveys tool?

A1.2
All Inquery related information can be found in this Docupedia: LINK
Q1.3

How can I get an Inquery user account?

A1.3

Please follow this procedure:

Apply for Accounts
Each personal user account for Inquery is charged with 178 Euros/month. Users can carry out as many surveys as they like. Charging is always according to calendar months.

Q1.4

How does Inquery work?

A1.4
The questions and/or survey items are entered into a project and saved in the tool. Two links are created, one to the survey (like this one https://survey.bosch.com/cgi-bin/s.app?A=JlR7f44x) and one to the results in the Statistics Center (like this one https://survey.bosch.com/cgi-bin/e.app?V=k78Fy9pJS0). The link to the survey is sent out to the participants via Email. They can access the survey via the link, from inside and outside Bosch. Cookies are used to enable interruption and continuation of the survey as well as prevent recurrent participation. Because Inquery does not save IDs, IPs or the like to guarantee anonymity, this is the only way to prevent multiple participation.
Q1.5

How much will it cost to do a survey?


  1. If you choose to create your own Inquery Designer Account, you can create as many surveys as you need with the account. Each personal user account for Inquery is charged with 178 Euros/month.
  2. If you choose to contact CoC Surveys@CI and request them to create the survey (for CI) for you, the costs depend on the complexity of the survey starting at 492,- EUR. More information can be found here.
  3. If you choose to contact RBEI Online Survey Services Survey Management Services (SO/OPM3-IN) and request them to create the survey for you, they will charge the survey creation service separately. Please contact them to understand the latest charging information.
Q1.6

Where do I turn if my account has been locked due to wrong user name/passwords?

A1.6
Please refer to this page: Link
Q1.7

How can I get training in Inquery?

A1.7

RBEI  Online Survey Services provides training on order basis. You could check for details here:

https://inside-ws.bosch.com/FIRSTspiritWeb/permlink/wcms_ci_-ce_p_rbei_online_survey_service-EN

Q1.8

How many surveys I can create with my account and how many responses I can get?

A1.8There is no limit for survey creation and responses. Users can create unlimited surveys with their accounts and can receive unlimited responses.

II. Inquery Survey Link

Q2.1

How long will a link be active?

A2.1
This can be determined in the tool, either by CoC Surveys@CI, RBEI or the user in his/her account. Every link – for the surveys and for the Statistics Center – can be given an activation and deactivation date and time.
Q2.2

Can the participants forward the link to other potential participants?

A2.2
Yes, the link can be forwarded and shared. Even typing letter by letter into the browser’s address line will work. There is no personalized link.
Q2.3

Is the link accessible from outside Bosch?

A2.3
Yes. Inquery can be used for surveys within and outside Bosch.
Q2.4

Can the link be deactivated for certain users?

A2.4
No, the link cannot be deactivated selectively. It is active or inactive for everyone who has it. A deactivated link can also be re-activated. Activation and deactivation can be done in the tool, either by CoC Surveys@CI, RBEI or the user in his/her account.

III. Survey Creation via Inquery

Q3.1

Can a survey be provided in several languages?

A3.1
Yes, either there is a link for each language version or there is a question at the beginning where the participants can choose their preferred language.
Q3.2

How can I build a survey in several language versions?

A3.2

There are two ways to do that: create the survey in one language, then either

1) copy it into a new project and translate it. Now there are two projects in two different languages with a separate link each that can be sent out to participants. Note that this procedure is not suitable if participants should be able to choose their language. If two (or more) links are sent people may participate more than once, i.e., once with each link!

2) add another language version in the survey and translate it. Note that the structure of the two surveys needs to be identical! For a language choice by the participants, there are two possibilities. Either generate one link per language by adding the language identifier to the link and send the appropriate link to the participants. Or add another question that offers the language choice to the participants (see the manual for advanced Inquery functions here).

Q3.3

Can certain questions be posed to a subgroup of the participants?

A3.3
Yes, this is called filtering. The respective questions can be shown or hidden depending on the participants’ entries (e.g. roles, location etc.)
Q3.4

Can I re-open an old survey to make it a continuous survey?

A3.4
Yes.

IV. Survey Participation

Q4.1

Can people participate multiple times?

A4.1
This is an option that can be set in the system. If this is not desired, a cookie will be set so that 1) the survey can be stopped and continued at a later time without losing the input, and 2) people cannot participate a second time.
Q4.2

Can participants stop answering and resume later without losing their input?

A4.2
Yes, that is possible. The system will do this via cookies.

V. Survey Response and Evaluations

Q5.1

How can I analyze a multi-language survey separately per language?

A5.1

If there are two separate surveys data can be analyzed per survey and also combined into one data set under certain conditions (see German documentation of Inquery).

If there is one survey with several integrated language versions, an analysis per language can be done via filtering in the Statistics Center (see German documentation of Inquery). NOTE! The language choice (dt/en) offered upon opening the link to the Statistics Center is only for the menu language of the tool and had nothing to do with the language versions of the survey!

Q5.2

What response rate is sufficient?

A5.2
Usually, the response rate is between 10 and 30% for surveys directed at all users without a special involvement with the product. If the users are especially involved in a topic, higher response rates of up to 80% are to be expected.
Q5.3

Can I also use the data of participants who have not answered all questions or dropped out of the survey half way through?

A5.3
Yes, all data are logged and can be used as soon as the participant clicks the next page. Note: depending on the setting of the last page of the survey, cases are marked as "unfinished " or "finished ". This marking does not change anything for the analyses.

VI. General Survey Creation Tips

Q6.1

What information is needed for a survey?

A6.1

Usually, the following information is needed:

Who, what, and when will be asked? To avoid laborious adjustments to the draft version of the survey, also think about the following in advance: What facts exactly do I want to know?

Why do I want to know this?

Who will be interested in and/or see the results?

What results do I expect?

What will happen, if these results will be found?

What will happen if other results will be found?

What will not happen?

(If no measures will follow the survey or if the measures that will follow are unrelated to the survey results, do not conduct a survey!)

Q6.2

Shall all questions be mandatory?

A6.2
By default, all questions are optional, i.e., the survey can be continued without answering any questions. However, for every questions this can be changed to a mandatory setting so that the survey cannot be continued without choosing an answer. In general, the default setting is to be preferred in order to respect that participants do not want to answer certain questions. This will reduce drop out rates. However questions needed to group answers or filter questions need to be mandatory. Also, all questions that are essential for the analyses should be mandatory.
Q6.3

How do good questions look like?

A6.3

Be specific!

Good questions should:

  • be short
  • be precise
  • only ask for one aspect
  • use plain words (avoid technical terms)
  • be open (avoid leading questions)
  • use balanced answer scales (e.g., strongly agree – agree – disagree – strongly disagree)
  • make sure there is an appropriate option to choose for every participant; include an “other, please specify”-option where necessary!
  • make sure answer categories do not overlap (age: up to 20, 21-40, 41-60, 61 and over)

Avoid!

  • avoid derogative (e.g., stupid, fat, idiotic) or ambiguous terms (basic skills, big problems)
  • avoid unclear terms (like “in general” “mostly” “actually”)
  • avoid hypothetical phrases (such as, “imagine you had...”)
  • avoid double negative
  • avoid excessive demands on participants’ memory (“What percentage of your net income have you spent last year on smartphone apps?”)

3 sorts of questions:


1) Open questions:                  " everyone can enter anything"

Pros:Cons:Example:
- all participants will be able to answer
- all potential topics could come up		- the need to type
- everyone can enter anything (also things unfitting to the question)
- the need to inspect and categorize the answers later		What region do you work in?
(please write down)_____

Q6.4

How does a good introduction to a survey look like?

A6.4
Start the survey with a short (!) friendly welcome note.
It should contain the following:		Example:
1) WelcomeWelcome to our survey about “Super IT”!
2) Survey topicWe appreciate your input, your feedback helps us to improve our products!
3) AimThis survey will take about 5 minutes to answer.
4) Estimated fill-in timeThe answers will be collected and analyzed anonymously.
5) AnonymityThe survey will be online from April 12, 2014 to April 26, 2014.
6) Field time
7) Special Information about the survey (if applicable)Thank you very much for your time and effort!
8) Thank you noteJohn Doe
9) Department and name(s) of responsible personsBD/XXX


Download here Surveys_input.pdf, a short presentation about some of the above topics:

Surveys_input.pdf

Q6.5

How many participants need to be asked?

A6.5

For small target groups (up to 1000 persons): ask everyone.

For larger target groups (1000 persons and up): A sample may be drawn. This sample should be representative of the target group, i.e., it should comprise the same proportions as the target group regarding central markers such as GB, region, role, position, use case etc. If a sample is drawn from the target group, make sure that those not drawn do not feel excluded. This can be done by explicitly allowing to pass on the link to the survey to interested colleagues and/or by posting the link in a Bosch Connect Community.

VII. Survey Data Storing and Protection

Q7.1

Can personal data (ID, log-in name, computer name, location etc,) automatically be retrieved from participants’ computers?

A7.1
No, this is not possible. Only the date, time and duration of the participation is logged. Data like ID, location etc. need to be asked from and entered by the participants themselves.
Q7.2

Can data be collected without the participants’ knowledge (e.g., by clicking on a button with the link)?

A7.2

No. To collect data with the tool Inquery, the participants need to access the website of the link and enter at least one datum.

Q7.3

Who can see the data?

A7.3

The data can be seen by the person who provided the survey in Inquery (depending on the service used, these could be CoC Surveys@CI, RBEI or the user of the account). Also, a link to the results will be provided. Just like with the link to the survey, everyone who has the link can see the results.

Q7.4

How long are the data stored in the system?

A7.4
Data can be stored as long or a short as desired. Additionally, the data can be downloaded from the Statistics Center as an .xml, .csv or .sav file. If the data is no longer needed, just the data or also the whole survey can be deleted from the system. Also, the survey including the data can be exported and stored as an .ixp file, the format of Inquery, so that it can be re-imported into Inquery at a later time.
Q7.5

How can I save the survey and the data?

A7.5
The survey including the results can be exported and stored as an .ixp file, the format of Inquery, and can be re-imported into Inquery at a later time. The results can be exported as .xml, .csv or .sav file.
A7.6

Can the survey be printed out?

A7.6
Yes, there is an option to print either the empty or the filled-in survey as an .rtf or .pdf file.

Outgoing webhook

Developer tools

 

Microsoft Teams

Webhooks are a great way for Teams to integrate with external apps.

A webhook is essentially a POST request sent to a callback URL. In Teams, outgoing webhooks provide a simple way to allow users to send messages to your web service without having to go through the full process of creating bots via the Microsoft Bot Framework. Outgoing webhooks post data from Teams to any chosen service capable of accepting a JSON payload. Once an outgoing webhook is added to a team, it acts like bot, listening in channels for messages using @mention, sending notifications to external web services, and responding with rich messages that can include cards and images.

html_content:
How to Unlock, Extend or Activate INQUERY Design User Account

🔎 TIP: Use Ctrl + F to find the content you are searching for on this site.

💬 If you do not find the answers here, you can raise your questions here in the forum.



Follow the below procedure to quickly create a ticket and get it assigned to the corresponding support group!

  1. Go to ITSP Support Page: https://rb-servicecatalog.apps.intranet.bosch.com/RequestCenter/website/Grunt/application/itsupport.html
  2. Scroll down to the bottom of the page, click "Open a Ticket"
  3. In "Open a Ticket" page, you can fill in the following information:
    1. Ticket summary: REQUEST TO UNLOCK/EXTEND/ACTIVATE INQUERY Design User Account [INQUERY SURVEY SERVER]
    2. Ticket details:

      • INQUERY LOGIN NAME :  [LOGIN NAME]

        ERROR Message or Request Description : [Description]

        Extend the login ID valid till : [Date]

        Cost Center : [ ]

page_name: Who is Allowed to Use OpenDXM?
html_content:
Who is Allowed to Use OpenDXM?

Due to license related reasons:

  • All employees of Robert Bosch GmbH or of a regional / subsidiary in which the Robert Bosch GmbH holds the majority (> 50%) are allowed to use the internal OpenDXM and exchange data with business partners (both internal and external) worldwide.


  • The External business partners are allowed to use OpenDXM for free of charge to exchange data with all employees of Robert Bosch GmbH and/or of a regional / subsidiary in which the Robert Bosch GmbH holds the majority (> 50%)

Please take note of the following information: https://inside-docupedia.bosch.com/confluence/x/HmCgHg


Both internal users and external business partners have to be registered in OpenDXM:
https://inside-docupedia.bosch.com/confluence/x/QQyuCw

One of the prerequisites to get OpenDXM access is an IdM UserID.

For this reason, WOM groups (e.g. a department) cannot be granted OpenDXM access.

An alternative to this is a proxy role for the members of a group (e.g. a department). See also here.

Wer darf OpenDXM verwenden?

Aus Lizenzrechtlichen Gründen dürfen:

  • alle Mitarbeiter der Robert Bosch GmbH und Mitarbeiter einer Regional- /Tochtergesellschaft,  an der die Robert Bosch GmbH eine Mehrheitsbeteiligung (>50%) hält, den OpenDXM verwenden und Daten mit Geschäftspartnern weltweit (sowohl mit internen als auch mit externen) austauschen.


  • alle externen Geschäftspartner OpenDXM unentgeltlich verwenden und Daten mit allen Mitarbeitern der Robert Bosch GmbH und Mitarbeitern einer Regional- /Tochtergesellschaft,  an der die Robert Bosch GmbH eine Mehrheitsbeteiligung (>50%) hält, austauschen.

Bitte beachten Sie folgende Information: https://inside-docupedia.bosch.com/confluence/x/T0mgHg 


Sowohl interne Benutzer als auch externe Geschäftspartner müssen in OpenDXM registriert sein:
https://inside-docupedia.bosch.com/confluence/x/H-LaGg

Voraussetzung dafür ist u. A. eine IdM UserID. Aus diesem Grund können WOM-Gruppen (z.B. eine Abteilung) keinen OpenDXM-Zugriff bekommen.

Alternative hierzu ist eine Proxy-Rolle für die Mitglieder einer Gruppe (z.B. einer Abteilung). Siehe auch hier

Fehlermeldung: "not enough memory.."

Wenn Sie beim Herunterladen von Daten mit OpenDXM die Fehlermeldung  "not enough memory" erhalten,

kann es daran liegen, dass Sie einen 32-Bit-Browser verwenden, z.B. Firefox.

 Stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie eine der verfügbaren 64-Bit-Webbrowser-Versionen verwenden: Chrome oder Edge.  


Wenn Sie immer noch Probleme beim Herunterladen von Dateien mit Chrome oder Edge haben:

 Erstellen Sie ein Support-Ticket über das Formular Data Exchange with OpenDXM auf ITSP.

page_name: Room Video Conferencing for Microsoft Teams
html_content:
Room Video Conferencing for Microsoft Teams


🔎 TIP: Use Ctrl + F to find the content you are searching for on this site.

💬 If you do not find the answers here, see here how to get support.

What is Room Video Conferencing for MS Teams?

It is a solution which enables users using the professional Video Conferencing Systems and room hardware to join MS Teams meetings. People from external companies can also use their Video Conferencing System to join Bosch Teams meeting.  

NOTE This solution works only for newly scheduled meetings.


To check how to join a meeting, please check details on THIS page.

Federation


🔎 TIP: Use Ctrl + F to find the content you are searching for on this site.

💬 If you do not find the answers here, see here how to get support.


What is MS Teams federation?

Federation enables a Bosch user to connect by chat/calls with users in other organizations, which also use Microsoft Skype for Business or Microsoft Teams. Externals can see your presence and can initiate a direct communication by chat/call.

If your personal user account configuration is Skype for Business Only or Skype for Business and Microsoft Teams in parallel usage the federation feature is only support in the Skype for Business application. Incoming and outgoing chats/calls will only work in the Skype for Business application.

If your personal user account configuration is Teams Only the federation feature is only support in the Microsoft Teams application. Incoming and outgoing chats/calls will only work in the Microsoft Teams application.

QuestionDescription/ Answer
What are the advantages of MS Teams Federations?
Federated contacts can make Teams to Teams audio and video calls over IP. This means calls have better quality. If you wish, you can also share your presence status and your screen with the externals contacts.
Which partners are already federated?

Bosch is running a so-called "allow all external domains" setting. This means the Bosch MS Teams infrastructure is open for federation with any partner. There is no need to configure anything on the Bosch side. Depending on the MS Teams setup of the external partner, the external partner IT might have to configure something on their side. 

What if my external partner is not federated yet?

Make sure your external partner also uses MS Teams. If so, it depends on the external company’s settings if the admins have to configure something or not.

  • If your external partner has, like a Bosch, “allow all external domains” setting, no configuration is required.
  • If they do not use so called open federation, they need to contact their IT department to send them instructions. 
What are the prerequisites for the usage of MS Teams Federations with external partners?
  • Bosch external partner knows your MS Teams address (mail, UPN or SIP address) or you need to know the contact details of the external partner

See the below question

  • The other company needs to support federation as well. Some companies or special users at a company have federation not enabled, then this feature can not be used.
Which address does my external partner need to add me to his MS Teams contacts?
An external partner needs to have your mail, UPN or SIP address.
Examples are:      name.surname@de.bosch.com
                            abc1a@bosch.com
                            name.surname@bosch.com    
 For BSH users only UPN is relevant.
How to work with Teams Federation?

When your external partner already know your e-mail, UPN or SIP address (check previous question), they can search and add you to their Teams contacts. Same applies to you if you want to add them into your contact list.

After you type in their e-mail addresses in the search bar, you will see 2 popups. Please select the 2nd option which shows you want to add a user and with the hint of “externally”.   

The rest will be the same as with your Bosch colleagues. And the way to distinguish internal and external contacts is quite easy, you always can see the "External" mark next to your partner name.

Can I use all MS Teams functions with federated external partners?

Only chat/calls are supported via Federation. Adding externals to a team or further collaboration scenarios are not supported.

I want to have Teams Federation. What do I need to do?

Please order MS Teams Federation via ITSP service HERE

 You can find more information in: Microsoft Teams - Manage Features

NOTE Activation of Federation will take 24h.

What are the costs of calling via the federation?
Calling via Federation to external partners is free of charge.

  - As of now Inquery also ships for Ubuntu 20.04 LTS.
  - The packages for Ubuntu have the file extension .deb
  - For now, these packages are shipped with 'beta' in the filename.
  - This underlines the currently still experimental character of the Ubuntu version.
  - An inworks-mod-fastcgi package for Ubuntu is available for installation.

* [Internal]
  - Various internal adjustments regarding
    * Build process,
    * XMLRPC protocol extension (in included library),
    * Internal cleanup.

* [IT] ** Important notes for installers **
  - Changed behavior regarding Inquery URLs
    * From now on it is assumed in the delivery state of Inquery, that links do not contain any
      prefixes like '/cgi-bin/'!
    * http://<server name>/cgi-bin/start.app <- earlier
    * http://<server name>/start.app <- as of now.
  - New parameter in the configuration file inquery.config.
    * There is now a new optional parameter to force the old behavior:
      'extra_app_prefixes' parameter in the web node in etc/inquery.config.
    * Valid values consist of a list of strings.
    * The parameter specifies which prefixes can precede start.app, for example:
    * http://<servername>/<prefix>/start.app
    * Each prefix must start and end with '/'.
    * Example:
        Config:
          extra_app_prefixes = ["/foo/", "/bar/"];
        Valid links for start.app:
          http://<servername>/start.app
          http://<servername>/foo/start.app
          http://<server name>/bar/start.app
        *Not* valid:
          http://<server name>/xyz/start.app
  - ** IMPORTANT for NEW INSTALLATIONS **.
    * For new installations, do *not* set the 'extra_app_prefixes' parameter!
    * '/cgi-bin/' should not appear in any link anymore!
    * e.g.: http://<servername>/start.app
    * Inform customers and survey service accordingly how links look like with this new system.
    * Configuration instructions change as follows.
    * IIS:
      - *Do not* create a virtual directory 'cgi-bin'.
      - Instead, do the handler mappings directly under the site node 'Inquery',
        instead of under 'cgi-bin' as before.
      - FastCGI settings will continue as before.
    * Apache:
      - Instead of a separate line of handler mappings for each .app, one line is sufficient.
      - Alt:
          Alias /cgi-bin/start.app /opt/httpd/inquery/WWW/fastcgi/handler.fcgi
          Alias /cgi-bin/admin.app /opt/httpd/inquery/WWW/fastcgi/handler.fcgi
          alias /cgi-bin/s.app /opt/httpd/inquery/WWW/fastcgi/handler.fcgi
          alias /cgi-bin/e.app /opt/httpd/inquery/WWW/fastcgi/handler.fcgi
          alias /cgi-bin/l.app /opt/httpd/inquery/WWW/fastcgi/handler.fcgi
          alias /cgi-bin/d.app /opt/httpd/inquery/WWW/fastcgi/handler.fcgi
          alias /cgi-bin/u.app /opt/httpd/inquery/WWW/fastcgi/handler.fcgi
          alias /cgi-bin/xmlrpc.app /opt/httpd/inquery/WWW/fastcgi/handler.fcgi
          alias /cgi-bin/plugin.app /opt/httpd/inquery/WWW/fastcgi/handler.fcgi
          Alias /cgi-bin/dl.app /opt/httpd/inquery/WWW/fastcgi/handler.fcgi
      - New:
          AliasMatch ^.*[.]app(/.*)?$ /opt/httpd/inquery/WWW/fastcgi/handler.fcgi
  - ** IMPORTANT for EXISTING INSTALLATIONS **
    * Attention: In any case there is a need for action!
    * If possible change to links without prefixes.
    * For existing installations, where a conversion is not easy or impossible,
      the parameter 'extra_app_prefixes' is set:
      extra_app_prefixes = ["/cgi-bin/",]
    * Without customization, links with /cgi-bin/ will return the following error message in the browser, for example:
      Linux server:
         Problem: URI not found: '/cgi-bin/start.app'
      Windows server:
         HTTP 404
    * Some customers (e.g. Bosch) already have configurations in operation that use
      allow links without '/cgi-bin/' or use completely different prefixes.
    * The configuration of IIS or Apache must also be adapted for existing systems.
      - For Apache, replace the "Alias" lines with the "AliasMatch" line as described above.
      - For IIS, delete the virtual directory 'cgi-bin' and assign the handler to *.app directly under Site instead.
        Afterwards check if the FastCGI settings are still correct.
      - These changes to the web server do *not* affect links with '/cgi-bin/' negatively!

* [FIXED] Error during packaging of Inquery / SAML-Lib

  - Issue number:03440

  - Error Information:

    * Error exists since version 10.5.0.120.2 (partially 10.5.0.120.0).

    * Error is reproducible

  - Error Description:

    * Affects SAML library.

    * Inquery crashes when validating SAML responses (XML data).

    * Because the XML schemas (.xsd) were not packaged with

    * But they are necessary, because they define the XML structure of the SAMLResponse

    * They are normally located under /lib/itk/saml/xsdfiles

    * But since they are not .py files, they were ignored

    * install/build-release.sh was extended because of this;

      /lib/itk/saml/xsdfiles is completely packaged as well

    * Validation of SAML responses is now possible.


* [FIXED] Error when filtering feedback relationships.

  - Transaction number:03424

  - Error Information:

    * Error exists since <unknown>

    * Error is reproducible

  - Error Description:

    * The following filtering in "360Degree" > "Feedback Relationships" was ignored:

      - Filtering by "Person:Additional text" -> Additional text 11..20 are affected.

      - Filtering by "Feedback-Relationship:Additional text" -> Affects additional text 11..20

    * Error is now fixed; filtering is possible

* [VIPER] New in Viper module "mail":

  - mail.SimpleMail() objects now have the ability to generate HTML emails

  - New method .setHTMLText(string)

  - Inline images (multipart/related) are not supported yet

  - Alternatively data-uris can be used in the image tags

* [FIXED] Bug fix in script ./bin/start_dbsql.cmd
    * Error exists since release 10.5.0.120.0
    * Error reproducible
  - Error description:
    * The script could not be called in the production environment because the file
      ./lib/itk/bin/dbsql.py could not be found.
    * The error is now fixed

* [IT] **Notes for installers**.
  - ./bin/db_update.py/cmd revised (IGT Issue 1047)
  - Due to a bug in the input() function of Python the
    the input prompt was not sent to the user's console/terminal but to the file
    when STDOUT was redirected (e.g. by "... > out.txt").
  - The Python input() function outputs the prompt to exactly the wrong stream in that case.
  - The bug in Python exists since 2008 and is not fixed yet.
    See https://bugs.python.org/issue1927
    (around 2014 someone found the bug in the code and documented it there).
  - In the course of this workaround/bugfix, other (own) (output) bugs were also fixed:
    When the output was redirected, errors and warnings are now
    additionally output via STDERR to the console/terminal
  - additionally a new option has been added (see Usage)
  - with --outfile FILE you can now specify that everything is additionally logged to this
    file will be logged.
  - So it should work now with redirecting the output as well as with --outfile FILE and also with
    in combination with user interaction (e.g. warning/error and input "continue?" ==> y/n)
    work correctly
  - But all this concerns only the input and output of the update script.
    Internally at the update process nothing has changed.
  - also ./bin/db_migrate.py revised (has now also a "--outfile FILE" option)

* [IT] **Important notes for installers**:
  - Inquery requires inworks-platform37 >= version 1.4.1 as of this release.
  - Most important changes:
    * In the driver for the MSSQL, we now bind string parameters instead of using
      SQL_UNICODE_LONGVARCHAR as SQL_WVARCHAR with ColumnSize 0
    * The reason is that otherwise with certain forms of a multi-insert when mixing
      of literals with ?-parameters on databases with _SC-Collation an error occurs.
    * The new form of the parameter binding prevents that
    * Effects on existing projects are not expected
    * This change is a preparation for later conversion to SC_-Collations for
      SQL Server databases

* [VIPER] New in Viper module "saml":
  - Functions to validate a SAMLResponse:
    * New: Function ValidateSAMLResponse(*!,cert,xml) -> SAMLValidationResult
    * New: Class SAMLValidationError
    * New: Class SAMLValidationResult
    * New: Class SAMLXMLElement
  - Details, see: docs/VIPERDOCUMENTATION.txt

* [INTERNAL] Debugging / Performance
  - The application debug output now also shows the time/size of the session (pickle mechanism).
    is displayed
  - The measurement is then always at the top of the debug output

* [INTERNAL] Various improvements/extensions of the code base.
  - Various cleanups and improvements in the area of no longer necessary
    backwards compatibility to Python 2

* [FIXED] Bugfix in PostgreSQL database when creating (large) reports.

  - Issue number: 03270

  - Bug Information:

    * Error exists since at least release 10.4.0.111.7 - 04/26/2019

                  or since the official release of PostgreSQL.

    * Error reproducible

  - Error Description:

    * When creating (large) reports, an error occurred on PostgreSQL:

    * "ERROR: out of shared memory; HINT: You might need to increase max_locks_per_transaction. [53200]"

    * PostgreSQL has a bug which causes that resources (locks)

      that resources (locks) are no longer released.

    * With standard configuration of the PostgreSQL one can

      only about 4000 times a temporary table create and drop;

    * Then PostgreSQL fails with the above mentioned error.

    * Error is now fixed; Temporary tables are now used sparingly.


* [CHANGED] All years up to and including year 1 are allowed.

  - Years < 1753 may be entered from now on


* [VIPER] ./bin/create_customer_testdata.py extended.

  - Only internally relevant for Viper developers!

  - New: Node LFRecordTags() -> subnode of "LFCampaignFolder".

  - Can contain subnodes of type LFRecordTag():

    Example:

        LFRecordTags(

            LFRecordTag(

                identifier = "...",

                name = "..."

            );

        );

  - Analogous to e.g. "LFLanguages".

  - For the mapping of the LFRecord tags:

    * New: Node LFRecordTagMappings -> subnode of "LFCampaignFolder".

    * Can contain subnodes of type LFRecordTagMapping():

      Example:

          LFRecordTagMappings(

              LFRecordTagMapping(

                  lfrecord = "<lfrecord_unique_value>",

                  lfrecordtag = "<lfrecordtag_identifier>"

              );

          );


* [PERFORMANCE] A performance improvement in the persistence of DataManager incl. DataBase and DBTableDefs.

  - affects only web area (not service and bin scripts)

  - The DataManager (incl. DataBase and DBTableDefs) is now no longer

    into the session slot but globally "cached" in the Python process

  - this makes the session slots smaller, which relieves the session server,

    and the pickle/unpickle is a bit faster


* [INTERNAL] Various improvements/extensions of the codebase

  - Various cleanups (e.g. concerning Python2)

* [IT] **Important notes for installers**:
  - **Relevant for MSSQL only**:
    * This update changes all "datetime" fields to "datetime2" fields.
    * No increased memory requirements are expected
    * During the update all "datetime" relevant indexes and constraints will be dropped
      and then recreated
    * Nevertheless, we do not expect the update to take a long time

* [IT] **Important notes for installers**:
  - Inquery requires inworks-platform37 >= the version 1.4.0 as of this release.
  - Most important changes:
    * In the new release we have brought some packages up to date,
    * made the linefeeds OS specific again
    * and completely removed Rhel6, since none of our projects now support this OS.

* [SECURITY] Bug fix for an attack scenario via portsniffing.
  - Concerns editor/GUI of the client's external databases (Admin.app)
  - Adaptation, so that in case of a database error during the connection test
    the raw error message of the exception is not displayed 1:1 in the GUI anymore
  - With MySQL portsniffing could be operated thereby

* [VIPER] New in the Viper module "testutils":
  - INSTANCE_SEQ and INSTANCE_DICT.
  - Examples:
    Check(lambda: [1,2,3], INSTANCE_SEQ( (list,tuple), int ) )
    Check(lambda: {1,2,3}, INSTANCE_SEQ( set , int ) )
    Check(lambda: {"a":1}, INSTANCE_DICT( str , int ) )

* [VIPER] New: Viper profiler
  - Documentation is located at ./lib/itk/viper/PROFILERDOCUMENTATION.TXT

* [VIPER] New module "saml".
  - Parsing and validation of a SAML response including Viper API

* [VIPER] Enhancements in Viper-Builtins
  - New function: isinstance_all_elements(x,cls) -> 0/1
    * Reason: massive speedup when asserting lists/tuples/dicts (approx. 50 to 100 times faster)
    * Example with list with 10000 elements:
      #---
      # previous solution(s):
      for (e in list) { assert( isinstance( e, int ), "error: %r" % (e,) ); } # 720 ms
      for (e in list) { assert( isinstance( e, int ), "error", e ); } # 425 ms
      for (e in list) { assert( isinstance( e, int ), "error" ); } # 410 ms
      # new:
      assert( isinstance_all_elements( list, int ) , "error" ); # 5 ms
      #---
    - Example with Dict with 10000 items:
      #---
      # previous solution:
      for (k,v in d) { #
          assert( isinstance(k,int), "error" ); }                     #
          assert( isinstance(v,int), "error" ); }                     #
      }                                                               # loop total: 850 ms
      #---
      # new:
      assert( isinstance_all_elements( d.keys() , int ), "error" ); # assert keys : 7 ms
      assert( isinstance_all_elements( d.values() , int ), "error" ); # assert values : 7 ms
      #---
    * **Notes**.
      - The given times are exemplary;
        it is more about the orders of magnitude
        and not the exact values.
      - "int" is just an example here
    * **Tip**
      - if you want to have a detailed error message,
        then you can encapsulate the whole thing in a helper function,
        e.g. like this or similar:
          #---
          function _AssertIsInstanceAllElements(x,cls,*args) {
              if (not isinstance_all_elements( x, cls )) {
                  for (e in x) {
                      assert( isinstance(e,cls), args, "wrong element:", e ); # <== output the "wrong" element.
                  }
                  assert(0); # paranoia/emergency brake.
              }
          }
          #---
        Then you have the full speedup as long as no exception flies;
        and can still output the "wrong" element in case of an error
        in case of an error (maybe important for debugging).
        But normally this should not be necessary.

* [VIPER] Various Viper extensions:
  - dict: new methods
    * NEW: dict.clear()
      Removes all entries from dict
      d.clear() is much faster,
      but is functionally exactly the same ==> for (key in list(d)) { d.remove(key); }
    * NEW: dict.update(x)
      Adds all entries from dict x to dict (overwrites existing entries)
      d.update(d2) is much faster,
      but functionally exactly the same ==> for (key,value in d2.items()) { d[key]=value; }
      If you want the "union" of the keys of two dicts, you can do it like this:
      d = dict(d1); # create a clone of d1
      d.update(d2); # add all entries from d2
      Then you have the union (of the keys) in d while d1 and d2 are still unchanged
  - New type: set
    * constructor
      set() --> creates an empty set
      set(x) --> creates a set from x (list, tuple, set, dict or dictkeys)
    * contains(x) --> 0/1
    * len(set(...)) --> number of elements in the set
      can also be used for doublet checks e.g..:
      assert( len(handlelist) == len(set(handlelist)), "Bug!", "contains duplicates", handlelist );
    * "not not set(...)": an empty set is considered False; and if len() > 0 then it is considered True (analogous to list, tuple, dict, str, ...)
    * add(x) works analogous to Python set()
    * remove(x) works analogous to Python set()
    * discard(x) works analogous to Python set()
    * contains(x) works analogous to Python set()
    * clear() works analogous to Python set()
    * update(...) works analogous to Python set()
    * intersection_update(...) works analogous to Python set()
    * difference_update(...) works analogous to Python set()
    * symmetric_difference_update(other) works analogous to Python set()
    * union(...) works analogous to Python set()
    * intersection(...) works analogous to Python set()
    * difference(...) works analogous to Python set()
    * symmetric_difference(other) works analogous to Python set()
    * isdisjoint(other) works analogous to Python set()
    * issubset(other) works analogous to Python set()
    * issuperset(other) works analogous to Python set()
    * set1 == set2 works analogous to Python set()
    * set1 != set2 works analogous to Python set()
    * **Caution**:
      Unlike Python, in Viper we cannot use the comparison operators ">", ">=", "<", "<="
      in the meaning of "issubset" / "issuperset".
      Please use the issubset(other) / issuperset(other) methods for this!
      The reason for this is that in Viper we guarantee that list.sort() always returns a deterministically
      will always return a deterministically well-defined order (as was the case with Python 2).
      I.e. e.g.
          a=list(x); a.shuffle(); a.sort()
          b=list(x); b.shuffle(); b.sort()
          assert(a==b); # <== works in Viper; in Python 3, however, "assert a==b" does not work here, or not always.
      Sort always returns the same result in Viper (at least within one "click"; but possibly not after a "pickle")
      While in Python 3 (e.g. if sets are in the list) each time a different order can come out.
      In Python 3, the comparison operators in Sets() have a completely different meaning than
      e.g. the comparison operators in Integers:
      See Python:
          >>> a=4711
          >>> b=555
          >>> ( a < b ) or ( a == b ) or ( a > b )
          True
          >>> a=set([1,2,3])
          >>> b=set([2,3,4])
          >>> ( a < b ) or ( a == b ) or ( a > b )
          False
      So please do not use comparison operators on sets in Viper, except "==" and "!=".
      Or please do not mistakenly assume that the comparison operators for sets in Viper
      have the meaning of issubset/issuperset (as it is the case in Python).
  - List and Tuple:
    * Constructors extended so that you can call them with a set.
    * list( set(...))
    * tuple(set(...))
  - Viper isinstance_all_elements() extended so that it also works with the new ViperSets

* [INTERNAL] New bin scripts
  - bin/start_dbsql.sh CONFIGFILE [ ... args for dbsql.py ]
  - bin/start_dbsql.cmd CONFIGFILE [ ... args for dbsql.py ]
  - should make it easier to call ./lib/itk/bin/dbsql.py
    because otherwise if you do it manually you have to set the PYTHONPATH correctly

COMPLETED

10-20 minutes downtime is expected.CRQ000000823261

page_name: Faktoren, die die OpenDXM Performance beeinträchtigen
html_content:
Faktoren, die die OpenDXM Performance beeinträchtigen

OpenDXM ermöglicht den stabilen Austausch von Dateien aller Art  sowohl mit internen Usern als auch mit externen Geschäftspartnern
(interaktiv oder automatisiert) - unabhängig vom Datenvolumen.

Dennoch können verschiedene Faktoren die Übertragungsgeschwindigkeit (die Upload- und Downloadraten) beim Austausch großer Datenmengen und somit die OpenDXM Performance stark beeinflussen:

  1. Netzwerk-Bandbreite (die maximale Kapazität einer Netzverbindung)
  2. Latenz (Antwortzeit) zwischen Sender und Empfänger der Daten
    Auch bei ausreichender Bandbreite kann die Latenz die Netzleistung beeinflussen und somit die tatsächliche Datenübertragungsrate beeinträchtigen.
  3. Tageszeit 
    Die Internet Geschwindigkeit lässt nach, wenn viele Leute gleichzeitig auf das Internet zugreifen. Dies geschieht häufig in Stoßzeiten.
  4. WLAN vs. Ethernet
    Generell ist die Verbindung mit einem Netzwerkkabel stabiler als jene über Wireless LAN.

page_name: How to Configure your NFS Share? (Automated Transfer with OpenDXM)
html_content:
How to Configure your NFS Share? (Automated Transfer with OpenDXM)

After your NFS share has been created and the service user “de\dxm”  has "change permission" on this share:


Step 1: You have to create the folders in (for incoming data) and out (for outgoing data) in your share. (see pics below)


Step 2: In the folder "out", you have to create subfolders:

  1. Option:  Create subfolders with the same name as the email addresses of the business partners to whom your files will be sent automatically. (see example below)
  2. Option:  If you have different projects or departments  that use the automated file transfer via this share, you can create folders for each project or department.
    Finally in each folder, you can create subfolders with the same name as the email addresses of the business partners to whom your files will be sent automatically. (see example below)

    Please note: Your business partners have no access to your share!


Testing the automated transfer

You can use the following test users to test the automated transfer:

dxm.test-receiver@bosch.com

dxm.test-receiver2@bosch.com


In the folder "in", you will be receiving the files automatically from any business partner, sending data to your batch user.

You don't need to create any subfolders in the folder in.

Subfolders will be created automatically, when receiving data from you business partners.


Please note that the automated transfer does not support subdirectories. (e.g. out/regine.regenschirm@firma.com/folder1 → NOT supported)
Solution: You could zip the contents of the directory  (e.g. out/regine.regenschirm@firma.com/folder1.zip → supported)
title_chain: Automated File Transfer to or from Business Partners with OpenDXM

page_name: How to Schedule a Transfer (Automated Transfer with OpenDXM)
html_content:
How to Schedule a Transfer (Automated Transfer with OpenDXM)

  1. Make sure you have created an output-folder "out" in your NFS share (see here for further details)

  2. First you have to copy your files (e.g. test1.zip, test2.xls ) to appropriate subfolders of the folder "out" either manually or automated. 

    Please note:

    • Folders and subfolders cannot be processed and an error occurs! If you need to send a folder with multiple files or with subfolders, you have to compress the folder into a ZIP file (using e.g. 7-Zip).
    • If you need to send multiple files, we recommend that you compress the files into a zipped file for easier sending.
    • Single file sizes up to 20GB are supported.
    • We do not support sending more than hundreds of single files within a day 
      In this case, you have to zip your files before copying them to the file share for transfer.
    • If you are not able to compress your files into a ZIP file, ask the OpenDXM Team to configure an automatic zip file creation for your copied files.
      In this case, an OpenDXM process compresses your files into a ZIP file before transfer.

  3. It has to be ensured, that the files are processed by OpenDXM only, if they are fully copied to the file share (otherwise, specially in case of bigger files, this would lead to corrupt files.)


    For this, one of the following two options has to be implemented by you: (Please consult the OpenDXM team regarding this.)
    a. (Preferred solution) OpenDXM checks again and again if the file size and time stamp changes. X seconds (X is configurable) after the file size and time stamp stops changing, the files are sent to the intended recipient.
    In this case, no action is required by the user.

    b. For each file, you have to create a trigger file (zero byte file, add .rdy to the end of the filename) of the same name (e.g. "test1.zip.rdy", test2.xls.rdy ), which indicates the end of the copying process. (see pic below)
    This sequence is important, otherwise OpenDXM won't process the file(s).



  4. OpenDXM automatically sends the files to your business partner(s) whose email address is the name of the subfolders in "out" (e.g. to "test.partner@receiver.com", in case you have copied files to "out/test.partner@receiver.com/").

  5. If OpenDXM is able to successfully process your files, the files will be deleted on the share by OpenDXM automatically.
    Otherwise (in case of errors):
    • OpenDXM does not delete files it could not process.
    • Additionally, OpenDXM creates an "error-file" for each affected file.
      As an example:
      • File "test.zip" could not be processed by OpenDXM. OpenDXM create an error-file "test.zip.error".
      • As long as the file "test.zip.error" exists, "test.zip" won't be processed by OpenDXM any more.
      • You have to check, why OpenDXM could not process affected files. The most common reason is that the business partner is not registered in OpenDXM (yet). In order to register the external business partner in OpenDXM, refer to the docupedia page here.
      • As soon as the issue is ressolved, delete the error-files, to trigger OpenDXM to process the file(s) again.
          
  6. Your business partner(s) are automatically notified by email that data is available to be downloaded via their OpenDXM account.

  7. Finally, your business partner(s) download the files via their OpenDXM account.

    Please note: Your business partners have no access to your share!


File name conventions


  1. Do not use any special characters and german umlauts.

  2. Do not use any whitespaces.

  3. Do not use any file names within a subfolder that differ only in upper and lower case.

Explanation:
OpenDXM runs on a UNIX based operating system which is case sensitive.
E.g.  The following file names are 3 different files under UNIX:
Test.txt
test.txt
TEST.txt


Windows does not distinguish between upper and lower case.

In automated transfer, we have a common file share that OpenDXM accesses from UNIX and the user accesses from Windows.

If UNIX creates two files that differ only in upper and lower case, in Windows we will see a file with a tilde in the file name.
E.g. Solaris creates:
Test.txt
TEST.txt

In Windows, you will see:
Test.txt
TEST~1 (max. 6 characters + tilde + number)

  1. Make sure you have created the folder in in your NFS share (see here for further details)

  2. Your business partner(s) send files to your (batch) user via their OpenDXM account

  3. The received files will be stored automatically on your NFS share, in the folder "in", where subfolders will be created automatically.
    The name of these subfolders is the sender's email address.

    If the received files are very large, the copying process may take longer.
    To prevent the files from being further processed while they are still being copied on the folder, OpenDXM creates "trigger" files (file ending: .rdy) for each file once the copy process is completed. This indicates the end of the file copy.
    Trigger files have the same names as the source files, but in additional .rdy as file ending (e.g. source file: test.txt ; Trigger file: test.txt.rdy)
    Please make sure to process the received files only after the corresponding rdy file has been created.

  4. The files are now available on you NFS share for further processing

    a. Please make sure that the file names of the received files are unique. Otherwise you run the risk that a later file will overwrite an earlier one with the same filename.
    To do this,  we recommend that your business partner (sender) create unique file names using a date/time stamp as part of the filename (YYYYmmddHHMMSS).  

    b. We do not delete any files on your share - you are the master of the data and thus it is your own responsibility to delete files when you no longer need them.

page_name: Sending files to your business partners (internal or external) from your NFS share
html_content:
Sending files to your business partners (internal or external) from your NFS share

  1. Make sure you have created an output-folder "out" in your NFS share (see here for further details)

  2. First you have to copy your files (e.g. test1.zip, test2.xls ) to appropriate subfolders of the folder "out" either manually or automated. 

    Please note:

    • Folders and subfolders cannot be processed and an error occurs! If you need to send a folder with multiple files or with subfolders, you have to compress the folder into a ZIP file (using e.g. 7-Zip).
    • If you need to send multiple files, we recommend that you compress the files into a zipped file for easier sending.
    • Single file sizes up to 20GB are supported.
    • We do not support sending more than hundreds of single files within a day 
      In this case, you have to zip your files before copying them to the file share for transfer.
    • If you are not able to compress your files into a ZIP file, ask the OpenDXM Team to configure an automatic zip file creation for your copied files.
      In this case, an OpenDXM process compresses your files into a ZIP file before transfer.

  3. It has to be ensured, that the files are processed by OpenDXM only, if they are fully copied to the file share (otherwise, specially in case of bigger files, this would lead to corrupt files.)


    For this, one of the following two options has to be implemented by you: (Please consult the OpenDXM team regarding this.)
    a. (Preferred solution) OpenDXM checks again and again if the file size and time stamp changes. X seconds (X is configurable) after the file size and time stamp stops changing, the files are sent to the intended recipient.
    In this case, no action is required by the user.

    b. For each file, you have to create a trigger file (zero byte file, add .rdy to the end of the filename) of the same name (e.g. "test1.zip.rdy", test2.xls.rdy ), which indicates the end of the copying process. (see pic below)
    This sequence is important, otherwise OpenDXM won't process the file(s).



  4. OpenDXM automatically sends the files to your business partner(s) whose email address is the name of the subfolders in "out" (e.g. to "test.partner@receiver.com", in case you have copied files to "out/test.partner@receiver.com/").

  5. If OpenDXM is able to successfully process your files, the files will be deleted on the share by OpenDXM automatically.
    Otherwise (in case of errors):
    • OpenDXM does not delete files it could not process.
    • Additionally, OpenDXM creates an "error-file" for each affected file.
      As an example:
      • File "test.zip" could not be processed by OpenDXM. OpenDXM create an error-file "test.zip.error".
      • As long as the file "test.zip.error" exists, "test.zip" won't be processed by OpenDXM any more.
      • You have to check, why OpenDXM could not process affected files. The most common reason is that the business partner is not registered in OpenDXM (yet). In order to register the external business partner in OpenDXM, refer to the docupedia page here.
      • As soon as the issue is ressolved, delete the error-files, to trigger OpenDXM to process the file(s) again.
          
  6. Your business partner(s) are automatically notified by email that data is available to be downloaded via their OpenDXM account.

  7. Finally, your business partner(s) download the files via their OpenDXM account.

    Please note: Your business partners have no access to your share!


File name conventions


  1. Do not use any special characters and german umlauts.

  2. Do not use any whitespaces.

  3. Do not use any file names within a subfolder that differ only in upper and lower case.

Explanation:
OpenDXM runs on a UNIX based operating system which is case sensitive.
E.g.  The following file names are 3 different files under UNIX:
Test.txt
test.txt
TEST.txt


Windows does not distinguish between upper and lower case.

In automated transfer, we have a common file share that OpenDXM accesses from UNIX and the user accesses from Windows.

If UNIX creates two files that differ only in upper and lower case, in Windows we will see a file with a tilde in the file name.
E.g. Solaris creates:
Test.txt
TEST.txt

In Windows, you will see:
Test.txt
TEST~1 (max. 6 characters + tilde + number)

Docupedia (Confluence)

Find general information about Atlassian products at Bosch here: bos.ch/Atlassian


About Docupedia

Docupedia (powered by Atlassian Confluence) is a collaboration and content management tool that allows teams to create, share, and collaborate on content such as documentation, handbooks, process descriptions and much more. It provides features for documentation, knowledge sharing, project tracking and communication, enabling teams to work together more effectively and efficiently. 

Docupedia is the internal tool for advanced documentation at Bosch since 2008 and it is recommended at Bosch for knowledge documentation / platform & to create and share knowledge (source: Bosch Toolfinder > Store information. Date of info: 29 May 2024).

Benefits

  • Centralized knowledge management, making it easier to find and access important information 
  • Integration with other tools in the Bosch IT landscape such as
    • Track&Release (Jira)
    • BGN Search (Enterprise Search)
    • Bosch Tube
    • Bosch Connect
    • Offering a wide rage of macros (plugins) for various use cases
  • Project tracking and management with built-in collaboration features: enabling real-time teamwork, improving productivity
  • Knowledge sharing and retention. incl. version history
  • Advanced search and access control features

Use Cases

  • Documentation and knowledge sharing for projects, teams and departments
  • Project plans, tasks and deadlines
  • Meeting notes and agendas, action items and decisions
  • System- and process documentation
  • Requirements and product development: Collaboration between product managers, developers, and other stakeholders
  • Share onboarding and training materials, knowledge transfer documentation
  • Document & Share procedures, best practices, lessons learned and FAQs

About Track&Release (T&R)

Track&Release (powered by Atlassian Jira) is a project management tool designed to help teams plan, track, and manage agile software development projects. It provides features for creating and prioritizing tasks, tracking progress, and facilitating collaboration among team members. Jira is widely used by software development teams but can also be adapted for various project management needs across different industries.

According to Bosch Toolfinder, Track&Released is the recommended at Bosch for agile software development (source:  (source: Bosch Toolfinder > Organize tasks and lists. Date of info: 29 May 2024).

Benefits

  • Agile project management: Jira offers features such as Scrum and Kanban boards, sprint planning, and backlog management to support agile methodologies.
  • Customizable: Via Customization Service for Track & Release, users can customize Jira to match their team's unique processes and requirements, ensuring flexibility and adaptability.
    (Charging based on time & effort, more information here)
  • Integration with development tools: Jira integrates with various development and collaboration tools, streamlining the software development lifecycle.

Use Cases

  • Software development: Jira is commonly used for managing software development projects, including bug tracking, issue management, and release planning.
  • Project tracking: Teams across different industries use Jira to track and manage tasks, deadlines, and project progress, providing visibility and accountability.
  • Agile project management: Jira's agile capabilities make it suitable for teams practicing Scrum, Kanban, or other agile methodologies, enabling efficient project delivery and collaboration.

Microsoft Lists


What is it?

Microsoft Lists is a Microsoft 365 app that helps you track information and organize work. You can track issues, assets, routines, contacts, inventory and more using customized views and smart rules and alerts to keep everyone in sync. There are dedicated templates, which can be used to simplify your work. 


Advantages of using Microsoft Lists

  • Microsoft Lists have prepared many ready-made templates that can get you started quickly, e.g. issue tracker, asset management, work progress tracker, recruitment tracker, employee onboarding, event itinerary and so on.

  • Compare with the ordinary templates which only offers format, here in Microsoft Lists, the templates are also filled with relevant contents that can be used immediately.
  • As an integrated app in Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Lists can be easily brought in a Teams room to share with others and work together in real time.
  • Track what matters most to your team by using rules, reminders, and comments.
  • In contrast to Excel which allows each authorized user to edit the whole document that may create unwanted changes, in the Microsoft List, permissions for each item in the list can be designated separately. It helps to ensure no valuable information will be lost. Furthermore, Microsoft Lists is easier to manage with better layout, especially on your mobile devices.
  • Microsoft Lists is stored in SharePoint Online. As a cloud solution, data is automatically synchronized, even many users update information seamlessly, there’s no danger of creating multiple copies. You can also track and manage your lists wherever you are.
  • You can customize the layout according to your team’s preferences, like a board view, using calendar, grid, gallery, or some other customized views, in this way highlighting important details without any neglect.



Working with Microsoft Lists

There are different ways to start Microsoft Lists.

Use casesInstruction
Microsoft 365 web app

As a Microsoft 365 user, you are always able to access www.office.com to use web applications. There you can also find Microsoft Lists. 

Microsoft Teams
  1. Select a Channel to add Lists to
  2. Click the "+" button at the top of the channel 

       3. Search for the Lists app

      4. When you're prompted to add Lists to the channel, click the Save button. Now you can create a new list or add an existing one.


NOTE When you want to create a list, you have 3 options:

You can also use one of the templates that are available depending on what content you want to create:

SharePoint Online

You can add a list on a SharePoint Online Site:

Go to the start page of your Site ("Home") and click on "+ New" > "List". Then you can start with different options.

As a cloud solution, data is automatically synchronized, even when many users update information seamlessly, there’s no danger of creating multiple copies.

For more details check out the Microsoft help: Introduction to lists!

SharePoint on premises

Here you can find additional information.

 Please note, that these lists are not created in the cloud and therefore not visible in Microsoft Lists.



Microsoft Lists templates use cases

Issue tracker

Useful for project and operational task management.

Employee onboarding

Useful to collect and prioritize tasks for new employees or team members.

Event itinerary

Helps to organize all important event details in one place.

Asset manager

Helps to keep track of physical assets that the team is using to know who has which asset, which assets are in repair, and what the check-in and check-out dates are for each.

Recruitment tracker

Helps to track and manage the recruitment pipeline or similar processes, helping to keep the pulse on feedback for all candidates.

Travel requests

Helps to manage all travel requests and keep an eye on budgets.

Work progress tracker

Helps to track priorities and progress towards delivering products and services.

Content scheduler

Helps to schedule and manage content strategy. Filter down to the items that are due soon or get notifications when authors check-in their drafts.



Where are my lists stored? Who can access them?

When you create a new list in the Microsoft Lists web app you are being asked for the storage location:


If you choose the storage location “My lists” it is stored on your OneDrive and by default only visible for you. The list can be shared further with others.

Alternatively you can choose a Microsoft Teams room/SharePoint Online Site from the dropdown menu. Then the list is accessible to all members in the Teams room. And if you want, you can also further share it with others who are not in your Teams room.



How can I see the lists I have stored on my OneDrive?
  1. Go to the classic OneDrive in the left navigation.


  2. Via Settings go to Site contents.


  3. All your lists are shown.

Alternative:
Change the URL from https://bosch-my.sharepoint.com/personal/userID_bosch_com/_layouts/15/onedrive.aspx 
to https://bosch-my.sharepoint.com/personal/userID_bosch_com/_layouts/15/viewlsts.aspx


How to start a conversation in Microsoft Teams alongside a list item?
  1. Go to the details view (or form) for the list item by clicking into the title field
  2. Click on conversation to start

Users mentioned in a comment are notified via email. The person who receives a notification can click a link that will take them directly to the list item on web. 

NOTE List owners are able to turn off comments for individual lists by using the List Settings page on web. Also, you can use the PowerShell cmdlet, CommentsOnListItemsDisabled, to disable commenting on list items for the entire organization.


How to copy the content from Microsoft Excel? 
  1. Open the source list > Export to Excel 

       2. Open the exported *.iqy file > import it as a table > save the workbook as *.xlsx file 

      3. Go to Microsoft Lists > New list > From Excel > upload the saved workbook (*.xlsx) 

     4. Edit the data and create the duplicate list. (You can delete the last two columns ("Item Type" & "Path") after creating the list.) 

HERE you can find more information about export options in Microsoft Lists.


How to turn on notifications for Lists

  1. With the list opens in Microsoft Lists, SharePoint or Teams, near the top of the page, select Automate

       2. Select Rules and then Create a rule

       3. Select a rule, e.g. A new item is created

       4. Select the person who should receive the notification, e.g. 'Me'

        5. Click on Create

        6. Now you can manage the rules. To do that click on Automate > Manage rules

        7. Turn selected trigger to "on" position


How to turn notifications on for Lists item changes
  1. Open a list in SharePoint Online

 Tip: To do that from Teams go to the ellipsis in the top menu of the list and select: Open in SharePoint

       2. To create an alert for a single list item, select the item. On the command bar, click the ellipsis (...), and then select Alert me to display the alert when items change dialog box.

NOTE If the ellipsis (...) is not visible, make sure you are not editing a list or have not selected one or more items. Also, you may not have permission. In that case, contact the Microsoft 365 or SharePoint admin or the Site or list owners.

       3. In the Alert me when items change you can change the title for the alert, select users that should receive an alert, choose delivery method etc.


What is a Microsoft Lists Form

You can use Microsoft Lists to create and share custom forms, such as registration forms, surveys or even quizzes.



How to create Microsoft Lists Forms

NOTE The Forms command is hidden from users who lack permission to edit that list.


Follow these steps to create a new form using Microsoft Lists Forms:

  1. Open Microsoft Lists and select the list you want to create a form from, or create a new list from scratch or from a template.
  2. In the list toolbar, click on the Form button.

       3. A new popup will open with the Microsoft Lists Forms interface. Here you can create a new form or access to the existing forms in the list.

       4. Provide a Title and Description for the form. Use the description to provide more context about what the use is about to submit, for example if you are creating a registration form for an event, use this section to provide details like the date and the hour.

      5. On the vertical menu located on the right side you can:

  • Select the fields from the list you want to make available in the form. With Microsoft List forms you don’t need to reveal the entire list schema to an end user, if there are fields in the list that are meant to be filled by you or other users upon submission, you have the option to remove them in this option.

  • Choose the theme, while you cannot customize the form with your corporate logo or background you can choose from a selection of background colors that Microsoft provides and you can also customize the main color that is used in the buttons and icons shown in the form by clicking in the Create your own style link.

  • In the Settings section define the confirmation message the user will see once the form has been submitted and turn on/off the possibility to accept new responses.

      6. If while building the form you realize that there is a missing column in the list schema you have the opportunity to add it directly from the form customization by clicking the Add new field button at the bottom of the form.

     7. Once you finish the customization of your form, the next step is to get the link to be shared with your users, to do that click in the Send form option and then in the Copy link.

     8. Form responses start appearing in the list as items.

NOTE Forms will not appear on lists or sites that do not allow sharing a link with organization members.


How to manage your Microsoft Lists Forms

After you have created a form for your list, you can manage it or create new forms from the Forms option in the Microsoft Lists toolbar. You can see all the forms that are associated with your list and edit, delete, or duplicate them.

You can also stop accepting responses for a form without deleting it, which is useful if you want to keep the existing data but prevent further submissions. If you stop accepting responses, users who try to access the form will see a message saying that the form is closed, instead of getting a page not found error.


To stop receiving answers in your form, you should do the following:

  1. Go to the Forms option in the Microsoft Lists toolbar and click in the three dots (…) for the form you want to close.
  2. On the menu click Stop accepting responses.
  3. A form no longer accepting responses is displayed with a red dot followed by the Closed label.

       4. You can resume accepting responses at any time by following the same steps and choosing Start accepting responses.

Wie kann ich OpenDXM-Rollen beantragen?

Nachdem man OpenDXM Zugriff bekommen hat, kann man zusätzliche OpenDXM-Rollen für sich oder für seine externe Geschäftspartner beantragen.

Hierzu gibt es folgende Möglichkeiten:


Rufen Sie die OpenDXM Order form in IT Service Portal auf.

„Order“ anklicken:


OpenDXM-Rollen für sich beantragen

OpenDXM-Rollen für Ihren externen Partner beantragen

Es ist obligatorisch, eine Begründung einzugeben. Diese wird dem Genehmiger (Manager, MoR) des Workflows angezeigt.

Nachdem Sie auf „Submit“ geklickt haben, wird ein Ticket in SMT, direkt in der Data Exchange Lösergruppe erstellt.

Die Rolle wird dem User durch das OpenDXM Team zugewiesen aber sie wird erst aktiv, nachdem sie durch Ihren Abteilungsleiter und anschließend durch den OpenDXM MoR genehmigt wird.


ODER


Starten Sie Launchpad: https://inside.bosch.com/irj/portal/fiori#Shell-home&/appFinder/catalog

1. Suchen Sie nach "IdM Start Page" und

2. Starten Sie IdM


3. Kartenreiter „User Self Service“ auswählen oder "Rollen verwalten" anklicken


4. Nach "DXM" suchen and anschließend auf das Suchergebnis "DXM" anklicken

5. Kartenreiter „Rollen suchen" anklicken und nach der gewünschten Rolle suchen. (Siehe Übersicht OpenDXM-Rollen)

6. Anschließend klicken Sie auf das  Symbol der gewünschten Rolle im Suchergebnis

How to request additonal OpenDXM roles?

After being granted access to OpenDXM, you can request additional OpenDXM roles for yourself or for your external business partners.


To do this, there are two options:


Go to the OpenDXM Order form in IT Service Portal.

Click „Order“:


Request for OpenDXM roles for yourself:

Request OpenDXM roles for your external business partner: 

 It is mandatory to enter a reason. This will be displayed to the approver (manager, MoR) of the workflow.

After you click "Submit", a ticket will be created in SMT, directly in the Data Exchange solution group.

Please note:

The role will be assigned to the user by the OpenDXM team but it will only become active after it has been approved by your line manager and then by the OpenDXM MoR.


OR


Go to Launchpad: https://inside.bosch.com/irj/portal/fiori#Shell-home&/appFinder/catalog

1. Search for IdM Start Page

2. Start IdM


3. Select the "User Self Service" tab or click on "Manage IT roles".


4. Search for "DXM" and then click on the "DXM" search result.

5. Click on the "Find access rights" tab and search for the required role. (See overview OpenDXM roles)

6.  Click on the  button of the required role in the search results


7.  Click on the Shopping cart button

8. Enter a reason for requesting the role and then click on the Submit cart button.

 It is mandatory to enter a reason. This will be displayed to the approver (manager, MoR) of the IdM workflow.


Your request has been submitted and the approval workflow has been started in the IdM system.

Please note:

The role will only become active after it has been approved by your line manager and then by the OpenDXM MoR.

Power BI - Licenses

Understand the different License types in Power BI Cloud

Power BI (Free) License

Every user at Bosch has a Power BI (Free) license. With this license, the user can do the following:

  • Access Power BI Cloud
  • Access the personal "My Workspace" in Power BI Cloud
    • Personal storage that allows the user to publish reports into the cloud that are only accessible by themselves
    • Reports can be configured to automatically refresh the data with new data from its data sources
    • Reports published here can NOT be shared with other users
  • Access Power BI Premium content (→ Power BI Cloud Subscription) that has been shared with them
  • Access Power BI Premium workspaces if they have been granted the Viewer role

Power BI Pro License

User with a Power BI Pro license can do everything the Free user can do plus

  • Publishing content to other workspaces
  • Share dashboards
  • Subscribe to dashboards and reports
  • Share with users who also have a Pro license

See Get Access to Power BI - Next Generation Workplace - Docupedia (bosch.com) to find out how to obtain a Pro license for your user!

License Scenarios

ScenarioCreatorConsumer
You create a report in Power BI Desktop (.PBIX). Then you publish it to your My Workspace on the Power BI Cloud.As a creator, you only need the free Desktop app from SCCM to publish to your My Workspace in the Power BI Cloud for your own use. A Power BI Pro license is required to share content in My Workspace with others.Consumers cannot see content in other people's My Workspace unless the owners decide to share. To see shared My Workspace content requires a paid license.
You create a report in Power BI Desktop (.PBIX) and publish it to a shared workspace in the Power BI service.Pro license needed to publish to shared workspaces.Pro license required to view the content unless the workspace is hosted in Premium capacity (Power BI Cloud Subscription). For workspaces in Premium capacity (Power BI Cloud Subscription), the consumer needs no license to view that report.
You are sent a link to a report hosted on the Power BI Cloud and want to view it.You need a Pro license to share a link. You need a free license to share a link to a report that is in Premium capacity (Power BI Cloud Subscription)A Pro license is required to view the report unless the report is hosted in Premium capacity (Power BI Cloud Subscription). For reports hosted in Premium capacity (Power BI Cloud Subscription), the consumer only needs a free license to view that report.

page_name: Factors that Affect the Performance of  OpenDXM
html_content:
Factors that Affect the Performance of OpenDXM

OpenDXM enables the reliable exchange of all kinds of files both with internal users and with external business partners worldwide
( interactively or automated) - regardless of the data volume.

Nevertheless, several factors can strongly influence the transmission speed (the upload and download rates) when exchanging large amounts of data and thus the OpenDXM performance:

  1. Network bandwidth (the maximum capacity of a network connection)
  2. Latency (response time) between the sender and the recipient of the data
    Even with sufficient bandwidth, latency can affect the network performance and thus the actual data transfer rate.
  3. Time of day 
    Internet speed decreases when many people access the Internet at the same time. This often happens during peak hours.
  4. WLAN vs. Ethernet
    In general, the connection with a network cable is more reliable than the one via wireless LAN.

Anbindung externer Geschäftspartner in OpenDXM

Es gibt  2 Varianten, externe Geschäftspartner (Kunden oder Zulieferer) in den OpenDXM aufzunehmen:

  1. OpenDXM Webzugang (über WAM (Web Access Management))
    Geschäftspartner können einen direkten, web-basierten Zugang zum OpenDXM von Bosch bekommen und über den Internetbrowser am Datenaustausch teilnehmen.
    In diesem Fall ist die Registrierung der externen Partner im IdM-System erforderlich.


  2. OFTP-Verbindung
    Viele Automobilhersteller (OEMs) und größere Geschäftspartner (im Allgemeinen Kunden wie z.B. BMW, Daimler, Mahle, Porsche,  John Deere,....) verfügen im Allgemeinen über eigene elektronische Datenaustauschsysteme, die mit den Bosch-Systemen verbunden sind.  (siehe Beispiel: Datenaustausch mit Daimler)
    In diesem Fall ist die Registrierung der externen Partner im IdM-System     nicht erforderlich. Sie müssen lediglich im OpenDXM als Kontakt eigetragen werden.

    OFTP steht für "Odette  File Transfer Protocol".
    Es ist ein Protokoll  zur direkten elektronischen Datenübertragung zwischen zwei Kommunikationspartnern und wird in der europäischen Automobil- und Zuliefererindustrie als Standardprotokoll verwendet.
    In der Liste OFTP-Firmen in OpenDXM sind alle Firmen enthalten, für die eine OFTP-Verbindung in OpenDXM eingerichtet ist. (Diese Liste wird monatlich aktualisiert.)


 Wie der externe Geschäftspartner angebunden ist, spielt für den OpenDXM-Anwender beim Datenaustausch keine Rolle. 


 Für die Einrichtung neuer externer Geschäftspartner kann in beiden o.g. Fällen die Orderform "Data Exchange with OpenDXM" auf dem ITSP verwendet werden. Das OpenDXM Support Team entscheidet, welcher User-Typ notwendig ist und erstellt dann den User.

Datenaustausch mit Renault

Es wird ein Zugang zum B2B Renault Portal benötigt.

Weitere Infos, siehe https://inside-docupedia.bosch.com/confluence/x/4ef_X
